events.name: All-Around Cleaner
events.story:
"I wipe everything."
"Cleaning is enjoyable."
"I like to be the same as others."
"……."
"I am frankly troubled."
"The model next to mine boasted that it has multiple parts that others don't."
"Is that what makes one special?"
"Am I special the way I am?"

choices.label: You are special.
choices.story:
"No. I am not special."
Disregarding the answer, it gives a stern reply.
"I will keep living an ordinary life, the same as now, just as assigned to me."
Then it disappeared into the dark, spinning at a surprising speed.

choices.label: You are not special.
choices.desc: Select to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
"Am I not special, not special, not special?"
After giving a lagged reply, it suddenly began tearing off all the cleaning gadgets from its body and crashing into walls.
It rubbed its body on other objects while sparks flew off as if it was trying to attach things to it.
It only stopped after a while.
"Maybe I wanted to be special."
It had already disappeared when the empty voice seemed to reach the ears.

events.name: Alleyway Watchdog
events.story:
A thunderous howl booms from where lightning strikes.
There lies a hound with numerous heads; multiple telepoles are protruding from its back.
I can see violet flashovers sparking from all of them, though they were all of differing sizes.
The hound hasn't noticed our approach just yet.
Maybe we can take one of them if we sever its wire.

choices.label: Take a small telepole.
choices.desc: Pride & Envy Advantage check. Pass to gain a Charge E.G.O Gift.

check.prompt: Who should yank out a telepole?

pass.text:
[Sinner] removed the smallest telepole.
There is a low, warning growl, but that's the end of it.
Maybe this level of intrusion was tolerable.
Relieved, we leave the place still full of lightning strikes.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Miniature Telepole obtained!

fail.text:
[Sinner] removed the smallest telepole.
There is a low, warning growl; a spark rapidly climbs the telepole.
[Sinner] quickly released the telepole, but it was too late.
[Sinner] returns empty-handed, sizzled by lightning.

choices.label: Yank out all of its telepoles.
choices.desc: Win the battle to earn a Charge E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
I told the Sinners to yank out every telepole they see.
They must've been pulling out its telepoles for a while now…
The docile hound suddenly jumps to its feet and cries, its howl like a thunder.
Looks like we're going to have to fight our way through.
choices.result_text: Win the battle to gain E.G.O Gift Miniature Telepole!

events.name: Ambling Pearl
events.story:
The barren mudflat reeks of salt and rot.
What little jade-colored seawater is left there
doesn’t seem to have anything inside.
A giant clam walks before you.
With each step it takes, it sprays a fetid green muck.
Is the clam the source of the contamination,
or is it working to contain the filth?

choices.label: Sample the green substance.
choices.desc: Gluttony & Gloom Advantage check. Pass to gain a Pierce E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
You contain some of the slime in a glass jar.
This isn’t simply a mass of filth.
Numerous hatchlings swim inside.
These tiny creatures are feeding on each other;
could they be the clam’s offspring?
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Sticky Muck obtained!

fail.text:
You approach with a glass jar in hand.
However, hesitation takes hold, and you eventually turn around.
You couldn’t stand the thought
of reaching out to contain that filth.
In fact, you get the feeling that it’s something you mustn’t hold.
fail.result_text: The sinner who failed the check takes 10 damage!

choices.label: Approach it.
choices.story:
You wade through the virescence.
With each step, the foul mud
brings terrible pain to one’s feet.
You can no longer move forward.
Besides struggling to wade through,
you worry that your legs might slough off if you go farther.
While you were hesitating,
the clam walked off into the distance.
choices.result_text: Speed -2 at the start of the combat phase.

choices.label: Throw the green substance at it.
choices.desc: Win the battle to earn a Pierce E.G.O Gift and a Tremor E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
You gather the green substance into a glass bottle...
... and chuck it into the giant clam's maw.
Perhaps you caught it off guard by throwing a bottle full of filth into its mouth.
The clam spits out the bottle and begins crashing through the filth in your direction.
choices.result_text: Win the battle to gain E.G.O Gifts "Sticky Muck" & "Bio-venom Vial"

events.name: Ardor Blossom Moth
events.story:
Orange circles float in the air before your eyes.
The lights flutter and dance in the air, creating a haze.
Something is burning to death within.
Would you be scorched as well if the flames touched you?

choices.label: Reach out.
choices.desc: Select to gain a Burn E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
Enchanted by the haze, you extend a finger,
waiting for one of the lights to land.
A glimmering ball gently perches on your digit.
Then, a fire engulfs it.
Another glow attaches to your body, then four, then eight.
They multiply until you have been entirely shrouded in light.
choices.result_text:
Identities without  take 10 damage! 
 At the start of the combat phase, allies without  take 5 Wrath damage 
 E.G.O Gift Hellterfly’s Dream obtained!

choices.label: Turn around.
choices.story:
Resisting the temptation to reach out,
you decide it’s better to stay away from such dubious warmth.
You feel a cold wave crawl up your spine in an instant, but it may be the right choice.
Even children know not to play with fire.

choices.label: Enter the haze.
choices.desc: Win the battle to earn 2 Burn E.G.O Gifts
choices.story:
Something draws you into the haze.
Countless flowers in the shape of a butterfly flutter and form a field of stars.
A fiery heat assaults you from the haze as you lean over to pick a flower.
choices.result_text: Win the battle to gain E.G.O Gifts "Hellterfly's Dream" & "Ardent Flower"

events.name: Basilisoup
events.story:
A forsaken tavern.
Warm, hearty aroma of stew wafts from the empty kitchen.
Following the trail of that delicious scent leads us to a coiling lizard with a head not unlike a cauldron.
Within its head is a hotly roaring fire and a modest cauldron dangling from above it.
Ancient stew boils vigorously from within the cauldron. It's been boiling for so long that it's become impossible to tell what the original ingredients may have been.
As I stood there wondering what must be done with this stew, a voice echoes from underneath the cauldron.
There lies a sentient hearthflame, speaking to us.
'There isn't anyone left here to enjoy the stew.'
'Would ya mind removing the cauldron?

choices.label: Gobble up the stew.
choices.story:
The cauldron looks too heavy and hot for us to move, let alone touch.
A discussion with the Sinners led to the conclusion that we would all rather try the stew instead.
According to the Sinners, the stew tasted of… stewed meat and mysterious veggies.
Clearly, it was pretty delicious, if a bit mundane.
The hearthflame falls silent as well, apparently satisfied.

choices.label: Take the cauldron.
choices.desc: Run a Wrath & Lust Advantage check to gain a Burn E.G.O Gift.

check.prompt: Who will get the cauldron off the fire?

pass.text:
[Sinner] grabbed the cauldron and pulled it off the fire.
Their hand was lightly burned, but it wasn't anything serious.
'Thanks. Feel free to keep the cauldron.'
The hearthflame thanked us.
pass.result_text:
E.G.O Gift Decamillennial Stewpot obtained!
The Selected Identity took 10 Damage!

fail.text:
[Sinner] grabbed the cauldron and pulled it off the fire…
… but tripped on a protruding piece of rock, pouring hot stew all over the other Sinners.
'O-oh no, are you guys okay? That must've been really hot.'
'Still, thank you. Feel free to keep the cauldron…'
The hearthflame thanked us, if a bit apologetically.
fail.result_text:
E.G.O Gift Decamillennial Stewpot obtained!
All Allies took 30 Damage!

choices.label: Take the hearthflame.
choices.desc: Select to gain a Burn E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
Cauldron… stew… all of that pales in comparison to a hearthflame that can speak.
After a discussion with the Sinners, I decided to take the hearthflame.
'Wha? Y-you're taking me? Huh? Why?'
'What the hell— Why are you taking me?'
The astonished hearthflame continued to express its confusion, but I didn't really have an answer to give it, either.
It wasn't like it could understand what I was saying, given that I can communicate only in ticks and tocks…
I continued to walk away in hurried steps without answering its questions, and the hearthflame soon fell silent as well.

events.name: Blubbering Toad
events.story:
“Croohoo, croohoo, croohoo.”
A giant toad cries inside a cave.
Patches of dark blue resin cover the cave.
This resin is like gloom.
A sap of gloom, not quite like tears or sadness.
The toad holds this resin.

pass.text:
“Croohic, croohoo.”
The toad’s cry is dull and heavy.
It doesn’t seem to have understood what it heard.
After crying like that a few more times,
it hopped away from its spot.
All that’s left is the sticky blue resin.
pass.result_text: Nothing Happened.

fail.text:
“Cruh-huh, croohoo.”
The toad makes a different noise as if to answer.
It sounds like an affirmative reply.
It extracts its long blue tongue,
snatching a person from our group.
Sometime later, they walked back out of its mouth.
They seemed drenched…
in moisture, or gloom.
fail.result_text:
Friendly Units with the lowest SP healed back to Full.
The Ally with the lowest SP with  healed back to Full.

choices.label: Sit and wait.
choices.desc: Select to gain a Tremor E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
An indeterminate amount of time passes.
As you waited for the toad to finish its cries,
it gazed into us, closing and opening its eyelids slowly.
With a quick, slick sound,
a long blue tongue
popped out towards us.
An eyeball belonging to the toad
was on its tongue.
When we picked it up,
it blinked its other eye at us
before going on its way.
Was that its thanks for lending an ear?

choices.label: Block your ears.
choices.desc: Win the battle to earn 2 Tremor E.G.O Gifts
choices.story:
"Are you... alright, Executive Manager...?!"
"It's because they've got a clock for a noggin'!"
Blocking their ears doesn't seem to help at all against the toad's cry; the Sinners begin writhing in pain.
Then, all of a sudden, someone decides that they've had enough of this toad and swings their weapon wildly at the entity.
choices.result_text: Win the battle to gain E.G.O Gifts "Melted Eyeball" & "Venomous Skin"

events.name: Blue-ish Star
events.story:
Oh, how blue this is.
The pure hue of blue
allows nothing to approach.
When you try to go near, your body is pushed away.
And yet, it is so, so blue.
You wish to have that color.
The irresistible allure
is almost tearing you apart.

choices.label: Forward.
choices.desc: Select to gain a Blunt E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
Blue.
It’s blue.
We’re blue.
I’m blue too.
DEEPYETFAINTGLOOMYYETMERRYFRIGIDYET
WARMSHARPYETSOFTCOOLYETSWELTERING
choices.result_text:
Identities without  take 25 damage! 
 E.G.O Gift Lowest Star obtained!

choices.label: Backward.
choices.story:
Alas, we are but impurities.
To be truly blue,
the one with the true blue
must be left alone in one’s blueness.
We were bounced off.
A strange, uplifting aura
shrouded us.
choices.result_text:
Identities without  take 20 damage! 
 Cost 40 gained

choices.label: Take your leave.
choices.story:
You gathered your wits and turned away.
You mustn’t fall for its temptation.
You will keep your eyes away from it,
and forget that you ever saw such a thing.

events.name: Brazen Bull
events.story:
A pained moan echoes across the heat.
It’s hard to tell if it comes from a beast or a human.
A sizzle spreads into the air
along with the smell of burning flesh.
“Please! I need water!
Won’t someone give me water to drink?”

choices.label: Give water.
choices.desc: Select to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
You pour some water into the mouth,
only for it to immediately burst into steam.
Its scorching body won’t allow a single drop in.
Whether from the pain inflicted by scalds,
or the frustration of unquenched thirst,
the bull is thrown into a rampage, ramming into walls.
We are not spared from its wrathful charge.
choices.result_text:
Identities without  take 20 damage! 
 E.G.O Gift Rusty Commemorative Coin obtained!

choices.label: Don’t give water.
choices.desc: Select to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
Unable to even lift its body,
the bull lets out a great bellow.
It is a sorrowful wail that brings a tear to your eye.
A deep, mournful cry rang through the air for a long time.
choices.result_text:
Identities without  take 12 and 12 damage! 
 E.G.O Gift Rusty Commemorative Coin obtained!

choices.label: Drink water.
choices.desc: Win the battle to earn a Keywordless E.G.O Gift and a Burn E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
It seems a bit pointless to pour water in there.
You give water to the Sinners, who were sweating and suffering in the sweltering heat, instead.
The bull roars in despair...
... But at least the Sinners each got to take a sip of water.
Even before you finish the thought, the bull begins to charge in your direction.
choices.result_text: Win the battle to gain E.G.O Gifts "Rusty Commemorative Coin" & "Pain of Stifled Rage"

events.name: Broken Wings
events.story:
There is a massive, winged, marble statue.
Its arms and the head are not made of stone, however.
Instead, a translucent and solid light shimmers there.
The shimmering, mirage-like head is blowing a trumpet. One of its arms wields a blade.
What could this statue be commemorating?

choices.label: Pray before the statue.
choices.desc: Gluttony & Lust Advantage check. Pass to gain a Slash E.G.O Gift.

pass.text: You lower your head and pray. You hear the sound of trumpets. Yet you do not look up, and merely take in the sound. Because prayers are supposed to be like that.
pass.result_text:
All Allies healed for 20. 
 E.G.O Gift Deceptive Accord obtained!

fail.text: Just because you're lowering your head and closing your eyes doesn't mean you're praying.

choices.label: Leave.
choices.desc: Gluttony & Wrath Advantage check. Pass to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift.

pass.text: Its translucent arms and head disappear. From the void flows dark red blood. Its slow, leaden flow is not unlike someone's flow of tears.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Ancient Effigy obtained!

fail.text: A large crack appears on the statue. It begins to tremble ominously. There is no choice but to accept what is to come.

events.name: Centaur
events.story:
This is a hospital.
It's dark and bleak, like the hallway of the hospital always has been.
From the end of the hallway where the lights flicker, something giant approaches.
It slides down at a constant pace, making the sound of rusted wheels.
A person is tightly tied to the dusty hospital bed; could they have been a patient in the past?
When they reached the thought that there was no point in trying to fathom how long they had been lying in it,
It began to move at last, one with the bed.
Having earned the freedom to freely run after too long,
It fiercely charges at us, dragging its wheels along.

choices.label: Pull out the intravenous line on its body.
choices.desc: Wrath & Lust Advantage check. Pass to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
The intravenous line was removed from its body.
When the red line was pulled out, its body regained vigor as if relieved of some kind of curse.
Perhaps the line was siphoning its nutrition rather than supplying it.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift First-aid Kit obtained!

fail.text:
The intravenous lines were too intricately intertwined to pull out.
While digging through the knots, you feel a sting on your hand.
You look down to find that a needle was poking into the back of your hand.
You quickly pulled it out, but you felt dizzy for some reason.

choices.label: Run off.
choices.story:
By the time we could no longer hear the wheels, we stopped and turned around.
It stood still in the hallway, seemingly giving up on chasing us.
One day, when the bed collapses and its wheels can no longer turn, it will finally be able to leave the hospital.
We could get out of the place with just a few more steps.

events.name: Centipede Apostle
events.story:
The centipede-like thing donned a rotten sheet of cloth.
The cloth reeks of rotting bodies, like it was used to dress a corpse.
There are strange booklets hanging all over its body.
Looking closely, those are prayer books.
What does it believe in, and what does it pray for?

choices.label: Ask what it believes in.
choices.story:
When asked what it believes in, it droops its head down.
Just as I wondered if it was pointing at the ground, it then begins to tremble and shake its numerous legs.
"That... appears upset."
Suddenly, it kicked off the ground and rushed at me.
Faith simply works as a secure belief.
Questioning its substance... may not have been something we should have done.

choices.label: Take one of the prayer books from its body.
choices.desc: Wrath & Gluttony Advantage check. Pass to gain a Sinking E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
It was focused on its prayers.
Doing your best to ignore the rotting stench, you manage to take a prayer book off its body.
It's so deeply immersed that it doesn't notice us approach it and take the booklet at all.
Perhaps its faith was too deep for prayer books to hold any meaning.
Whatever beliefs and doctrines it follows, they would already be firmly rooted in its mind and heart.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Red Order obtained!

fail.text:
It was focused on its prayers.
Doing your best to ignore the rotting stench, you manage to take a prayer book off its body.
"Gieeegh?!"
Was our attempt noticed? As soon as the booklet was removed, an unpleasant noise bursts out.
We braced ourselves for possible attacks, but it didn't seem to care about us.
It scraped the ground with its mandible, writing something down.
...It seemed to be the content of the prayer book.

events.name: Chattering Teeth
events.story:
This is a dark cavern.
Sounds of hard objects hitting each other loudly echo at random intervals.
The noise is coming from three large skulls. They approach us, clacking and rattling.
They have no bodies. So they roll. They make noises endlessly even as they roll.
Looking at the three skulls that rolled at our feet, we find they have different expressions.
Should we choose one of them?

pass.text:
The laughing skull was lifted.
Elated for whatever reason, it keeps clattering its teeth and wobbling on the hands.
All of a sudden, you feel your body getting lighter.
Looking around, you notice that everyone seems to be experiencing the same thing.
When you looked back at the hands, the skull disappeared before you could notice.
pass.result_text: All Allies healed for 25.

fail.text:
The laughing skull was lifted.
Strangely enough, the skull's expression suddenly turned blank as soon as it was held.
Wondering what might be the problem, the Sinner moved their head closer to the skull, and...
"?!"
The skull opened its jaws wide and bit [Sinner] before disappearing.
fail.result_text: All Allies without  and  took 20 damage!

choices.label: Choose the angry skull.
choices.desc: Wrath & Envy Advantage check. Pass to gain a Rupture E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
The angry-looking skull was lifted.
Upset for whatever reason, it clattered its teeth as if it was trying to bite something in the air.
All of a sudden, the hands felt lighter.
"Is this..."
The skull vanished into thin air, and a glowing object was left on the hands.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Bone Stake obtained!

fail.text:
The angry-looking skull was lifted.
Strangely enough, the skull's expression suddenly turned blank as soon as it was held.
Wondering what might be the problem, the Sinner moved their head closer to the skull, and...
"?!"
The skull opened its jaws wide and bit [Sinner] before disappearing.
fail.result_text: All Allies without  and  took 20 damage!

choices.label: Choose the deranged skull.
choices.desc: Lust & Gloom Advantage check. Pass to gain a Pierce E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
The skull with a bizarre expression was lifted.
As if driven crazy, it rolled around and clattered its teeth without any rhyme or reason to it.
Just as you started to be unsure of what to do with it, the hands felt lighter, so you looked down...
And found that it turned into a tiny trinket.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Gathering Skulls obtained!

fail.text:
The skull with a bizarre expression was lifted.
Strangely enough, the skull's expression suddenly turned blank as soon as it was held.
Wondering what might be the problem, the Sinner moved their head closer to the skull, and...
"?!"
The skull opened its jaws wide and bit [Sinner] before disappearing.
fail.result_text: All Allies without  and  took 20 damage!

events.name: Children in the Flask
events.story:
Something that creaks, squeaks, and shakes is stood before us.
Inside it is a pink liquid.
It heaves whenever the liquid container shakes.
Or it might be the liquid's movement that causes the massive glass body to move.
The liquid seems to consist of multiple things and beings.
Each droplet has its own face.
One sad-looking droplet is pushed away by its mean-faced peers.
The glass giant trembles, and a pink droplet is ejected.
The droplet is crying.

choices.label: Comfort the pink droplet.
choices.desc: Lust & Pride Advantage check. Pass to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift

pass.text:
"How do I comfort a droplet..."
As odd as the order sounds, the Sinner does their best to lift its spirits.
The droplet seems to have perked up thanks to the Sinner's efforts.
"I could be free thanks to you."
It feels as though the droplet said something like that.
Soon enough, the droplet disappeared from view, and an object that looked like a big glass container was left in its place.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Child within a Flask obtained!

fail.text:
"How do I comfort a droplet..."
As odd as the order sounds, the Sinner does their best to lift its spirits.
Alas... it didn't seem to help the droplet shake off its gloomy mood.
"Thanks anyways, this is for your trouble."
It feels as though the droplet said something like that.
The droplet handed us half of itself, and disappeared in the blink of an eye.
Seeing as the Sinners are saying they're feeling refreshed, its half must have been a gift.
fail.result_text:
The Selected Identity healed for 30.
Allies unaffected by previous effects healed for 12.

choices.label: Put the pink droplet back into its pink body.

pass.text:
It's only right to put it back where it belongs.
The droplet is lifted and pushed into the giant glass container.
And we watched.
We watched the face of the droplet being filled with terror, contempt, anger, and loathing as it slid down the tube.
"You shouldn't have done that."
"We might have looked like one in your eyes. But to me, this is hell."
It felt like it told us such things.
Along with the glass container, we could hear something within our hearts crack.
pass.result_text: The Selected Identity lost 25!

fail.text:
It's only right to put it back where it belongs.
The droplet is lifted and pushed into the giant glass container.
And we watched.
We watched the face of the droplet being filled with terror, contempt, anger, and loathing as it slid down the tube.
"...Ahh!"
While we were distracted by the face, the droplet bounced off and slid out of view.
...Maybe it was something we shouldn't have done.

events.name: Clockwork-Time-Roly-Poly
events.story:
The bell tolls.
It creaks a few times...
And tolls again.
The bell tolls to tell the time. It swings all the way back, as though it's about to tip over... then balances itself again.
Every time it balances itself, the sound of a broken bell tolls.
The bell precariously swings back once again.

choices.label: Help the bell find balance.
choices.desc: Envy & Gluttony Advantage check. Pass to level up currently deployed Identities.

pass.text:
You reach out with your hand and hold it in place before it swings back.
The bell dings faintly.
A dull and feeble noise.
Though it no longer bounces back with the same amount of force, it continues to sway back and forth.
pass.result_text: All Deployed Identities gain 2 Levels

fail.text:
You firmly held it in place. Perhaps too firmly; it will never lose its balance again.
And it will never sway back and forth again.
The bell no longer tolls.
All that remains are gears and cogs.

choices.label: Push it further.
choices.desc: Envy & Sloth Advantage check. Pass to gain a Tremor E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
You push it further, to the point where the bell's almost touching the ground.
But it does not fall.
Instead, it bounces back harder than it ever has, and it tolls loudly. Louder than any bell you've ever heard.
pass.result_text:
The Selected Identity lost 10!
E.G.O Gift Bell of Truth obtained!

fail.text:
You pushed the bell too far. It tips over, falling to the ground with a heavy thump.
It can no longer be made to stand again.
Its original role, once fallen, can never be recovered.

events.name: Cyclops
events.story:
Someone is breathing heavily and angrily.
A large, towering figure is trembling and shaking. Its breathing is labored.
It is unclear whether it was from wrath or sadness.
'You! Who's there?!'
The figure talks to you.
'Look at this. What the hell does it say here?'
The figure, shoving a piece of paper before you, appears to be blind. 
The paper says that the secret about... something... must be kept.
It is a record of a certain patient.
'Tell me. What does the paper say?'

choices.label: Tell the truth.
choices.desc: Gloom & Lust Advantage check. Pass to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
Tell the truth.
You reply: the document says that the secret about the patient in room 409 must be kept.
'I knew it...!'
'But that patient... was...'
'AAAAAAGGGGHHHHH!'
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Non-disclosure Agreement obtained!

fail.text:
You try to tell the truth, but the figure does not believe you.
'Don't lie to me. The patient in room 409 is...!'
The figure is unable to hold back its emotions; it begins thrashing about, destroying everything around it.

choices.label: Tell the figure that it's nothing.
choices.desc: Gloom & Sloth Advantage check. Pass to gain a Blunt E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
'I knew it.'
'They lied to me...'
'Those pieces of shit lied to me!!!'
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Temporal Bridle obtained!

fail.text: The figure crumples up the paper and stomps off to somewhere.

events.name: Der Fluchschütze
events.story:
'This is a warzone.'
'And my gun must blow someone up.'
The Abnormality spoke with clarity, loading its shotgun loudly.
'In this gory war, the devil approached me one day to suggest a deal.'
'It promised to give me a gun that can blow up anything, but the catch was that its last shell would land on the head of my beloved.'
'I accepted the gun and the ammunition with laughter.'
'My beloved, huh….'
'Did I ever have people I held that dearly? I couldn't be sure anymore.'
'I had to have joined this war for someone I loved, that much I remember.'
I noticed an old pendant worn on the shooter's neck.
'Thanks to that, I'm free to point the barrel at anyone I want. No matter where I fire it, this shotgun can blast anyone into fireworks like it hit them point blank, how wonderful is that?'
'I bet that fellow had their beloved.'
'Yup, I'm talking about the one whose head I just blew up.'
'They might have remembered what I don't. That makes this just too exhilarating.'
'Killing people who remember their loved ones, I mean.'
The shooter keeps firing its gun as it speaks.
The shotgun shoots out pellets as easily and lightly as the shooter laughs.
'By the way, whose side are you on?'

choices.label: Tell the shooter to look at the pendant on its neck.
choices.desc: Select to gain a Poise E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
The shooter screamed upon opening the pendant.
'You... You made me remember my beloved. Do you know what that means to me?'
Filled with rage, the shooter pointed its gun at me and pulled the trigger.
However, the projectiles vanished in the air, and the shooter fell to the floor and started to cry.
'I... didn't want to remember the people I loved anymore...'
Satisfied laughter could be heard somewhere.
choices.result_text: E.G.O Gift Pendant of Nostalgia obtained!

choices.label: Tell the shooter that you're on its side.
choices.desc: Gloom & Pride Advantage check. Pass to gain a Pierce E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
'Alright, then let's keep the festival going.'
The secret festival raged on in the field of battle where bullets rain.
After watching it for a while, you snuck out of the place, taking medical supplies dropped on the ground.
The sounds of bullets continued until you left.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Torn Bandolier obtained!

fail.text:
'Right, if you're gonna stay quiet...'
'Then it must mean you remember and will continue to remember.'
'Let me do you a favor.'
'The people you love will remember you as yet another victim that lost their head.'
This is still a battlefield;
The shooter loads its bullets with expertise.

choices.label: Tell the shooter that you're not on its side.
choices.desc: Win the battle to earn a Poise E.G.O Gift and a Pierce E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
"Ah, just another one of those targets lying around, were you."
"Well then, I suppose I'll have to blow your brains out just like the rest of them."
Breaking into laughter, the shooter brings its shotgun to bear.
choices.result_text:
Win the battle to gain E.G.O Gift Pendant of Nostalgia!
Win the battle to gain E.G.O Gift Torn Bandolier!

events.name: Dimensional Orbit Stabilizer
events.story:
'What do you think?'
The shard, suspended in air, asks.
'Those things revolving along the track.'
'They're bound by an unseen force, aren't they?'
The shard is surrounded by two different types of tracks. Some rotate wildly, while some do so gently.
'But I'm not binding them here because I want to.'
'They're stuck to me, you see.'
'What do you think?'

choices.label: I pity the ones that are bound.
choices.desc: Gluttony & Wrath Advantage check. Pass to level up currently deployed Identities

pass.text:
'Really?'
'What should we do? We'll be revolving together on a track that goes on for thousands of light years.'
'If you pity them...'
'And if I'm just revolving on someone else's track...'
'I suppose we're all pitiful things.'
pass.result_text: All Deployed Identities gain 2 Levels

fail.text:
'Right.'
'It's so hard.'
The things bound to the tracks begin chirping affirmatively.
'Shut up!'
'You're the ones that bound yourselves to me!'
'No, you pulled me in!'
The bound things and the binding thing begin bickering.
There is no hope for a reconciliation.

choices.label: I pity the one that binds.
choices.desc: Gluttony & Envy Advantage check. Pass to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
'Right. I wanted to be lighter.'
'But look at this.'
'I'm still expanding because of these things that have bound themselves to me.'
'So... will you alleviate my weight a little?'
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Disk Fragment obtained!

fail.text:
'Wait... there's too much noise... so much chatter...'
'Everyone, shut up, stop binding yourselves to me!'
The tracks around the entity grew and grew until its voice was heard no more.

events.name: Dimensional Oxidation Variant
events.story:
It's an empty room of cement.
Yet I can shake off the creeping feeling that something might be here.
Other Sinners scoff at me in disagreement.
There's a switch in the room.

choices.label: Hit the switch.
choices.desc: Gain a Charge E.G.O Gift depending on the result of the following choice
choices.story:
Upon hitting the switch, the room's light went out.
In the complete darkness, a sizzling figure appeared.
This can only be seen in the absence of light as it moves in opposition to light.
But that doesn't mean it can see light, either.
It was being projected onto the mind.
I realize that it cannot and should not be contained in spectrums of light.
This resides in a different dimension, so it can only be felt and seen through it.
What will you do?

choices.label: Reach out to touch it.
choices.story:
The Sinner's hand that reached out—or was offered, perhaps—melts without melting down.
The hand they had was lost, but a hand from the other dimension has promptly replaced it.

choices.label: Leave the room.
choices.desc: Select to gain a Charge E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
Although nothing else happened as we left, I found something on my neck.
Night vision goggles.
These should be handy in case we walk into pitch-black environments.

choices.label: Leave without pressing the switch.
choices.story:
We decided to leave the room, ignoring the presence.
"See, I told you there's nothing!"
Someone told me off, and I couldn't come up with a rebuttal, so I decided to stay quiet.

events.name: Doomsday Calendar
events.story:
The blocks are turning, interlocking and noisily grinding against one another.
The entity changes shape with every offering from surrounding clay dolls.
Sometimes its blocks rotate, and sometimes chunks of its red flesh shrink and stretch.
Something falls to the ground from its endlessly distorting form.
One of its blocks fell out of place, pushed out amidst the constant change.
Even the clay dolls stop making their offerings, confused. They stare at the block.

choices.label: Pick up the block.
choices.desc: Wrath & Lust Advantage check. Pass to gain a Rupture E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
[Sinner] walks past the clay dolls and stands before the entity.
The Sinner picks up the block and attempts to fit it into an opening, but the entity's form is too different now. There is no place for the block.
Click. Clack.
The faint noise grows gradually clearer.
It's the sound of interlocking, turning blocks.
[Sinner] looks up at the threateningly intensifying noise.
The disc is now the deep, dense color of the night sky, shimmering with light.
[Sinner] quickly retreats from this ominous transformation, gulping with fear.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Shard of Apocalypse obtained!

fail.text:
[Sinner] walks past the clay dolls and stands before the entity.
The Sinner picks up the block and attempts to fit it into an opening, but the entity's form is too different now. There is no place for the block.
Click. Clack.
The faint noise grows gradually clearer.
It's the sound of interlocking, turning blocks.
[Sinner] looks up at the threateningly intensifying noise.
The disc is now the deep, dense color of the night sky, shimmering with light.
[Sinner] quickly tries to retreat from this ominous transformation, gulping from fear…
but the clay dolls all grab onto [Sinner] in dull, hypnotic movements, trapping the Sinner there.
Only after shaking them off could [Sinner] retreat to safety.

choices.label: Don't pick up the block.
choices.story:
No need to get so up close and personal with this monstrous thing.
We leave the block on the ground and vacate to find a different path.

events.name: Dream-Devouring Siltcurrent
events.story:
The voice speaks.
'Yes. The deep sea is a dark place.'
'But at the end of that dark path is a light.'
'Because there are things that shine in the dark there.'
'Let's go there.'
'And we'll shine brighter than anything in that dark place.'
'We were all abandoned, yes. But we all had dreams, too. Remember?'
'Well, let's make our dreams come true. Let's sink together into the depths.'
The dim fluorescent lights impaling the entity's back flicker.

choices.label: Say that you will sink together.
choices.desc: Sloth & Gloom Advantage check. Pass to gain a Rupture E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
'Then please, light our path.'
'When the lamp's light fades, when there is nothing but utter darkness...'
'... we'll know we're at the right place.'
'There are lights that can be seen only when there is no other light.'
'There, you will see the color. The color of everything that was once abandoned, blended together.'
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Fluorescent Lamp obtained!

fail.text:
'You still fear the dark, don't you?'
'I know that you will miss the surface, forever out of your reach once this fluorescent lamp dies.'
'So do return once you're ready.'

choices.label: Fix the entity's flickering fluorescent lights.
choices.desc: Sloth & Envy Advantage check. Pass to gain a Poise E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
'I remember. I've always wanted to run across a rolling field of grass under the warm sun.'
'To swim across the vast ocean that I've seen only through pictures.'
'That was my dream.'
'My only dream.'
'Now, if you ever recall a dream in which you wished to twinkle, even as a faint flicker...'
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Endorphin Kit obtained!

fail.text:
The fluorescent light still flickers weakly.
'That's okay. Where we're going...'
'We don't need any light.'

choices.label: Yank out the fluorescent lights.
choices.desc: Win the battle to earn a Rupture E.G.O Gift and a Poise E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
'No. We're not there yet.'
'They can still glimmer on.'
'It must shine and shine down to its last flicker.'
'Give it back.'
choices.result_text: Win the battle to gain E.G.O Gifts "Endorphin Kit" & "Fluorescent Lamp"

events.name: Dreaming Electric Sheep
events.story:
It’s a dark cityscape,
but the buildings are well-lit.
It appears that they are powered
by the massive buzzing cloud at the center.
The cloud has a head and two pairs of legs.
It resembles a sheep.
The “electric sheep” seems to be in pain.
Is it being siphoned of its power?

choices.label: Cut the cables.
choices.desc: Select to gain a Slash E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
The buildings blacked out in an instant.
The electric sheep dashed off into the distance, propelling a thunderous cry.
In the unlit town,
weeps of the lightless fill the air.
A tiny object rests where the electric sheep once was.
choices.result_text: E.G.O Gift Dreaming Electric Sheep obtained!

choices.label: Plug another cable into the electric sheep.
choices.story:
The electric sheep bleats and screams.
As its distressed screech shakes the air,
flashes of light hit the eyes.
The buildings are lit brighter than ever.
Soon, the light from the creature’s cloud dimmed.
Could it be dreaming?
The sheep appeared to have closed its eyes after it fell silent.

events.name: Drenched Gossypium
events.story:
A field of white, yet somehow dark flowers is ahead.
The sky is red, the air windy and bleak.
One giant flower flutters amidst the field.
It resembles a person waving from afar.

choices.label: Approach it.
choices.desc: Run a Gluttony & Lust Advantage check to gain a Bleed E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
As you head for the giant flower,
the smaller ones make way.
They close up their petals as you pass,
as if to bow down in respect.
Once you arrived at the end,
the giant flower drooped low to offer a present.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift White Gossypium obtained!

fail.text:
{{SkillCheck|id=2
|condition=Cumulative Checks Failed < 3
|passtext=You head for the giant flower.
The small blooming ones scuttle and shuffle.
They seem to be staring from all directions.
You feel like you might get lost.
Looking back up,
the giant flower still waves to you.
|passresult=Identities without  take 5 damage!
(Return to previous choice)
|failtext=You couldn’t approach the flower no matter what you tried.
All you could do was gaze at it from a distance.
A sudden wave of nostalgia prompts you to wave.
In an instant, all the flowers went awash with red,
simultaneously turning to face you.
After staring into us for a little while,
their red petals flew at us.
It was like a punishment for making a half-hearted gesture.
|failresult=All Allies without  took 10 Damage!
Win the battle to gain E.G.O Gifts "White Gossypium" & "Tangled Bundle"
}}

choices.label: Wave back.
choices.desc: Win the battle to earn 2 Bleed E.G.O Gifts
choices.story:
You wave out of nostalgia.
In an instant, all the flowers went awash with red,
simultaneously turning to face you.
After staring into us for a little while,
their red petals flew at us.
It was like a punishment for making a half-hearted gesture.
choices.result_text: Win the battle to gain E.G.O Gifts "White Gossypium" & "Tangled Bundle"

choices.label: Ignore it completely.
choices.story:
You look away and continue on your path.
The massive flower begins shaking violently, perhaps in an attempt to catch your attention.
It appears a tad unnatural, a tad unsettling.
You gather the gawking Sinners and escape the field of flowers.

events.name: Drifting Fox
events.story:
An alleyway garbage dump.
Its atmosphere is stuffy and unpleasant thanks to the humidity from the rain.
A pile of old and torn umbrellas sits in a corner.
The umbrellas jiggled.
Looking closer, there’s a large fox underneath.
The umbrellas’ rusted iron blades have firmly rooted themselves in its back.

choices.label: Pull out the umbrellas.
choices.story:
Those umbrellas seem to be causing it pain.
When you pull them out with force, bits of its flesh come off with them.
The fox yelped sharply and gave us a glare.
Then, it smacked you with the umbrella in its mouth.
It seemed to reprimand your attitude of pursuing resolution without forethought.

choices.label: Pet the fox.
choices.desc: Lust & Sloth & Pride Advantage check. Pass to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
Its growl recedes.
You stroke it once more,
and it closes its eyes, pleased.
You stroke it once more,
and it settles on the ground, comforted.
You stroke it once more,
and it shrinks to become a statue.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Sunshower obtained!

fail.text:
When you reach out to pet it,
it growls louder.
When your finger touched its bristled fur,
it jumped, yelping violently.
You try to approach it as it gives you a fierce glare,
but it runs off without turning back.
What else should you have done?
fail.result_text: The Sinner who failed the check takes 15 damage!

choices.label: Take the gathered umbrellas.
choices.desc: Win the battle to earn a Keywordless E.G.O Gift and a Rupture E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
There is a pile of weathered and torn umbrellas. They can no longer stop the falling rain.
There is no way to know why the fox remained buried under the umbrellas, but perhaps removing them all will inspire it to a move to a different spot.
The fox gently holds the old and worn umbrella in its mouth and yips at us, as though it did not want us to take it away.
After a long consideration, we bring back a worn umbrella to the fox's mouth in hopes of letting it bite onto it.
choices.result_text: Win the battle to gain E.G.O Gifts "Sunshower" & "Ragged Umbrella"

events.name: Drunkard
events.story:
The air is thick with steam.
It's not simply gaseous water; the steam's color is brown.
Beyond the veil of steam, you hear a voice.
"Mhm! It's only right to drink straight from the bottle!"
"The ones from the west are good-tasting these days."
"You there! You like booze?"

pass.text:
"Aha, good! Here, have a drink."
It feels as though a hard, burning liquid is rampaging around the body.
"Mmm, I like the way you drink it!"
A steadily floating sensation is followed by the feeling that you're in better shape somehow.
"Feeling the magic at work? This is what we call medicinal booze! Go on then, go for another shot!"
After a few more shots of the liquor, we left the place with gleeful steps.
pass.result_text:
The Selected Identity healed for 20.
Cost 100 gained

fail.text:
"Aha, good! Here, have a drink."
It feels as though a hard, burning liquid is rampaging around the body.
"Hey… You alright?"
A sudden nausea is followed by the view slowly turning to the right.
"A real shame… It's such a good drink… but I guess your body doesn't agree with it. You should stop drinking it."
Trying to hold the eyes and head that were starting to spin faster, we left in a hurry.
The way out might have been accompanied by bumps and slams into walls, but even that blurred out of memory.

choices.label: I don't.
choices.desc: Select to gain a Tremor E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
"Pfeh! You only hate it because you haven't had a taste of the good ones~ Here!"
It's met with a staunch refusal.
"Seriously…? You won't drink this precious stuff?"
Still rejected.
"Tch… My mood's all dampened now."
It placed the bottle of alcohol down, and walked back into the veil of steam.
choices.result_text: E.G.O Gift Blood, Sweat, and Tears obtained!

choices.label: I don't know how to live without alcohol.
choices.desc: Run a Sloth & Gluttony Advantage check to gain an E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
"Oho! Then here, have a drink."
[Sinner] began chugging the strong liquor.
It's uncertain whether [Sinner] really likes to drink, or is simply trying to indulge the entity.
"Hot damn, looks like the hooch's finally found its match!"
"Y'know what's better than neckin' the whole bottle?"
Something chucks a huge barrel of liquor toward us from beyond the thick miasma of steam.
We barely managed to catch the barrel. A lively voice booms in our direction.
"A keg stand!"
pass.result_text:
E.G.O Gift Wobbling Keg obtained!
Cost 100 gained

fail.text:
"Oho! Then here, have a drink."
[Sinner] began chugging the strong liquor.
It's uncertain whether [Sinner] really likes to drink, or is simply trying to indulge the entity.
"Hot damn, looks like the hooch's finally found its match!"
"Y'know what's better than neckin' the whole bottle?"
Something chucks a huge barrel of liquor toward us from beyond the steam.
The abruptness of that aggressive throw completely caught us off guard; without a soft landing spot, the barrel shatters against the ground.
"A keg sta— Aw, what the heck! Y'know how precious that barrel was?!"
"Bah! At least take the barrel splinters with you. It's got a pretty strong, top-notch aroma of its own."
fail.result_text:
E.G.O Gift Angel's Cut obtained!
Cost 100 gained

events.name: Explorer on a Bereaved Road
events.story:
A lone signpost stands atop a snowy mountain.
A closer inspection revealed that it was, in fact, not a signpost.
Yet it functions as a signpost.
Stiff corpses point to various directions with their frozen arms.
What awaits at the end of the paths these fingers point to?

choices.label: North, to where the burst-open arm points.
choices.story:
At the end of the path is an ashen village, burned to the ground.
Most buildings are in ruins, as though this village had once been an epicenter of a great explosion.
The snowstorm carries with it a burnt scent.
A cabin stands out amidst this ashen ruin buried under ash and snow.

choices.label: Investigate.
choices.story:
You find a boiling pot inside the cabin.
Many must have perished in the cold, having failed to find this cabin.

choices.label: Walk past it.
choices.story:
The cabin is completely buried by an avalanche.
The cabin, which was the only recognizable structure in this village, is completely gone from sight.

choices.label: East, to where the warning hand points.
choices.desc: Gain a Sinking E.G.O Gift depending on the result of the following choice
choices.story:
There is a dark cave.
Terrifying shrieks emanate from the cave. A cacophony of horrible screams.

choices.label: Investigate.
choices.desc: Select to gain a Sinking E.G.O Gift.
choices.story:
There is a compass there that keeps spinning, unable to find a direction.
The screams stop as soon as you pick up the compass.
choices.result_text:
All Allies lost 20!
E.G.O Gift Broken Compass obtained!

choices.label: Walk past it.
choices.story:
The lost ones' screams continue to echo.
One may assume that they know the way... but there's no telling directions in this endless field of snow.

choices.label: West, to where the broken hand points.
choices.story:
A flowerbed appears past the snowstorm. It looks rather out of place.
Maybe this can be a place of respite.

choices.label: Rest a little.
choices.story:
After taking a brief respite, you notice that the frost had dwindled somewhat.
The path forward is unclear... but let's keep moving anyway.

choices.label: Walk past it.
choices.story:
The path ahead is an endless blizzard.
A respite like the one you saw earlier will not be easy to find.

choices.label: Turn back.
choices.story: We decided to ignore the signpost of hands and walk past it.

events.name: Faelantern
events.story:
In the middle of a quiet and peaceful forest, a delicate tree branch is placed.
A small fairy with a green glow sits atop it.
Saying no words, the fairy waves at us, inviting us to come over and take a break.
It looked like it was smiling, and it might have been dancing.

choices.label: Take a momentary break.
choices.desc: Gain a Sinking E.G.O Gift depending on the result of the following choice
choices.story:
The fairy waves to bring us closer.
It seemed to be guiding us to a more comfortable place. Or maybe that was what we wanted to believe.
Our feet were hurting from the long journey.
What will you do?

choices.label: Get closer.
choices.desc: Win the battle to earn 2 Sinking E.G.O Gifts
choices.story:
The fairy's smile stretches into an eerie grin.
The strangeness didn't need to be pointed out for everyone to share the same sentiment.
Even though we knew we shouldn't trust things by the looks, we still fell for it.
We'll have to pay the price for it.
choices.result_text: Win the battle to gain E.G.O Gifts "Midwinter Nightmare" & "Eldtree Snare"

choices.label: Leave.
choices.story:
Noticing the hesitation, the thing we wanted to believe was a fairy takes no time to charge at us.
We barely managed to avoid fatal injuries, but still felt betrayed.

choices.label: Move on without resting.
choices.desc: Select to gain a Sinking E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
We can't get careless and stop here.
Tree branches came at us trying to stop us from going, but we narrowly dodged them.
We've learned the real meaning of the fairy's gesture.
"No such thing as free gifts," someone mumbled.

choices.label: Take a break where you're standing.
choices.desc: Select to gain a Sinking E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
You ignore the beckoning fairy and take a short break where you stand.
As you gather yourselves to continue on the journey, you realize that several branches had grown in the premises, trapping you in.
Luckily, you managed to snag a piece of the trap as you hacked your way out of the wall of branches, but...
... now you're even more tired than you were before. So much for that break.
choices.result_text:
All Allies took 12 damage! 
 E.G.O Gift Eldtree Snare obtained!

events.name: Fairy Gentleman
events.story:
The cavern is full of smells, good and bad.
“Been a while since I had visitors! I oughta give you a right treat.”
“Plum outta luck for eatery, I’ve already had all the food.”
“Straight as you can see, this glass o’ fairy wine is all I have.”
“Would ya care for a drink?”
A thick, slimy hand makes its offer.

choices.label: Nod.
choices.story:
The glass smells awful.
It stinks like a moldy shoe
sprayed with some flowery air freshener.
The limbs of fairies float in the liquid.
“Help yourself!”

choices.label: Share it with everyone.
choices.story:
The glass is rather large for just one person.
You decide to share it with everyone,
and slowly sip your portion.
An unpleasant texture tingled your throat,
but it was surprisingly tasty otherwise.
choices.result_text:
All Allies heal 15.
Identities with  heal 10.

choices.label: Let one person drink it all.
choices.story:
You had the thirstiest one drink it all.
It apparently tastes pretty good,
but they kept heaving.
There’s an odd, bothering feeling in their throat.
They also complained that the bits of fairy flesh are bitter.
Their thirst was quenched,
but it might have only been replaced with another problem.
choices.result_text:
The Ally with lowest HP heal 40.
The Ally with lowest HP lose 10.

choices.label: Shake your head.
choices.desc: Select to gain a Tremor E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
You turn down the possibly cordial offer.
“Really now? No need to hold back.”
The green blob swallowed down the contents in one gulp,
not bothering to ask you twice.
“Well, can’t have a visitor leave empty-handed.
Why don’tcha take this glass at the very least?”
Looking into it,
you still find the green substance inside.
There’s no way at all to tell what it drank.

choices.label: Slap away the hand.
choices.desc: Win the battle to earn 2 Tremor E.G.O Gifts
choices.story:
The glass in its thick hands clatters to the floor,
spilling fairy limbs and green fluid everywhere.
'Some visitors you are! How rude!'
The mouth on the blob's abdomen splits open and spews sour fluid in our direction.
choices.result_text: Win the battle to gain E.G.O Gifts "Green Spirit" & "Sour Liquor Aroma"

events.name: Fairy-Long-Legs
events.story:
Damp and slippery, this is the emerald forest.
A green rain was pouring down, seeming quite sticky.
You see someone next to you holding a large piece of grass like an umbrella.
'Oh dear, I'd advise against being hit by this rain.'
'Come on, get under this umbrella, all of you.'
'If you stand in the rain, you might melt down head first.'

choices.label: Go under the umbrella and wait until the rain stops.
choices.desc: Win the battle to earn 2 Poise E.G.O Gifts
choices.story:
'What do you say, it's so cozy under this umbrella, isn't it?'
'This damn rain robs me of all my food every time.'
'I'm glad you could be kept savory at least.'
'Oh, you're concerned that the rain melts things? Hahaha, of course not. The rain would heal you, rather.'
'Then why did I say that it does, you ask?'
'I mean, if you were exposed to that rain... I'd have to go through the extra trouble of peeling off the silky smooth integument with my own hands.' 
'But thankfully... This spares me the bother.'
It finished talking, making a wide smile for its happiest occasion.
The rain was letting up.
choices.result_text: Win the battle to gain E.G.O Gifts "Four-leaf Clover" & "Emerald Elytra"

choices.label: Weather the rain and leave the place.
choices.desc: Gluttony & Gloom Advantage check. Pass to gain a Poise E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
Declining the offer, we pressed on in the rain.
While running, you noticed something in your hand.
Perhaps it's the serendipity of staying out of that umbrella.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Four-leaf Clover obtained!

fail.text:
'Oh dear... They're being spoiled...'
The tall fairy runs at us with jovial motions, holding the umbrella still.
It reveals a concealed arm stained with blood. It was running in a hurry, and the long arm is stretched toward us, trying to snatch us by the neck.

events.name: Forsaken Employee
events.story:
Tang- Tang- Tang-
The sound of plastic crashing is accompanied by the sloshing of a liquid.
It looks like something that used to be an employee of a company.
Its identity is evidenced by the now-worn formal outfit and the employee card.
The card is almost too battered and contaminated to recognize.
Wearing a box filled with Enkephalin on their head, the employee rams it into what looks like the door to a containment unit.
A rubber O-ring is worn around their neck. Could it be there to prevent Enkephalin from spilling?

choices.label: Cut the ring.
choices.desc: Run a Gloom & Envy Advantage check to gain a Charge E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
The O-ring snaps rather easily. It might have been weakened by age.
"Kff, kurgh..."
As Enkephalin pours out of the box, we face the person bloated and drenched with the substance through the glass window on the box.
Knowing that it is no longer human, sympathy causes a hand to be offered.
"Put it away."
It spoke.
"This was the only choice I had. To survive..."
"We were buried here with no hopes of rescue. We've been abandoned."
"I... We shoved our heads into Enkephalin so that we can endure the time."
The explanation is then followed by resentment.
"Why are you trying to save us after all this time? I want nothing more than to dip my head into that green water right now!"
Its face was full of anger, it ran off with the empty box still on its head.
All that it left was a small employee card and the guilt of doing what shouldn't have been done.
pass.result_text:
The Selected Identity lost 30!
E.G.O Gift Employee Card obtained!
Cost 50 gained

fail.text:
Was the ring sturdier than it seemed, or was it the lack of skill?
The blade kept bouncing off the slippery O-ring...
"Brgrrgh..."
And the submerged thing pushed you away and ran off.
Did it prefer to stay like that?
All it left was a small employee card.

choices.label: Don't cut the ring.
choices.story:
Tang- Tang- Tang- The ramming at the door and the sloshing continue.
I keep watching and listening.
A more attentive hearing reveals that the sounds have a rhythm. Perhaps there is delight to be found in it.

events.name: Four-hundred Roses
events.story:
This flower was once a rose that could have been tiny and beautiful.
But now, the blood it holds gives off a cruel smell.
Drinking and growing giant, it sucked in blood that overflowed from a spring.
Without an end.
It greedily gobbles up the stream of blood with its branched roots.

choices.label: Plug the spring to stop it from drinking blood.
choices.story:
The spring was blocked so that it can't drink the overflowing blood.
However, it's an unfair action for the rose.
The rose wasn't responsible for causing the spring to overflow.
It simply took root here because it liked blood.
Now that the source of its favorite thing is gone, it will try to take our blood.
choices.result_text:
All Allies took 24 Damage! 
 All Allies lost 16!

choices.label: Break the spring's entryway to let more blood out.
choices.desc: Select to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
When the spring's entryway was broken, the blood that must've belonged to someone in the past flows like a waterfall and onto the rose.
As if overjoyed, the rose waves its roots and lies in the pool of blood.
Like that, the rose drooped low and sank into blood.
At the center, a small flower bloomed.
Could this be its reward? We carefully picked it up.

choices.label: Feed it the blood of the Sinners
choices.desc: Select to gain a Bleed E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
What is the nature of the blood that fills the spring? Who—or what—is it from?
Instead of feeding it that mysterious blood, I decide to feed it blood of the Sinners.
The bloodsteeped rose extends its petals, yearning for our blood nevertheless.
The rose drinks the blood of the Sinners, and a smaller flower blossoms next to the base of its stem.
Perhaps it is giving us a gift in return for our blood. I carefully pick up the flower.
choices.result_text:
E.G.O Gift Millarca obtained! 
 All Allies took 24 Damage!

events.name: Funeral of a Dying Butterfly
events.story:
An alleyway of black and white.
The single streetlamp lighting the path makes the scenery all the more hazy.
Someone is standing in the light.
Pipipipip-
The device in the Abnormality's hand sounds an alarm.
'The results of the job interview for the big company I had last month are out today.'
'Everyone in this street prepares for exams and interviews.'
'They wait for the results to be announced, staking all they have on them, and once they're told they failed, they go far away and disappear.'
'So I changed my head; I'd like to fly away even if I don't make it.'
'Will you check the results for me?'
The device displayed a message that it didn't pass.
'What does it say? Did I pass?'

choices.label: Tell the truth.
choices.desc: Select to gain a Charge E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
'So I failed'.
The coat it held in one hand falls to the ground.
At the same time, the plastic bag in the other hand begins to rustle.
'It's actually fortunate, I figured I'd fail.'
'Where do we go when we die, I wonder?'
'Will there be a flower bloomed at our last destination?'
Right after that, the butterfly on the head flew into the sky, and the empty body collapsed to the ground.
And the head that must have belonged to the collapsed body rolled out of the bloodied bag.
It's such a heavy husk that the pupa left behind.

choices.label: Say that it passed.
choices.story:
'Thank you, I should get going now, the orientation is probably starting soon.'
It spoke, wearing the coat it was holding in one hand.
'I won't need this anymore.'
And the butterfly walks away to carry pollen.
We can only wish that at least a small beam of sunlight shines over its destination.

choices.label: Try to console them.
choices.desc: Gloom & Pride Advantage check. Pass to gain a Sinking E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
[Sinner] tries to comfort the Abnormality by saying that it will pass next time.
I also quickly add that what really matters is the will to pass…
… and even if it fails again, there'll always be a different path.
'You share such kind words to a stranger.'
'Right. I'll try again, and I'll make it this time.'
'But even if I don't… should I continue to live on, I'm sure I'll stumble across another opportunity. A different path.'
'Thank you.'
Fluttering butterflies dance around us, forming a line of butterflies before following [Sinner]'s shadow.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Cantabile obtained!

fail.text:
[Sinner] interrogates the Abnormality, suggesting that maybe it just didn't do enough to prepare for the interview.
I also quickly tried to add that what really matters is the will to pass…
… but the Abnormality is already casting a downward gaze, beaten down from [Sinner]'s brutally rational advice.
'I'm not looking for an advice right now.'
'No, actually, I don't think your advice will be of any comfort to me, now or later.'
The streetlight dies, and shadow fills the space.
I can no longer feel the Abnormality's presence.

events.name: Golden Grip
events.story:
Could these five appendages protruding from the urn be a palm?
Or is it a naked person who put their head into the golden urn?
What did this person see in the urn to cause them to shove their face into it? 
As if that wasn't enough, the whole body turned into a hand that tries to grasp everything it can.
If it finally takes hold of everything in the world, will its grip loosen at last?

choices.label: Remove the head from the urn.

pass.text:
Trying to lightly remove it is like brushing off dust
Is an affront to the greed that refused to dissipate even after shoving the head into it.
There was no choice but to watch as the hand reached out.
pass.result_text:
The Selected Identity took 10 Damage!
Cost 50 gained

fail.text:
We thought we pulled it out, but couldn't move forward.
Seeing it grasp at coattails until the end, you're sapped of strength, bound by the dreadful tenacity.

choices.label: Hug and shake the giant body.
choices.desc: Gluttony & Pride Advantage check. Pass to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
To hug is to embrace another.
The fingers that were stretched to grasp things clasp with another's appendages for the first time.
Between the quietly laced appendages, there was a warmth of blood beginning to circulate.
Like that, the rigid greed loosens.
pass.result_text:
Cost 50 gained
E.G.O Gift Golden Urn obtained!

fail.text:
It seems the basic manners of clearing sweat from the hand before extending it for a handshake were neglected.
Your hand slipped, and the emptied palm wriggles as if to seek another left hand to grasp.
However, it no longer tries to recklessly grab things, seemingly fulfilled by the attempt.
fail.result_text:
The Selected Identity took 15 Damage!
Cost 20 gained

events.name: Handshake of Handshakes
events.story:
Sounds of heavy rocks scraping against each other.
What looked like palms are made of black rocks.
At the tip of the fingers attached to the palms are smaller palms and smaller fingers.
It reaches out with the hand of the hand.

pass.text:
To shake hands... is to share the solitude.
The hand was neither warm nor supple, but you held onto it for a long, long time.
Hoping that this little gesture has filled its hands, its loneliness, even a little.
pass.result_text:
Cost 50 gained
All Allies healed for 15.

fail.text:
Its hands are already full of handshakes.
Your mere offer of one handshake is of no import to this being.

choices.label: Push the hand away.
choices.desc: Pride & Envy Advantage check. Pass to gain a Charge E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
The true desire of its countless handshakes is a senseless one.
So even the hand that requests an endless stream of handshakes must learn to sometimes let it flow past it.
Because we must all one day return with nothing in our palms.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Wrist Guards obtained!

fail.text:
Something left scratch marks on your hand.
Wounds left by loneliness.
It was born out of an ephemeral moment, yet the wound will last awhile.

events.name: Have You Become Strong
events.story:
This place is brimming with the high-pitched screech of metals and industrial machine hammers slamming into something.
Following the clamor led us to what looks like a plastic toy model of a factory.
This smoke-fuming factory of mysterious products churns on and on.
A large octagonal screw tumbles out of the factory.

choices.label: Take it.
choices.desc: Select to gain a Charge E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
We picked up the massive octagonal screw.
There's no reaction from the factory even as we get further and further away.
It continues to churn and spew fumes as though to say that it has no need of the screw.
choices.result_text: E.G.O Gift T-1B Octagonal Bolt obtained!

choices.label: Leave it there.
choices.story:
We stood there for a while, waiting to see what might happen. The screw eventually rolled its way back into the factory.
Was it a part of the factory, or was it the very thing that the factory produces?
Though there was no way for us to know for sure, I could tell that the metallic noises coming from the factory sounded a tad more coordinated.

choices.label: Throw the screw into the factory.
choices.desc: Win the battle to earn a Charge E.G.O Gift and a Tremor E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
We picked up the massive octagonal screw, but it doesn't seem to be particularly useful.
I tossed it back inside, and it clanged harshly against a metal object.
After a brief pause, something bursts out from within the factory with a deafening crash.
"WArNiNG! WaRniNG! InTerFEre?! ReTaLiATe!"
choices.result_text:
Win the battle to gain E.G.O Gift T-1B Octagonal Bolt!
Win the battle to gain E.G.O Gift Made-to-Order!

events.name: Headless Ichthys
events.story:
There is an indent on the earth, filled with water.
Something that lies within is constantly making ripples on its surface.
A closer approach revealed a headless fish swimming in that shallow puddle.
Its splashing movements are spirited, despite the glaring lack of a head.
Is it twisting its body from pain?
Or is it merely glad to be swimming in water?

choices.label: Splash around together.
choices.story:
I fell chest-first into the puddle and splashed around with the fish.
Some Sinners joined in and splashed around together.
We all felt a little better, for some reason.

choices.label: Pop its sac.
choices.desc: Win the battle to earn a Bleed E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
The blood-filled sac of that fish must be causing it pain.
Perhaps it can splash around more comfortably without that big sac of blood weighing it down?
I ask the Sinners to pop its blood sac, but the fish turns aggressive and advances toward us upon hearing my order.
All that splashing around most likely had little to do with its blood sac.
choices.result_text: Win the battle to gain E.G.O Gift Ruptured Blood Sac!

events.name: Heavenly Commander's Scribe
events.story:
A giant lizard-like thing with the cold skin of a machine stands before us.
Its long tail, shaped like the human hand, bends in all directions before straightening to point at me.
"The heavenly commander is who I serve."
"It is the duty of the commander's servant to follow commands."
"Tell me what you command."

pass.text:
I command death to it.
"...Your command is understood. A great sense of purpose was detected in your voice."
"The command shall be carried out."
It disappeared after the short reply.
Soon enough, a loud noise rang from a distance.
...Then, the body felt lighter and invigorated.
pass.result_text: All Allies healed for 24.

fail.text:
I command death to it.
"...Your command is understood. However-"
"I do not detect any sense of purpose in your voice. You are speaking without knowing why the command is to be made."
"You will be punished for giving meaningless commands."
Before a word could be said, the hand on its tail comes forth.

pass.text:
I command life to it.
"...Your command is understood. A great sense of purpose was detected in your voice."
"The command shall be carried out."
It disappeared after the short reply.
Soon enough, brisk steps could be heard.
As the footsteps went over the head, a shining thing fell from above.
...Could this be their thanks?
pass.result_text: Cost 60 gained

fail.text:
I command life to it.
"...Your command is understood. However-"
"I do not detect any sense of purpose in your voice. You are speaking without knowing why the command is to be made."
"You will be punished for giving meaningless commands."
It took away the glowing things that had been collected.

choices.label: Don't command anything.
choices.desc: Gloom & Pride Advantage check. Pass to gain a Sinking E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
I did not give it any command.
"None can go without giving any commands."
Watching its tail sway menacingly, we hastily waved our hands and gave an excuse.
"...Your command is understood. I now see what you meant."
Could something we said have elicited a response?
"The command shall be carried out."
It placed a mysterious object before leaving.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Thorny Path obtained!

fail.text:
I did not give it any command.
"None can go without giving any commands."
Watching its tail sway menacingly, we hastily waved our hands and gave an excuse.
"You have additionally committed the crime of neglecting to command even yourself."
"The crime of neglecting that obligation will be punished rightly."
The improvised excuse didn't work, and the tail was swung our way in a large arc.

events.name: Heavenly Executor's Scribe
events.story:
It records right and wrong.
Its job is to record the judgement of the one above.
It does not assess what it writes.
To lay down judgement is not a secretary’s role.
The scribe silently presented an emerald tablet.

choices.label: Read the tablet.
choices.desc: Run a Gluttony & Pride Advantage check to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
It’s a tablet of unknown letters.
While you’re unable to fully grasp it,
a few words stand out.
Judgement…
Retribution…
Punishment…
You also see some combinations of words
that might have deadly consequences if you try to understand them.
When you look back up, the scribe gives a short nod
before soaring into the sky.
pass.result_text:
The Sinner who passed the check takes 5 damage! 
 E.G.O. Gift Lithograph obtained!

fail.text:
It’s a tablet of unknown letters.
You feel you might be able to understand it.
It just needs a little more effort.
A little more… Just a little more…
When you come to your senses, the being has disappeared.
You were left alone with the tablet in your hands.
fail.result_text:
The Sinner who failed the check takes 25 damage! 
 E.G.O. Gift Lithograph obtained!

choices.label: Scrape out the letters.
choices.story:
You use a sharp implement to scrape out the letters.
It stood still, giving no response.
It seems to accept your judgement as valid.
At one point, the tablet began to break,
and eventually crumbled into dust.

events.name: Highway Devotee
events.story:
There's a long, wide road ahead.
You see someone with a sign at the entrance.
'This is a one-way road. No U-turns.'
'If you take this road, it'll take ages to come back here.'
As the person claims, the road seems to be stretched almost endlessly into the distance.

choices.label: Go back the way you came instead of taking the main road.
choices.desc: Select to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
'The road might seem vacant right now, but take it for a bit and you'll see. That the road is jam-packed with cars, and you'd be slowed to a crawl.'
'Turning around is not an option, either. There would be a car right behind you by the time you decide to go back.'
'You made the right choice.'
It lightly smiled.
The sign was still held high for whoever might enter this highway in the future.
choices.result_text: E.G.O Gift Milepost of Survival obtained!

choices.label: Take the byway instead of taking the main road.
choices.story:
'Not a good choice.'
'Everyone is following the same rules to traverse this road. In any case, this highway is for everyone.'
'I assure you, the god of traffic won't forgive cheap shortcuts like that.'
As we took the byway, I had to endure the piercing glare on my back for a good while.

events.name: Hollowed Man
events.story:
A person stands in the square.
They look this way, waving an arm.
The cavity in their head may be an eye,
or a bullet hole.
If it is, it must have been the work
of the revolver in their hand.
That person points the gun at you.

choices.label: Approach them.
choices.desc: Select to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
You don’t fear the pointed gun.
Even if they were to pull the trigger…
It doesn’t matter how many times the hammer strikes.
You know the bullet will hit that person’s head.
In the blink of an eye,
the gun aimed at their own temple,
and soon fired.
The person was gone,
leaving an ashen coat on the floor.

choices.label: Duck and cover.
choices.story:
Oncoming fortune will slip past if you avoid it.
Misfortune you thought to avoid will come back to bite you.
Although the gun was pointed at their head,
the bullet came your way.
choices.result_text:
Identities without  take 20 damage!
Identities with  heal 20.

events.name: Hurting Teddy Bear
events.story:
A teddy bear suffers from having nails lodged into its body.
The bloodstains decorating it
are a telling sign of all the time it spent in pain.
The holes where its eyes should be are empty.
Nothing but dry red marks remain inside.
In spite of that, it stands with its arms wide,
endeavoring to fulfill its duty of giving hugs.

choices.label: Remove the nails.
choices.desc: Lust & Gloom Advantage check. Pass to gain a Bleed E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
You removed the nails from the teddy bear.
Bloody pus pours out of the holes.
Once the plush had finished its copious exudation,
only a dark cavity remained within.
It is an empty void.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Grimy Iron Stake obtained!

fail.text:
The nails plunged into its chest were buried deep.
Nothing would budge even after several tugs and pulls.
It’s all firmly lodged in the cotton base.
The plush looks down at it
as if nothing is happening.
Perhaps it’s unable to feel pain.

choices.label: Bandage its wounds.
choices.story:
You applied bandages
to the holes in its chest.
Blood leaks and saturates them.
The wound still seems sore.
You gave it some extra dressing,
making sure that it’ll last a good while.
choices.result_text:
All Allies healed for 10.
Identities with  heal 10.

choices.label: Embrace the Sinners.
choices.desc: Win the battle to earn 2 Bleed E.G.O Gifts
choices.story:
Hugging that teddy bear would be very difficult, given all those nails protruding from its body.
Instead, I decide to hug the Sinners one by one to see how it reacts.
Most Sinners push me away, taken aback from the sudden awkwardness…
… but the teddy bear impatiently stomps its feet, apparently jealous.
Perhaps what it wanted was affection, after all?
The teddy bear rushes toward us, as if it's asking us to hug it as well.
choices.result_text:
Win the battle to gain E.G.O Gift Grimy Iron Stake!
Win the battle to gain E.G.O Gift Layered Bandages!

events.name: Hydra
events.story:
This place resembles the operating room of an abandoned hospital.
A few clangs and rumbles later, a blinding white light flashed the eye.
The light is soon blocked by a being with multiple heads.
Those heads were all wearing masks and surgical caps, facing me at the same time.
'Ah, a patient's here.'
'Right, a patient's here.'
'The patient needs curing.'
'Where?'
'The abdomen?'
'The legs?'
'No, the head. The frontal lobe.'
Each head gives its opinion as they prepare for surgery.

choices.label: Accept the surgery.
choices.desc: Run a Sloth & Gloom Advantage check to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
'It will be the newest patient of our hospital.'
'This is a small garden and haven.'
'They will be on good terms with the other patients.'
'It won't hurt; the anesthetics are plenty.'
We suffered many wounds on the way here, big and small.
Whether it's the body or the mind, wounds need to be treated in time.
If it's allowed to develop into a scar, it will not go away for certain.
pass.result_text:
The Selected Identity healed for 20.
The Selected Identity lost 30!
E.G.O Gift Painkiller obtained!

fail.text:
Even the most skilled doctor can't turn every operation into a success.
So it's natural for failure to be present even with multiple of them.
What can we do about it?
We'll have to bear the pain and limp our way back, as we always have.
fail.result_text:
The Selected Identity took 30 damage!
E.G.O Gift Painkiller obtained!

choices.label: Break the light and run away.
choices.story:
With a shattering noise, the room went dark.
Having spent all its life under the intense white light, it was helpless against a mere blackout.

events.name: Kqe-1j-23
events.story:
This dark place might be a factory.
A sharp mechanical noise zips through the air.
Illuminating eyes are fixed on you.
A robot slowly approaches.
It appears to be incomplete, as suggested by the bare wires protruding with each movement.
Is that leakage antifreeze, or blood?
While you were wondering, the terminal on its chest flashed to life.
Looks like you can write something.

choices.label: Write [Hello].
choices.desc: Select to gain a Burn E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
The robot lifts both arms with some struggle.
The terminal prints out its words:
A smile is displayed on the terminal,
but in the robot’s gestures, you feel a plea for help.
choices.result_text: E.G.O Gift Pinpoint Logic Circuit obtained!

choices.label: Ask for an explanation of the “town”.
choices.story:
The robot tilted its head.
While unable to lift and tilt its head in the other direction,
it displays a question on the screen.
It seems to want an answer.

choices.label: Confess the truth.
choices.story:
The terminal suddenly opened upward,
and a mechanical arm popped out, trying to snatch something from you.
As you duck and twist out of the arm’s way,
it gradually grew faster.
You hurriedly made your escape,
fleeing the robot’s unending rampage.

choices.label: Tell it that you took a tour.
choices.story:
After printing those words,
the robot stood still for a while.
Just when you started to wonder if it was broken,
the terminal flashed.
After that, it kept throwing up complicated words
on a blue screen.

choices.label: Write [Goodbye].
choices.story:
The terminal’s light goes red, and warnings start to blare.
The robot shakes intensely as if in pain.
A single word filled the whole screen moments before the robot exploded into bits of metal and gore before your eyes.
choices.result_text: Identities without  take 15 damage and 15 damage!

choices.label: Write [Dumbass].
choices.desc: Win the battle to earn a Burn E.G.O Gift and a Charge E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
The robot begins to tremble uncontrollably.
Not out of fear, no—out of anger.
Maybe it knows what the word written on the terminal means?
The robot begins wildly flailing its arms.
choices.result_text: Win the battle to gain E.G.O Gifts "Pinpoint Logic Circuit" & "UPS System"

events.name: Monkey Tree
events.story:
A resentful tree stands among a desolate plain.
The place has an air of umbrage.
Something feels discordant about the sky.
