You note one twig growing out of the tree like an arm.
Though the tree is unmoving, it seems to want something.

choices.label: Sprinkle water.
choices.desc: Select for a chance to gain a Rupture E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
You sprinkled water around the tree.
It soon boiled away,
as it would on a cast-iron skillet.
You don’t see any change in the tree.
Maybe the twig has become livelier?
No matter how you look at it, it’s rather hard to tell.

choices.label: Give it more water.
choices.desc: Select for a chance to gain a Rupture E.G.O Gift

pass.text:
With another go and look around,
the tree appeared more alive than you first thought.
The foreboding aura disappeared at some point, too.
Could you really have quenched its age-long thirst?
The twig rustled and came to you.
It gave you a handful of gifts
as a token of its gratitude.
pass.result_text:
All allies heal 30 and 30
E.G.O Gift Thunderbranch obtained!

fail.text:
You try pouring more water,
but it still vaporizes in an instant.
Maybe it’s started to absorb less?
Another close look still shows no changes.

choices.label: Snap the twig.
choices.desc: Select to gain a Rupture E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
You snapped the arm-like twig that had been bothering you.
A cacophony of dreadful screams struck your ears.
You noticed that the screams were coming from the twig.
As much as it creeps you out, you get a strong feeling
that you will suffer terrible consequences if you throw it away.
choices.result_text:
A random Identity without  loses 10
E.G.O Gift Thunderbranch obtained!

choices.label: Snap the twig.
choices.desc: Select to gain a Rupture E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
You snapped the arm-like twig that had been bothering you.
A cacophony of dreadful screams struck your ears.
You noticed that the screams were coming from the twig.
As much as it creeps you out, you get a strong feeling
that you will suffer terrible consequences if you throw it away.
choices.result_text:
A random Identity without  loses 10
E.G.O Gift Thunderbranch obtained!

events.name: My Form Empties
events.story:
A bell occasionally tolls in the red room.
It’s a heavy, subduing sound.
The statue is chanting something.
You’re unable to recognize its words.
But, you feel that whatever it is,
is not a joyous thing.
There’s a brass ring on the statue’s finger.

pass.text:
You close your eyes and focus on the sound.
You are able to pay closer attention to what it is saying.
It is uttering its thoughts in the form of a mantra.
It is emptying itself by verbalizing its thoughts.
In that case, you will absorb its teachings.
Fill yourself with the sermon it has gouged out.
While it has forgotten itself, you gain a clearer sense of self.
pass.result_text: All allies heal 15.

fail.text:
You close your eyes and focus on the sound.
What is it saying?
This thing is uttering thoughts.
Empty oneself by verbalizing one’s thoughts.
Expel everything within so that nothing remains.
That is the statue’s way of forgetting the self.
You sense yourself disappearing as well.

choices.label: Take the brass ring.
choices.desc: Lust & Gluttony Advantage check. Pass to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
You picked up the ring in its hand.
It remains perfectly still, maintaining its chant.
This statue won’t move,
no matter what happens around it.
Though it stays forever still,
and the tone of its mantra remains consistent…
You knew one thing.
Its chants are imbued with a curse.
pass.result_text:
E.G.O Gift Bloody Gadget obtained! 
 Identities without  take 10 damage!

fail.text:
You tried to pick up the ring in its hand.
Its wrist suddenly spun in a circle.
You reach for the ring again,
but that wrist keeps moving, denying you.
It could be conveying that you are unworthy.

choices.label: Place a coin.
choices.desc: Win the battle to earn a Keywordless E.G.O Gift and a Sinking E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
You place a coin before the grand Buddha Mūrti.
With the ceaseless chanting gone, only the hollow echo of the bell bounces off the walls of the chamber.
Perhaps the touch of secularity in the face of an emptying form has triggered something.
Those taken by the Buddha Mūrti begin to swarm the void the chanting left behind.
choices.result_text: Win the battle to gain E.G.O Gifts "Bloody Gadget" & "Grandeur"

events.name: Nymph
events.story:
It gives blood to those who need it.
The only blood it has to give is its own.
Even those who don’t need a transfusion
are bled dry with scissors, forced to accept.
Thus, its road is filled with receivers that need blood.

choices.label: Accept blood.
choices.desc: Select to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
It plucked a blood bag and handed it to us.
Seeing us accept it,
it quickly hung an empty one in its place.
The bag fills with blood at an uncanny pace.
Having fulfilled its duty, it strolled past us.

choices.label: Donate blood.
choices.story:
Its endless donation of blood
was a pitiful sight.
We decided to share some of our own.
GIGIGIH.
When we expressed our willingness to donate,
it cried as if to signal its displeasure.
Then, it raised a pair of scissors,
chopping off the arm of the one who volunteered their blood.
GIGIGIH.
Then, it pulled out one of the tubes connected to its body,
plugging it into the cut wound.
An arm soon grew back.
The spilled blood stayed on the floor.
choices.result_text:
All Allies healed for 12.
Identities with  heal 15.

events.name: Overdue Assignments
events.story:
I see a room filled with papers.
It was probably once spacious, but now, it's cramped thanks to the stacks of papers with scrawls occupying much of it.
Something swims this way in this sea of papers and documents.
The serpent made of papers slithered up to talk to me.
'This is hell.'
'The hell for homework and assignments all the people in the world have neglected to do.'
'People may think an assignment that they didn't get to finish is no big deal... How little do they know.'
'The assignments wanted to be completed and submitted on time!'
'This is where the overdue and forgotten assignments end up.'
'They're then plummeted into a hell where they suffer for eternity, forever left procrastinated.'
'How cruel students are! You may have seen us as little tasks you could put off, but we wished nothing more than to be handed over!'
'Let me ask you this... Have you ever been behind with an assignment? It doesn't matter if it was by unavoidable circumstances, tell me if you have abandoned any poor assignments!'

choices.label: Say that you haven't put off any.
choices.desc: Select to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
'Good, good. Keep up the good work!'
'Keep making sure no assignments are left behind.'
I feel a strong sense of trust.
If I ever get assignments to take care of, I'd best submit them before the deadline.

choices.label: Say that you have.
choices.story:
'No wonder, as soon as you arrived here...'
'This pile of papers has been rustling furiously at you. Can you hear them?'
'This is your name written here, isn't it?'
You hear faded papers clamor, unsure if they're delighted or infuriated to see you.
There is no choice but to face the errors of your past.

events.name: Pagoda Veneration
events.story:
Clackle-
Clackle-
A mountain made out of holed rocks. It's shrouded with white fog.
Rocks can be heard clashing with each other.
There's a being with long limbs and stone-like skin piling up a tower.
Could it be a stone tower being made for a wish?
Or is it a cairn that is burying someone alive?

choices.label: Place a stone over the tower.
choices.desc: Sloth & Gloom Advantage check. Pass to gain a Poise E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
Did you place it with sincerity?
Then the wish may come true.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Stone Tomb obtained!

fail.text:
To place your wish on top of countless others...
The hand needed to be lighter and more cautious.
One stone falls to the ground, followed by many others.
The price for ruining the tower won't be light.
fail.result_text: The Selected Identity took 15 and 25 damage!

check.prompt: Who will bring down the cairn?

pass.text:
You see something buried beneath the collapsed cairn.
We may never know why it had to be buried discreetly.
pass.result_text: Cost 70 gained

fail.text:
As the stones collapsed in such a short time,
You attempted to avoid them to no avail, being pressed under their weight.
Now you were the one trapped in the stone cairn.

events.name: Paper Chairman
events.story:
“Who are you, and what brings you here?”
A piece of paper rustles.
“Well, you came just at the right time for me;
I’ve urgent business that needs doing.
Won’t you take the job?”
It held out another piece of paper with lousy letters written on it.
Unfortunately, you can’t make sense of these lines and dots.
“How’s about it? You up for it?”

pass.text:
“You kent that?”
The paper flapped in disbelief.
“Well, if you really insist, knowing what’s coming…”
It took a step back, dousing itself with coffee.
Just then, a paper soldier
suddenly rushed at you.
“You shouldn’t underestimate paper’s integrity.”
Before you could respond to the peculiar voice,
the soldier attacked you.
pass.result_text: All Allies took 10 damage!

fail.text:
“You sure you read it right?”
“With a body like that, you can’t fulfill the contract written here!”
The paper sprayed coffee on the floor,
spewing insults.
Before we could make any excuses,
we got kicked out.

choices.label: Shake your head.
choices.desc: Lust & Sloth Advantage check. Pass to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
“‘Preciate it. You made the job easier.”
The paper soldiers nearby
start fighting each other.
Sometime later, the defeated soldiers’ bodies are torn,
exploding into paper cranes.
One of the cranes crawls your way.
“Take good care of that piece.”
The satisfied sheet of paper drenched itself in coffee.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Coffee and Cranes obtained!

fail.text:
“That your way of turning someone down?”
Annoyed, the paper crumpled.
“There are basics to proper conversation.
I don’t wish to speak with someone
who can’t respect those basics.”
Before we could make any excuses,
we got kicked out.

events.name: Portrait of a Certain Day
events.story:
This is a corridor of a large, wooden mansion. Its floorboards are ancient.
You can hear creaking noises approaching from a distance. Something walks in this direction.
'My master had a very unfortunate life.'
'I am the butler of this house.'
'Sad, sad things happened here. Many sad things.'
'I still carry with me my master's portrait because no one remembers them anymore.'
'How is it? Can you see it well?'

choices.label: Say that you can't see it well.
choices.desc: Envy & Pride Advantage check. Pass to gain a Sinking E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
'I see.'
'If my master is gone from the painting, the memories... what shall I do?'
'What if... one day... I start doubting that I ever had a master...'
Only the masterless painting remains in the hallway now.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Headless Portrait obtained!

fail.text:
'That cannot be.'
'Look not at the time that is spent, and focus on the painting.'
'The face of my master, who had to go through so much.'
You had to sit there and stare at the painting for a while.

choices.label: Say that you can see it well.
choices.desc: Envy & Sloth Advantage check. Pass to level up currently deployed Identities.

pass.text:
'Is not the face of my master so graceful? The eyes, so deep. The gaze, so noble.'
'Thank you. I am starting to remember. The face of my master, reflected in your very own eyes.'
pass.result_text: All Deployed Identities gain 2 Levels

fail.text:
'If you really can see my master's countenance... that's not the face you'd be making.'
'And those unimpressed, lifeless eyes aren't the look one would wear upon seeing my master's face.'
We were quickly deemed unwelcome, and were chased out of the mansion.
fail.result_text: All Allies without the  took 10 damage!

choices.label: Say that it's too dusty to tell.
choices.desc: Gloom & Sloth Advantage check. Pass to gain a Poise E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
'Oh my...'
[Sinner] offered to clean the dust off the portrait.
The entity tried to back away from us, flustered...
... but the Sinner reached out anyway to gently dust the portrait and clean it until its surface was spotless.
'Now that you've cleaned the portrait, I am certain you can see it well.'
'Thank you. My master... will be happy, too.'
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Recollection of a Certain Day obtained!

fail.text:
'Oh my...'
[Sinner] marched toward the entity to dust off the portrait.
'You will NOT so rudely and callously lay your hands on my master's portrait!'
Perhaps we were too rash in our approach.
The entity shouted at us, saying that we were 'rude, rowdy guests', and kicked us out of the mansion.
fail.result_text: All Allies without the  took 10 damage!

events.name: Recurring Faith and Promise
events.story:
We come across two bizarre lifeforms standing on either side of a table set with an old roulette wheel. 
 "Care you test your luck? A prize awaits those who have fortune's favor." 
 "Lose. No prize. Leave if don't want." 
 The old roulette wheel they point at is inscribed with strange symbols. 
 We cannot make sense of the symbols, but something about them keeps drawing our gaze. 
 What should we do?

choices.label: Spin the roulette.
choices.desc:
Choose to gain or lose Cost 
 (Only selectable with 50 or more Cost.)

pass.text:
We cannot take our eyes off the spinning roulette wheel. 
 The roulette comes to a stop, just short of slipping past the yellow slot. 
 "Oh, that's a win!" 
 "You. Lucky."

fail.text:
We cannot take our eyes off the spinning roulette wheel. 
 The roulette comes to a stop, just short of slipping past the blue slot. 
 "You. Bust. Scram." 
 "Too bad, that's a bust. And that means no prize money for you." 
 We were thrown out of the chamber, empty-handed.

choices.label: Stop.
choices.story:
"Wise. Choice." 
 "So you prove yourself a coward." 
 We escape the chamber.

events.name: Resident of Metropolaris
events.story:
Welcome. This is the city of peace, Metropolaris.
No one can be hurt here at Metropolaris.
The entity called it a city... but there's nothing here.
The only recognizable being here is the entity that greets you without even looking in your direction.

choices.label: Ask if there are any other citizens.
choices.story:
'There are. Somewhere.'
'But you can't meet them.'
'Citizens of this city can never see nor touch each other. That is our revolutionary policy.'
'If no one can touch another...'
The entity adds, a tinge of pride in its words.
'... then no one can hurt another.'

choices.label: Walk past the city.
choices.story:
'Do as you will.'
'Time does not heal all wounds. It only turns them into scars.'
'You will one day remember us and miss us. You will miss our world where no one can hurt or be hurt by anyone.'

choices.label: Stroll this city where there is no one and no one to meet.
choices.story:
The city was infinitely vast, and no one even dares to breathe as we walk.
And its citizens are forever at peace.

choices.label: Ask to shake hands.
choices.desc: Gain a Charge E.G.O Gift depending on the result of the following choice.
choices.story:
'What are you doing?'
'Reaching out with your hands... to touch is a taboo.'
'If our hands touch, I'll be hurt. You'll be hurt too.'
'And one day... everyone will be hurt.'

choices.label: Try to shake its hands anyway.
choices.desc: Select to gain a Charge E.G.O Gift.
choices.story:
'NO NO NO NO NO NO!'
'NOTHING CAN HURT ME. DON'T LOOK AT ME. DON'T GIVE ME YOUR HAND. DON'T HURT ME.'
The entity cries as it disappears. It leaves something behind.
choices.result_text:
E.G.O Gift Material Interference Force Field obtained! 
 All Allies lost 20!

choices.label: Back off and withdraw your hand.
choices.story:
It didn't even have a hand to shake ours.
You lower your confused, lost hand.

events.name: Rising Ashes
events.story:
A cry rings out in the ashen wilderness.
From the distance, an undulating wall of fog rises.
Its shape resembles a human.
Yet, it could be a spirit or a ghost taken form.
Its mouth, agape as if crying in despair, is completely dark.

choices.label: Walk into the mist.
choices.desc: Wrath & Lust Advantage check. Pass to gain a Burn E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
We carefully walked into the dense fog.
Eerie howls surround us.
It was no longer possible to tell which way was forward.
All we could do was keep walking.
The fog cleared at one point,
and a trinket of endless ashen flow awaited us.
We then realized it wasn’t fog we walked through.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Ashes to Ashes obtained!

fail.text:
We carefully walked into the dense fog.
Eerie howls surround us.
It was no longer possible to tell which way was forward.
All we could do was keep walking.
After a while, even advancing began to feel terrifying.
The fog grows thicker.
It feels as though you will no longer be able to escape.

choices.label: Look the mist in the eye.

pass.text:
You stared into the eye-like things.
Your piercing gaze met the song
of endless despair and wailing sockets.
You then realized that it wasn’t fog you were facing.
What you thought were its eyes and mouth
all turned out to be tricks played by shadows.
When you figured out that its howl was merely whistling wind,
all of it vanished.
pass.result_text: All Allies healed for 15.

fail.text:
You stared into the eye-like things.
It returned the gaze, singing endless despair.
Just as you felt that the figure seemed to have grown,
we were engulfed by the fog.

events.name: Rose Hunter
events.story:
This is a dark forest, full of fog and vine.
An apple, rotten but still moving, runs to me in a hurry.
"Please help me, I need to hide."
"I'm just a poor, tiny apple… Cursed and thrown away."
Before I could answer, the apple hid its small body behind my leg.
"……."
Amidst the fog of the viney forest, the clop of a horse is heard.
It's a giant horse made of vines.
Mounted on it was a being with the head of a rose.
The vine horse stands before me and lets out heavy breaths that reek of green grass.
"I am on the hunt for someone. It needs to be taken care of urgently."
"What I am looking for is an apple that will become a princess, not knowing its rightful place."
"It must have passed this way. Do you know what direction it has taken?"

choices.label: Tell the truth.
choices.desc: Wrath & Envy Advantage check. Pass to gain a Rupture E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
"Ah..."
You moved your leg to the side and pointed below, to the trembling apple's dismay.
"Hah, got you."
"No! I don't want this!"
"Stories must follow their natural courses. This is the flow we shall follow, so accept it."
It picked up the tiny apple and put it on the back of the horse.
"This won't be needed anymore. It's not the most flattering gift, but I will give it to you as a reward for letting me know."
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Barbed Lasso obtained!

fail.text:
Just as you thought you'd tell the truth, you felt a tremor at your leg.
"...You were hiding it."
You try to deny it, but it was already angered.
"Get lost!"
It lashes at you viciously with a thorny snare...
And when you managed to dodge the onslaught, you found that the snare caught the rotten apple.
"This is the natural course. Accept it."
Having caught the apple, it ran off in the other direction.

choices.label: Say that you don't know.
choices.desc: Win the battle to earn 2 Rupture E.G.O Gifts
choices.story:
"You do not know? I see. If that is the determined trajectory of this tale, then it must be followed."
"Yet... how would you explain that thing hiding behind your leg?"
The entity asks us with an air of hostility. It must've noticed the apple trembling behind my leg.
After a quick deliberation with the Sinners, I decided to try lying to the entity.
"... You say that it is a pomegranate, not an apple? Do you take me for a witless imbecile? "
"Enough talk. Make way, or suffer my wrath!"
The entity charges at us, the lasso swinging wildly above its head.
choices.result_text:
Win the battle to gain E.G.O Gift Barbed Lasso!
Win the battle to gain E.G.O Gift Thorny Rope Cuffs!

choices.label: Point it in the wrong direction.
choices.desc: Pride & Envy Advantage check. Pass to gain a Rupture E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
When I point to some random, incorrect direction, the entity approaches and looms over me.
In place of its head was but an eyeless rose, but... I could still feel its piercing gaze.
"Such tale is your wish? Then I hope you have it within you to be responsible for your own words."
"Should you come across the apple in your journey, I bid you to bind it with this lasso."
The entity tossed a lasso at us before gallopping off astride the great steed of vines.
Only when could we no longer hear the sound of galloping hooves did the apple slowly emerge from behind my leg, shuddering.
"C-can you please get rid of that lasso? Please... I'm scared."
The apple pleaded, but some Sinners disagreed.
The lasso may come in handy.
I denied the apple's request, wound the lasso on my arm, and continued onward.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Thorny Rope Cuffs obtained!

fail.text:
When I point to some random, incorrect direction, the entity approaches and looms over me.
In place of its head was but an eyeless rose, but... I could still feel its piercing gaze.
"Such tale is your wish? Then I hope you have it within you to be responsible for your own words."
"Should you come across the apple in your journey, I bid you to bind it with this lasso."
The last sentence must've scared the apple—it flinches.
The entity noticed the hem of my pants shake slightly and erupts into a furious bellow, swinging the lasso.
"BEGONE!"
The apple tries to hurry away from the entity, but it's soon snared by the barbed lasso.
After fastening the apple to the vine horse's leg, the entity gallops into the forest.
The apple's desperate cries for help slowly fades away from us.

events.name: Shock Centipede
events.story:
“This centipede is capable of discharging a high voltage.”
That’s what the sign attached to the tank says.
Is this an aquarium, or a laboratory?
The segments of the creature spark each time they move,
suggesting faulty connections.
There are two buttons at the tank.
One is shaped like a thunderbolt, while the other looks like a waterdrop.

choices.label: Press the lightning-shaped button.
choices.desc: Select to gain a Rupture E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
“Apply stimulation and pain to the centipede
to increase the discharge intensity.”
So writes a message above the buttons.
That seems to be what this one does.
When you pressed it, a mechanical sound played for a short while.
An item that resembles a battery casing
dropped through the chute below. 
The centipede isn’t moving.

choices.label: Press the droplet-shaped button.
choices.desc: Envy & Wrath Advantage check. Pass to gain a Charge E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
“Apply stimulation and pain to the centipede
to increase the discharge intensity.”
So writes a message above the buttons.
When you pressed the drop-shaped button, the tank was filled with water.
The centipede twists its body as if in some sort of dance.
It didn’t seem to be out of joy.
pass.result_text:
Speed +1 for this battle 
 E.G.O Gift Uncapped Defibrilator obtained!

fail.text:
“Apply stimulation and pain to the centipede
to increase the discharge intensity.”
So writes a message above the buttons.
When you pressed the drop-shaped button, the tank was filled with water.
The centipede twists its body as if in some sort of dance.
You watched the centipede’s tail scratch the tank’s surface. 
The glass cracked and shattered to pieces immediately afterward.
The electrified water cascaded all over us.
fail.result_text: Identities without  take 15 damage and 15 damage!

choices.label: Rapidly mash both buttons.
choices.desc: Win the battle to earn a Rupture E.G.O Gift and a Charge E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
“Apply stimulation and pain to the centipede to increase the discharge intensity.”
You ignore the warning sign and start rapidly mashing the two buttons.
The machine begins ejecting battery casings from its body.
Water fills the tank, and the centipede begins to writhe.
The glass window on the tank fractures for a moment—then out comes the electrified water and the centipede.
choices.result_text: Win the battle to gain E.G.O Gifts "Standard-duty Battery" & "Uncapped Defibrilator"

events.name: Sign of Roses
events.story:
What does this signboard say?
It hangs itself on a tree, trying to make its content known.
Its desperation is almost pitiable.

choices.label: Pick a rose.
choices.desc: Gluttony & Envy Advantage check. Pass to gain a Rupture E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
You pick a rose out of it.
With closer examination, you notice
that it has an intestinal texture.
What is a flower-shaped organ for?
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Crown of Roses obtained!

choices.label: Unravel the brambles.
choices.story:
As you try to untangle the vines,
sallow bits of flesh fall off.
The thorny brambles you thought were a source of constricting pain
ironically had been keeping the body together.
The body writhes as its flesh falls apart.
Blossoms of flowers sprawled on the ground substitute its screams.
choices.result_text: One random Identity without  takes 10 damage!

choices.label: Knock down the sign.
choices.desc: Win the battle to earn a Rupture E.G.O Gift and a Bleed E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
There's no way to tell what it's so desperately trying to share.
But it's unlikely that it points to anything of worth.
You order one of the Sinners to knock down the sign, just in case it gets you lost later.
... The brambles suddenly begin to gather, raising the sign back up. Roses begin to bloom in all directions.
choices.result_text: Win the battle to gain E.G.O Gifts "Crown of Roses" & "Respite"

events.name: Skin Prophet
events.story:
Candles quietly burn away.
Scribbling sounds are all that fill the air.
A trio of eyes takes turns glaring
into a grand tome, bound in skin.
You can’t tell what it’s referencing,
or if there is any deliberation in its writing;
hands are busy nonetheless.
Yearning for destruction and doom,
it writes and writes and writes.
You feel the passages it’s writing may be prophecies for someplace and sometime.

choices.label: Snuff out the candles.
choices.desc: Select to gain a Burn E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
You hushed the candles, one by one.
The space grew darker,
but its hands won’t stop.
The only light left
was on the quill it held.
Even that was snuffed by our breaths.
Then, the whole place went dark.
All that’s left
is the pen in its hand.
choices.result_text:
E.G.O Gift Fiery Down obtained! 
 Skill Final Power -1 at the start of the combat phase.

choices.label: Peek at the book.
choices.result_text:
Identities without   take 20 damage! 
 Cost 60 gained

choices.label: Gather the candles together.
choices.desc: Win the battle to earn 2 Burn E.G.O Gifts
choices.story:
You gathered the scattered candles to a single spot.
The flames suddenly rise high when a gust of wind whooshes past the gathered candles.
@#$!!@#*!
As soon as the pillar of flame touches the book, the three eyes all whip around to glare at the Sinners.
choices.result_text: Win the battle to gain E.G.O Gifts "Fiery Down" & "Melted Paraffin"

events.name: Sleeping Bag of a Bygone Day
events.story:
Shhhh-chk.
Shhhh-chk.
There is a skeleton, making ominous, labored noises.
There is a shadow of somebody in its spine.
Does the shadow breathe, one must ponder.

choices.label: Pick up a respirator and put it in its mouth.
choices.desc: Pride & Gloom Advantage check. Pass to gain a Poise E.G.O Gift

pass.text:
A single breath was more than enough.
For the first time in their existence, they could breathe in and out as much air as they wanted without hurting.
Every living second of their life was pain. No one will ever understand that.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Nebulizer obtained!

fail.text:
Blowing air into its mouth was to no avail.
There was a coughing noise not long after.
Perhaps liberation is nigh.

choices.label: Watch.
choices.story:
The shadow in the skull was nothing but a lingering feeling.
Resentment. Penance. All of it, to no avail. So it fades away in silence.
All that remains is a hollow skull.
choices.result_text:
All Allies healed for 10.
All Allies with the  healed for 15.

events.abnormality: Sleeping Bag of a Bygone Day

events.name: Sleepyhead
events.story:
The long-necked thing has a hammer on its head.
It resembles a toy somewhat, but this one is undoubtedly an Abnormality.
The way it stood, it looked like it could fall from its precarious stature at any moment,
And as suspected, its head slammed the floor, unable to withstand the weight of the steel.
The flask on its back may have to be filled for this hammer to be lifted back up.

choices.label: Fill it with a Sinner's blood.
choices.desc: Run a Lust & Gloom Advantage check to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
The flask on the back fills with red.
Sated by the weight of the blood, the head lifts from the floor and points to the ceiling again.
pass.result_text:
The Selected Identity took 10 Damage! 
 E.G.O Gift Voracious Hammer obtained!

fail.text:
Alas, more blood was spilled than expected.
You fall to the floor as if you became the hammer.
Sated by the weight of the blood, the head lifts from the floor and points to the ceiling again.
fail.result_text:
The Selected Identity took 25 damage! 
 E.G.O Gift Voracious Hammer obtained!

choices.label: Have the Sinners forcibly grab the head and the flask to lift it up.
choices.story:
Soon after being lifted, the head shook for a moment before dropping again.
*wham*
Its neck had no semblance of strength, tilting downward without aim.
Leaving the hollow ringing of the floor and the broken neck behind, we moved on.

events.name: Smokey Old Man
events.story:
The room's ceiling was too high. Yet it was so narrow that it felt like a tight space.
Something that looks like an old person sits on a chair, staring into a painting on the wall. It didn't so much as flinch.
A dark, thick, and sticky smoke crawls out from behind it.
Perhaps that's what loneliness might look like if it's visualized.
"What's a young one like you doing in this room."
It spoke to us, its eyes still glued to the painting. How long has it been aware?
"Are you interested in hearing my stories?"

choices.label: Say that you're willing to hear the stories.
choices.desc: Gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift depending on the result of the following choice
choices.story:
"My stories are so long, young ones like you might end up being as old as me while hearing one."
"These long, long stories... They only end in one way: I wanted to go home, but couldn't make it."
It says with a long sigh, like it was wishing to let go of a longing.
"Get this painting off the wall and take it with you. It'll be better off that way."
What will you do?

choices.label: Take the painting.
choices.desc: Select to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
When we removed the painting from the wall, a creeping feeling weighed on our backs.
We turned around to find that much more of the sticky smoke was gushing out than before.
"It was my only home..."
The way it tried its utmost to hold its tongue, its murmur almost felt like a wail.
When we tried to put the painting back...
"No! Don't do that... Just take it. I've made up my mind."
It shouted.
"Take it and leave, before I take your home. Now."
...We followed its plea and left the place in a hurry.

choices.label: Leave the painting be.
choices.story:
It wasn't looking at the painting purely to admire it.
It transcended gaze and became an obsession, or attachment in a way.
We decided against taking the picture.
"Why... Why do you leave it..."
Although its voice was shaky, there was a hint of relief in it.
"Yes... This is my home I can't return to. It saddens me just to look... but if I can't do even that, my mind wouldn't be at ease."
"While it pains me that you chose to leave the painting be... I must thank you. Take this instead to help with your travels."
It handed us a glowing thing, and went back to staring at the painting.

choices.label: Leave without listening.
choices.story:
"......."
Without replying, we tried to walk out of the room and close the door.
In that instant, the desolate smoke could be seen surging and bursting through the narrowing gap.
I quickly closed the door shut... but couldn't stop a cloud of smoke from leaking through.

events.name: So That No One Will Cry
events.story:
You hear the quiet flickering of candles.
In this cramped room, you find a wooden doll, standing.
Are the talismans filling the room for a wish?
Does this wooden doll wish for anything?

choices.label: Remove the doll’s talismans.
choices.desc: Select to gain a Rupture E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
After you removed them, the doll knelt.
Is it begging you not to take it,
or is it a gesture of gratitude?
You won’t know for now.

choices.label: Remove the wall talismans.
choices.desc: Sloth & Wrath Advantage check. Then, maybe gain a Poise E.G.O Gift depending on the subsequent choice

pass.text:
When you detached one,
a candle in the room suddenly began to burn.
With another detached,
the fire burns even brighter.
The wooden doll begins
to tremble ever so slightly.
Is it right to continue?
Is this what it wishes for?

fail.text:
Nothing happened.
The doll would simply stand there, producing small noises.
The talismans in hand have turned into sticky blood,
slipping between your fingers.

choices.label: Remove all talismans.
choices.desc: Win the battle to earn a Rupture E.G.O Gift and a Poise E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
We start removing every single talisman in the room.
The wooden doll paces here and there, uneasy and anxious.
We ignore it and continue removing the talismans.
As we were almost finished with removing the talismans, the wooden doll stands before the Sinners as though to tell them that enough is enough.
choices.result_text: Win the battle to gain E.G.O Gifts "Talisman Bundle" & "Old Wooden Doll"

events.abnormality: So That No One Will Cry

events.name: Spider of Marriage
events.story:
It’s a spider’s nest made of thorny vines
and filled with flowers, perhaps once used for celebration.
The buds appear to be filled with someone’s blood.
The bride and groom crawl between them.
As they scuttle around,
blood seeps out of their hands and feet.
It appears that they change sides
before the bottom one loses too much blood.

choices.label: Pick a flower.
choices.desc: Select to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
When you plucked a blood-soaked flower, it expressed joy.
Those congratulatory flowers
may be acting as a curse now,
preventing them from leaving the nest.
Those flowers were not planted or raised by the couple.
The petals were feeding on
someone’s naïveté.
choices.result_text:
Identities without  take 5 damage!
Identities with  heal 15.
E.G.O Gift Prejudice obtained!

pass.text:
When you tore out a vine, it screamed.
As much as it hurts them, it’s still their home.
Those who ruin it will be detested.
It may not be wise to approach the ache so rashly.
pass.result_text: All allies lost 10!

fail.text:
You tried to remove the vines,
but they were tougher than they seemed.
After a few tugs pass,
you only have scratches on your palms.
They were quietly watching the affair.
They looked both upset,
or afraid in some way.

events.name: Spiral of Contempt
events.story:
Blood pours from above; the land of gold lies beyond.
The spiral ahead loudly screeches.
It must have reached this depth after burrowing and burrowing.
Although it has no eyes, it creaks to face you.

choices.label: Keep looking.
choices.story:
You continue to stare at its peculiar movements with yearning eyes.
It feels as though spirals of spikes are digging into your head.
From the excavated brain, geysers of hatred and contempt erupt.
It’s as if those feelings were inside you all along.

choices.label: Avert your eyes.
choices.desc: Wrath & Gloom Advantage check. Pass to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
The whirling spiral slows down,
showing forgiveness.
Reverence for a being of no significance
is followed by a slight self-contempt.
The spiral descended out of sight in the meantime.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Perversion obtained!

fail.text:
Though you turned away, it keeps pulling you in.
As if drawn by a magnet,
all eyes are pulled toward it.
The spiral has not forgiven.
Contempt for your hesitation to show the courage not to face it takes over.
You feel the encroaching spiral slowly dig its way in.
fail.result_text: The Sinner who failed the check takes 12 damage and 8 damage!

choices.label: Seize the spiral.
choices.desc: Win the battle to earn a Keywordless E.G.O Gift and a Bleed E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
A Sinner seized the creaking spiral.
Unpleasant, metallic noise whirls, and its contemptuous gaze radiates in all directions.
The spiral strikes at the Sinner's heart.
choices.result_text: Win the battle to gain E.G.O Gifts "Perversion" & "Awe"

events.name: Star Luminary
events.story:
Stars glow blue in the dark.
Looking at them up close, those weren't actually stars.
It was a person waving their arms with blue marbles in their hands.
"These are stars."
The person claims what they're holding are stars.
As if they read my mind and knew what I was thinking.

pass.text:
We told the person that the things in their hands are just blue marbles.
"Is that so. That's how you see them."
The person remained tranquil as if they knew you'd tell them that.
"If you want to look at them that way, then I say go ahead."
They disappeared, gently waving the marbles.
It feels like we've learned an important truth.
pass.result_text:
All Allies healed for 33.
Start the next battle with +2 E.G.O resources of all affinities

fail.text:
We told the person that the things in their hands are just blue marbles.
"You sound pretty confident. Do you know what a star is in the first place?"
"Speckles of light floating in the dark. That's what we call stars."
They gently wave the marbles in their hands.
"Stars are what's in your mind. So these blue marbles are stars."
As the upright manner of speech was about to be etched on the heart, they disappeared, telling us they'll 'go to the blue star'.
It feels like we've learned an important truth.
fail.result_text:
All Allies healed for 33.
All allies have +2 Skill Final Power for the next battle

choices.label: Agree that they are stars.
choices.desc: Lust & Pride Advantage check. Pass to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
Seeing the numerous hues of light in them, they ought to be stars for sure.
"I want to return to the blue star someday."
Could that be where they come from? Will I be able to go there?
"Do you think so too? That you want to return to that place."
You nod. You have no idea where it may be, and you certainly aren't from it, but you feel the urge to go back to it.
"Then I'll give this to you."
They handed over a blue star they were holding and disappeared.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Tomorrow's Fortune obtained!

fail.text:
Seeing the numerous hues of light in them, they ought to be stars for sure.
"Right, but..."
Their tone suddenly changes to a melancholic one.
"I know. That I can't go back to it anymore."
"That I'm just waving my arms and emitting the blue glow to become a star myself."
With a whistling noise, it vanished into thin air.
Our heads somehow felt lighter after this.
fail.result_text:
All Allies healed for 33.
All allies have +1 Skill Power for the next battle

events.name: Steam Transport Machine
events.story:
It carries heavy objects without a word.
As it does its work,
the number on the electronic display seems to update.
Machines exist for a purpose.
You feel like you should give it an order.

choices.label: Order it to carry luggage.
choices.desc: Envy & Gluttony & Sloth Advantage check. Pass to gain a Tremor E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
It lifts a nearby object
to carry it from left to right.
The count on its body went up by 1.
Just as you started to wonder if that was it,
the machine replaced one of its vacuum tubes with a new one.
It presented the old one to you,
and naturally, you accepted.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Nixie Divergence obtained!

fail.text:
It lifts a nearby object
to carry it from right to left.
While it was moving the object,
it suddenly came to a halt.
The vacuum tubes in its body suddenly flicker.
After flashing random letters and numbers,
everything shut off.
With its power gone, the object slipped from its hands and fell.
…A few of us were standing in the impact zone.

choices.label: Order it to do nothing.
choices.story:
A purposeless machine is bound to lose
the meaning of its existence, even if it is functional.
A machine whose purpose is to do nothing
will do whatever it takes to achieve its directive.
With a loud boiling noise,
the machine’s body begins to heat, expelling hot steam.
Seeing it glow a dangerous-looking hue,
we quickly escaped the room.

choices.label: Order it to carry luggage faster.
choices.desc: Win the battle to earn 2 Tremor E.G.O Gifts
choices.story:
The machine begins to carry luggage faster and faster.
The numbers on the vacuum tube displays begin to rise rapidly, and so does the steam fuming from its body.
It doesn't take too long for the machine to move all the luggage.
Now that there wasn't anything left to carry, the machine slowly turns in our direction.
One of the Sinners shouts, 'Wait, we're not luggage!' but it falls on deaf ears.
choices.result_text: Win the battle to gain E.G.O Gifts "Nixie Divergence" & "Clockwork Spring"

events.name: Stuck in Heaven
events.story:
A cluster of eyes looks this way.
The thing in the middle has the appearance of a tree branch, but it is human.
Heaven sometimes burrows;
other times, it makes a home in the heart.
Once taken root, that heaven
will only be visible through the eyes of others.

choices.label: Close your eyes.
choices.desc: Select to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
Even with one’s eyes closed, heaven is there.
As long as heaven is lodged in,
there is no way to avert your gaze
from what you wish not to see.
Meaning, you may only see
what it wants you to see.
Even though one’s eyes were closed,
one’s sight remained open.
It will be forever impossible to close.

choices.label: Return the gaze.
choices.story:
You stare into it without blinking.
Its eyes won’t so much as flinch.
Those eyes don’t care if the host twitches in pain.
You are not what the eyes are looking at.
It must be heaven somewhere behind me.
choices.result_text:
Identities without  take 10 damage! 
 Identities with  heal 10.

events.name: Sunset Wayfarer
events.story:
“Look at those butterflies! Aren’t they just beautiful?”
“And gander at that sunset, too!
Really makes you want to go for a stroll.”
“Why don’t you stop for a moment
and take a breather here?”
Something yellow gestures warmly at you.

choices.label: Take a break.
choices.desc: Select to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
“Wasn’t it tiring coming all the way here?”
“Really, check out those butterflies.
Just watching them will warm your heart.”
You looked at the butterflies as the voice suggested.
They indeed fill the heart with a certain warmth.
“Looks like some of them want to tag along!”
A kaleidoscope of butterflies started following you,
even after you left that scenic spot.
choices.result_text:
E.G.O Gift Eclipse of Scarlet Moths obtained!
All Allies healed for 8 HP.
Identities with  heal SP.

choices.label: Ignore it and leave.
choices.story:
“You must be very busy then!”
It made the same gesture as when it first greeted us.
Perhaps it was waving goodbye all along.
“Another time, I suppose!”
choices.result_text: At the start of the turn, heal 10 and 10 (Up to 3 turns)

events.name: The 4th Front of the Smoke War
events.story:
That must be snakes, bugs, or the symbolization of fulfilled peace.
Looking closely, the fence of wire and the countless corpses caught up in it can be seen moving.
Those sacks of flesh entangled in painful ways must be the remains of those who perished in a war fought in the past.
Now, it moves like a living thing, wandering where the Smoke War may have taken place.
The concertina wire was a line crossed between you and me, and a separator.
However, this rusted, bloodstained wire now binds us together and squeezes us so our flesh and eyes meet.

choices.label: Sneak up and remove a part of the wire.
choices.desc: Wrath & Pride Advantage check. Pass to gain a Bleed E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
While it stood still, we carefully approached it.
If we remove a part of it, those bound to it might find momentary peace.
"...!"
Taking off a piece of the wire was surprisingly easy.
However, the flesh lumps show no change at all.
It's as though they are telling us that this won't be remotely sufficient to free them from what they suffered that day.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Smokes and Wires obtained!

fail.text:
While it stood still, we carefully approached it.
If we remove a part of it, those bound to it might find momentary peace.
"...!"
We weren't familiar enough with the wire's structure. The hand twists and gets dragged into the wire in an instant.
"G-Get it out, quickly!"
The arm was pulled out thanks to the help of several people, but it was left severely mangled.

choices.label: Cut the tip of a finger to drop my blood on the wire.

pass.text:
Was it by pity or some kind of sympathy?
Or was it the idea that sharing the pain might reduce their burden?
Drops of blood fall from the tip of the hand and seep into the flesh, little by little.
The thing finally responds, approaching as if to look down on you.
Maybe it saw me as the same as those who perished in the thick fog.
When it opened its mouth with a pitiful look, a glowing object was inside.
It might be a small token of consolation it's offering. You took the object.
pass.result_text: Cost 60 gained

fail.text:
Was it by pity or some kind of sympathy?
Or was it the idea that sharing the pain might reduce their burden?
Drops of blood fall from the tip of the hand and seep into the flesh, little by little.
"...Urk!"
All corpses and bodies bound to the wire scream at once.
The thing begins to rampage in unison.
As I was not part of the war nor I was there to witness it, I cannot associate with or understand them in any way.
It was merely a fit of hasty arrogance.
There was no choice but to flee from the place, leaving the raging thing behind.

events.abnormality: The 4th Front of the Smoke War

events.name: The King in Binds
events.story:
There is an entity bound to an extravagantly ornamented chair.
It appears as though the entity is shooting a stern glare this way.
It tries to say something... but its mouth is bound.
The King on the throne twists and thrashes, trying to approach... but the things that bind drags him away.
The beautiful yet cruel crimson strips of fabric. They pull mercilessly. They are...

choices.label: ... Bandages.
choices.desc: Pride & Wrath Advantage check. Pass to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
Bandages, made to heal.
But he will bleed out as soon as these bandages are undone.
To maintain his shape... he must remain bound.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Grand Welcome obtained!

fail.text:
The wounds bound by the bandages rot away little by little; nothing indicates that they are healing.
They serve only to hide the hideous wounds, not to heal them.
fail.result_text: All Allies without the  took 20 damage!

choices.label: ... Chains.
choices.desc: Pride & Envy Advantage check. Pass to level up currently deployed Identities

pass.text:
Chains, made to imprison.
He will endlessly struggle against the chains to be free.
To regain his authority. To speak the words unuttered, bound by the chains.
pass.result_text: All Deployed Identities gain 3 Levels

fail.text:
It thrashed once, then ceased its movements evermore.
Perhaps it was because you defined the fabric as chains. Or, perhaps they really were bound by chains. No one will ever know.

events.name: Time Duck
events.story:
Whirr-clink. Whirr-clink.
Sounds of sticky, oily clockwork echoes.
It is the sound of each cog indents clicking into each other. It is the sound of flowing streams of water conjoining.
A tired, downcast duck stands before you.
The clockwork whirrs vigorously, but the rabbit appears weary.
... No, perhaps this is a duck.
The Rabbit asks.
'What am I, in your eyes?'

pass.text: This is a duck. The duck's tired, downcast beak is clearly right there.
pass.result_text: Cost 50 gained

fail.text: The answer lacked confidence. The rabbit, which you believed to be a duck, fled.

choices.label: A rabbit.
choices.desc: Sloth & Envy Advantage check. Pass to gain a Sinking E.G.O Gift

pass.text: This is a rabbit. Its long ears doubtless indicate that it is a rabbit.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Melted Spring obtained!

fail.text: The answer lacked confidence. The duck, which you believed to be a rabbit, fled.

events.name: Tomb of Bone
events.story:
This place is like a giant scrapyard.
All kinds of refuse find their way here, only to be burned.
The difference is that this scrapyard collects nothing but bones.
Human bones beast bones and the bones of something that is neither human nor beast
All kinds of bones find their way here.
A faint voice can be heard from the pile, but it is too feeble to be understood.

choices.label: Search to find where the voice is coming from.
choices.desc: Gloom & Gluttony Advantage check. Pass to gain a Sinking E.G.O Gift

pass.text: You find a skeleton amidst the pile of other bones. This may be the one trying to reach you. There's no telling if this is the right skeleton. Maybe you've prescribed meaning to something that just amounts to a pile of bones.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Skeletal Crumbs obtained!

fail.text: You tried your best to find the source of that sound, but it was to no avail. All flesh and hide are weathered away by the sands of time, and all that remains are indistinguishable bones. But the disembodied voice persists still.
fail.result_text: All Allies without the  took 13 damage!

pass.text:
Just a meaningless sound of wind whistling between the bones.
The sound of emptiness. The very same wind that will weave between our bones when we are buried here.
pass.result_text: Cost 50 gained

fail.text:
As we were walking away from the voice, [Sinner] notices something under their feet.
Looking down revealed that we were surrounded by several mounds of bones.

Yet, we soon realize that the whispering is coming from every bone shard surrounding us.
Are they really talking to us, or is this an auditory hallucination caused by the ominous fear prevalent in this place?
We pick up a single bone, but it drags up an entangled strand of bones, piercing, breaking, and enveloping one another, with it.
They are tangled and snarled to the point where it has become impossible to tell what their original shapes may have been.

Spurred on by this unpleasant sensation, [Sinner] left the bone shard and hurried away from the mounds of bones.

events.name: Tomorrow's Expression
events.story:
A thing wearing human skin was dancing in place, clicking and creaking.
It soon spots me.
Clopping like a spider, it talks to me.
"I made this face yesterday."
Fwip-pip. Tap-trrt.
"What face do you think I'll make tomorrow?"
Fwip. Trrt-tap.
"What face should we make?"

choices.label: I think we will smile.
choices.story:
"Smile? Smile? Smile!"
A creepy laughter bursts out, almost indistinguishable from noise.
"I'll smile! I'll smile!"
Krrrt, fwip. Trrt-tap.
Sounds of stiffened skin being stretched, and faces hastily shifting.
Only after all those sounds stormed past, I realized that my skin was taken.
choices.result_text:
All Allies without  took 15 Damage! 
 All Allies with  healed for 20.

choices.label: Don't make any expression.
choices.desc: Select to gain a Blunt E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
"Don't make any?"
"How do I do that?"
"How? How?"
Krrrt, fwip. Trrt-tap.
A hazy racket of confused sounds and rapid spins stirred the air...
"......."
Then, only a leather mask remained where it stood.

choices.label: Cry and cry until you sink.
choices.story:
"Bweeeeh!"
Ear-piercing cries of what felt like countless lives burst forth.
"Waah! Waah!"
When the disorienting cry finally stopped,
It had already disappeared, leaving only weathered minds.
choices.result_text:
All Allies without  lost 15! 
 All Allies with  healed for 20.

events.name: Wailing Coffin
events.story:
A wail fills the forest.
You can’t help but wonder what it’s so sorrowful for.
There’s a coffin in the middle of the woods.
It has been tied with multiple cords and ropes,
in what appears to be a desperate attempt to keep its contents from escaping.
However, the coffin continues to rumble and creak.

choices.label: Open the coffin.
choices.desc: Wrath & Gluttony Advantage check. Pass to gain a Bleed E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
With each rope that’s untied, the wail grows louder.
You feel sympathy for the trapped being.
Undoing the ropes, you begin to weep
along with their wailing.
One undone knot accompanies sorrow.
One undone knot accompanies lamentation.
When the last is released,
you discover that there is no one inside.
Perplexed, you examine the interior,
and find a single, red-jeweled beetle.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Wound Clerid obtained!

fail.text:
With each rope that’s untied, the wail grows louder.
There’s more than one individual occupying the coffin.
Several people are clinging to each other, all crying.
The coffin bursts open, letting them out.

check.prompt: Let’s just go back. Who should lead the way?

pass.text:
The red arms wave in the air,
as if pleading not to be left behind.
But, after another look,
it also seems as if they’re thankful for being left as they are.
Though the wailing hasn’t ceased,
the weeping seems to have softened, just a little.
pass.result_text: All Allies healed for 10.

fail.text:
You disregard the chilling sensation and move on.
However, that feeling would linger,
even after a while of walking.
At one point, you stopped and turned around
to find a hand.
It was attached to an unnaturally scrawny red arm.
It grabbed its speechless victim.
A familiar note was added to the coffin’s wailing.
fail.result_text: The Sinner who failed the check takes 15 damage and 12 damage!

events.name: Wandering Heart
events.story:
Sometimes, the mind wanders.
Where does such a mind end up?
If it had a physical destination,
then it must look like this.
An empty, humanlike statue
is where that mind would decide to settle.
Now, it extends its arms, trying to grab at anything.

choices.label: Reach out to grab its hand.
choices.desc: Select to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
You tried to hold its hand,
but you couldn’t touch it.
It was an illusion—something that shouldn’t be—made visible.
It retracted its arm,
as if it understood as well…
Then, it broke itself,
turning into a small statue.
choices.result_text:
All allies lose 13
E.G.O Gift Phantom Pain obtained!

choices.label: Refuse it.
choices.desc: Gloom & Gluttony & Pride Advantage check. Pass to gain a Tremor E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
You quickly ducked out of its path.
Among the onslaught of the obsessively encroaching hands is a particularly small hand.
You reach out and pull on that hand. The statue ceases to move.
In your hands is an unforeseen, symmetrical figurine.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Mirror Tactile Synaesthesia obtained!

fail.text:
You quickly ducked out of its path.
However, it was no easy task
to avoid its obsessive hands.
A few of them managed to grab and scratch at us.
Though we managed to escape, we suffered a lot.

events.name: Wayward Passenger
events.story:
You see a poor passenger, stranded between dimensions.
Most will never realize that this person ever disappeared.
Well, the transport company would know,
but they’ll simply pretend that the passenger never existed.
Lost and abandoned, tossed out like trash,
having no place left in the City.

choices.label: Point the direction it should go.
choices.desc: Gloom & Sloth Advantage check. Pass to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
As soon as it’s shown where to go,
it runs in that direction.
You notice it dropped something as it began to sprint.
A blue lighter with a Wing’s logo on it.
You heard stories of that Wing
providing its employees with supplies like this.
It would seem that it was an employee of the transport company, not a passenger.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Blue Zippo Lighter obtained!

fail.text:
While you were in contemplation,
it slowly shambled your way.
When you point in a random direction out of panic,
it changes course to follow the instruction.
Moments later,
you heard the noise of metal plates crumpling, and something else ripping apart.

choices.label: Stand still.
choices.desc: Win the battle to earn a Keywordless E.G.O Gift and a Charge E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
It idly stared in our direction.
Then, it began shambling for us, realizing something.
As it drew closer, you were able to identify
that the being was a company employee, not a passenger.
The ID card on its chest gave it away.

"This must be a tavern…"
This bar or an inn is bustling, and its patrons are energetically chattering away. They all seem to be in a rather good mood.
A trio among the crowd is quite boisterously arguing and pointing fingers at each other.
"No, NO! I don't understand why this is even a matter of dispute! A blade is a weapon made for cutting, and the 'right' way to use a blade is to slash with it."
"You don't know what you're talking about! Stab a single point with all your might, and your foe shall surely fall!"
"… You're both wrong. Your half-hearted cuts and stabs won't do anything but piss 'em off. They'll be back on their feet immediately!"
"Smack their skulls with the blunt end—hilt or the scabbard, and knock them down for good! Make 'em too dazed to get up!"
The trio appeared to be talking about something pretty serious, so we'd stopped to listen to their debate…
They suddenly turned in our direction and called over to us.
"You there! Your band can clearly handle your weapons, am I wrong?"
"Answer us. What is the best way to wield your sword?"
"Of course, to slash is the best way to use a blade, is it not?"
What should I say to that?

"I have heard a tale of one such nightly stroll. In this tale, a clueless traveler heedlessly wanders into a brumous haze, and finds himself afore an otherworldly being—"
"AAAGH! Stop, stop it!"
Just as the Sinners began loudly bickering with each other, I realized that there was something hazy standing in our way.
"Is that thing… dancing?"
A mysterious thing, dressed in white, danced gracefully before us with a large blade in hand.
When it met my gaze… or, when I thought it did…

What does it want me to do with it?

We hear a pair of voices as we walk alongside a stone fence. The two travelers are both carrying blades.
"I pity the people here…"
"Well, the decision of a Wing is absolute for its feathers. There is very little they can do about it."
One of them stands out—their clothing sets them apart from the locals. Maybe they're not from around here.
"Still, to allow the Kurokumo Clan to make their way in here? That's too much."
"The Wing cares about naught else but fluttering its wings. All else becomes insignificant."
Sounds like they're talking about the current S Corp.
"More outsiders, I see. How convenient."
The pair stops in their tracks, then turns around to face us.
"The Kurokumo Clan… no. You do not wear their garb. You don't appear to be peasants seeking to make some cash in the chaos of the Backstreets, either…"
"Well, then. What do you outsiders think of the current climate?"
How should I answer this?

"I enjoyed your answer. If you ever find yourself in a conflict with the Blade Lineage, show them this tassel."

To say that what is wrong is right and right is wrong is not wrong,

What is it talking about?

"Is this a tavern?"
We walk into what seems to be a bar of sorts, its guests rowdily drinking and chatting about in groups.
We find a seat to relax, but another group that was sitting nearby approaches us.
"What's going on here? I haven't seen your faces around here before…"
"This is a good day, boys—let this one slide. Don't stir up unnecessary trouble."
"Yes, dame! Of course, dame!"
That's when we realize that they're all carrying swords with them.
Swords engraved with elaborate cloud patterns.
"Did you hear about that new Syndicate that sprang up today?"
"Ah, the… the group that primarily uses spears, right…?"
"Dumbasses. Swords are the most superior form of weaponry there is, the apex of arms. And they use spears instead?
"Let's all be completely honest here, guys. Sure, we're a Thumb subsidiary, but there's just something badass about a sword, huh? Way cooler than fists or guns."
"Good thing we have these fine people here to give us a most fair assessment on the superiority of swords.
We feel their gaze simultaneously turning to look at us.

"Looks like you pissed off my boys. Would it have hurt to pretend to go along with them?"
"I think I'll head out now. Remember what I said earlier—don't start trouble and leave them alone."
"Yes, dame!"
As soon as the person who appeared to be their leader left the room, things became a lot more tense all of a sudden…

The employee, who is already occupied with his work, gets flustered and tries to say something. But it takes him ages to even open his mouth.
The owner pulls out a recorder in a frustrated attempt to communicate, but it doesn't help.
"I just checked the security camera. You've been napping for two whole hours! Explain yourself."

events.name: Yurodiviye Hideout
events.story:
A secret hideout of the Yurodiviye. A Yurodivy is fervently reciting the texts given to them by the Saint.
"We have become nothing but cogs in a machine that exists solely for the industrialists, the bourgeoisie, and the Wings."
"What else, what other human relation remains among the Citizens but the narrow self-interest and heartless bonds created by capital?
"Thus, we shall cast aside the cold, unfeeling metal we call coin; instead, we shall trade our warmth with one another based on our needs!"
"To the haves, the laws of the Nests are shields that protect their privileges; yet, to the have-nots, they are chains that shackle us!"
"Then we shall defy the laws of the Nest! We shall show them the wrath of the have-nots!"
"All that the Yurodiviye have to lose is our chains; all that we have to gain is a world without hunger!"
The Yurodivy suddenly points in our direction.
Looks like we're going to have to say something.

events.name: Factory Laborer
events.story:
Just another busy, busy watch factory.
"!@#$!#$#!$@#$!$#@$."
A man in shiny dress shoes and a clean set of suit, clearly the factory's owner, is shouting at his employees in dirty, oil-gunked work clothes.
Something seems to catch his eye, causing him to glare at one of the employees and scream with anger.
The employee, who is already occupied with his work, gets flustered and tries to say something. But it takes him ages to even open his mouth.
The owner pulls out a recorder in a frustrated attempt to communicate, but it doesn't help.
"I just checked the security camera. You've been napping for two whole hours! Explain yourself."
"F… … … a… … …"
"… … c… … … t…"
"Can't you speak any faster, man?!"
Maybe there's something around here to resolve this situation?",

choices.label: Take a look around the factory.
choices.desc: Gluttony & Pride Advantage check. Pass to gain a Tremor E.G.O Gift

pass.text:
"After looking around and thinking for a moment, [Sinner] noticed that the factory's machine was running at a high speed.
[Sinner] says that, two hours of sleep might bring undue burden on other employees...
and may even have had negative effects on the factory's production lines.
"You have a keen eye for problems."
"Did you all hear that? Stop making excuses and get back to work."
The factory owner glares at the employee, who was slowly descending the stairs, before handing something over to us.
"I was going to give this out as a reward for good performance to an employee of mine, but I don't suppose I shall now. Here, you can have this."
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Silver Watch Case obtained!

fail.text:
[Sinner] expressed confusion that no one, including the employee, seemed to notice that the employee was sleeping for two whole hours. 
"Tsk tsk. This reflects negatively on our factory's image."
"You're fired. Get out."
Something felt off, but it was too late.
The employee very slowly fell to their knees, tears welling in their eyes, but the factory owner did not even bat an eye before turning around and leaving the room.
We were left alone with the employee's slow, excruciating wailing.

choices.label: Take a closer look at the factory owner and the employee.
choices.desc: Gloom & Sloth Advantage check. Pass to gain a Tremor E.G.O Gift

pass.text:
[Sinner] paced between the two of them for a while, before coming to a realization that the lengths of their days were completely different.
In the eyes of the factory owner, who lives eighty-hour days, it may have looked as though the employee slept for two straight hours.
But for the employee, who only lives six-hour days, it must have been a mere nine-minute nap. [Sinner] relays this information.
"Hm. How many hours do you work in a day?"
"F...i...v...e... H...o...u...r...s..."
"Hm, yes. That sounds about right. I'll let this one slide, but be careful not to make the same mistake twice."
With that, the owner walked past the employee.
The employee very slowly bowed at us in gratitude before leaving something in our hands.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Faded Watch Case obtained!

fail.text:
[Sinner] expressed that the employee lives shorter days than the owner.
"And why would that be any of my business?"
"Nine minutes, two hours, it makes no difference. You still decided to sleep in the middle of a workday. You're fired."
Something was wrong—but it was too late.
The employee very slowly fell to their knees, tears welling in their eyes, but the factory owner did not even bat an eye before turning around and leaving the room.
We were left alone with the employee's slow, excruciating wailing.

events.name: T Corp. Tax Collection
events.story:
You find yourself at a random T Corp. street. A Collection Staff is collecting taxes from a citizen.
"Will you be making your payments in time, or in cash?"
"Like I said, we already paid our Time Taxes in full! Besides, three-hundred-million Ahn? That's absurd...!"
"The records state that you have accrued additional Time Tax responsibilities due to the donation gift tax."
"No way. Is this because I gave away my time to those kids in the Backstreets?"
"I only gave them three hundred hours, so how the hell does that suddenly snowball into a three-hundred-million Ahn in taxes?! That doesn't make any sense!"
"Tax calculations in T Corp. are always exceptionally accurate."
The Time Collector strides toward the citizen to neutralize them.

choices.label: Talk to them.
choices.desc: Gloom & Sloth Advantage check. Pass to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
[Sinner] claims that there is something wrong with their calculation.
The other Sinners chime in to say that they should probably get that amount verified. One of them notes that, conveniently, there is a Collections Office nearby.
The whispering crowd begins to grow around the commotion, and the Time Collector eventually gives in.
"Looks like you're not carrying a timepiece."
"I would stay out of trouble if I were you."
Clearly annoyed by the obstruction, the Time Collector grumbled about something and left; but not before taping something to the Sinner's clothes.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Warning Notice obtained!

fail.text:
[Sinner] claims that there is something wrong with their calculation.

"Not only that, you are also disturbing the peace of our good citizenry. I will have to collect your taxes."

choices.story:
Looks like he'll have to defend himself somehow at the Collections Office.
It's not like you can change anything by stepping in.
... You suddenly come to a realization that this is the kind of thought that transformed T Corp. to a place like this. You whip around and try to intervene...
... But the Time Collector had already extracted time from the citizen, slowing him to a crawl.

events.name: Streets of T Corp.
events.story:
People from all walks of life, all with different hours to spend in a given day, speak and move about in varying speeds.
The sound coming from this odd inequality fills the street with incongruence.
Two people catch your attention in that chaos.
A rich-looking youth, despite his apparent time affluence, is walking in a brisk pace toward the streets...
... and a poor-looking old man, despite his apparent time poverty, is slowly walking into an alley with a leisurely look on his face.
Who to follow?

choices.label: Follow the youth.
choices.desc: Pride & Gluttony Advantage check. Pass to gain a Tremor E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
After barely managing to catch up to the youth, [Sinner] asks them what's gotten them in such a hurry.
The youth keeps glancing at his watch, clearly impatient about even waiting for [Sinner]'s question to finish. He keeps pacing from one location to another.
"I have to work fast so I can make more time!"
"That factory owner there? I'm sure he's got ten more hours in his life than I do!"
[Sinner] leans in and asks the youth: "What are you going to use all that time for?"
"With more time, I can use that time to work longer hours! Agh, I'm late! Gotta run, bye!"
The youth hurriedly runs into the building.
We never did find out what he really wanted to do with all that time.
Looks like he dropped something in his hurry...
But he's already too far gone to give it back.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Rusted Clock Hands obtained!

fail.text:
You couldn't catch up to the youth.
Oh well.

choices.label: Follow the old man.
choices.desc: Sloth & Lust Advantage check. Pass to gain a Tremor E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
You ask the old man: "How can you smile like that when it's clear that you have such little time?"
The old man smiles gently before writing something down on a paper.
'Life is not a matter of how much time we have.'
'What truly matters is how we use the time that is given to us.'
'How can I make any other face but a smile when, at this moment, I am afforded leisure in such a hurrying world?'
The old man slowly turns around and walks away.
Looks like he left something behind.
You look up to return the item to the old man... but he's already gone.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Etched Clock Hands obtained!

fail.text:
You ask the old man: "How can you smile like that when it's clear that you have such little time?"
The old man smiles gently before writing something down on a paper.
We don't have time for this nonsense.
You hurry on your path, leaving the old man behind.

choices.label: Don't follow anyone.
choices.story:
They're just two people minding their own business, spending their own time as they see fit.
Why go after them? Let's just spend our time as we see fit.
You continue down the street, your head brimming with thoughts of time inequality.

events.name: Yurodiviye Hideout
events.story:
A secret hideout of the Yurodiviye. A Yurodivy is fervently reciting the texts given to them by the Saint.
"We have become nothing but cogs in a machine that exists solely for the industrialists, the bourgeoisie, and the Wings."
"What else, what other human relation remains among the Citizens but the narrow self-interest and heartless bonds created by capital?
"Thus, we shall cast aside the cold, unfeeling metal we call coin; instead, we shall trade our warmth with one another based on our needs!"
"To the haves, the laws of the Nests are shields that protect their privileges; yet, to the have-nots, they are chains that shackle us!"
"Then we shall defy the laws of the Nest! We shall show them the wrath of the have-nots!"
"All that the Yurodiviye have to lose is our chains; all that we have to gain is a world without hunger!"
The Yurodivy suddenly points in our direction.
Looks like we're going to have to say something.

choices.label: T-the Yurodiviye of the City, Unite!
choices.desc: Wrath & Envy & Gluttony Advantage check. Pass to gain a Tremor E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
UNITE!
The Yurodivy produces a few bottles of liquor stolen from the rich and pours it over the pile of chalices, all the while shouting the chant.
Alcohol overflows the uppermost chalice and spills, filling the other chalices below.

fail.text:
That was a very awkward chant. Everyone suddenly shoots a suspicious look in your direction.
You make some bad excuses about having places to be before quickly booking it from the hideout.

events.name: Daily Life
events.story:
"Ah, there…!"
I turn around to see someone precariously stumbling by the railings… before falling.
Falling… like a feather dropping from a height that is neither too high nor too low, like someone slowly sinking in water.
"WATCH THYSELF!!!"
One of the Sinners shouts vigorously to alert us to the danger.
We all sprinted toward the area where the person was falling, but it seemed that they were still falling by the time we got there, and we even had time to catch our breath.
Something about the ponderousness of their fall made me wonder if it would be as easy and light as grabbing a gently falling piece of paper to grab them.
"… Mass as a factor can hardly be ignored in this case. Despite the ponderous speed with which they fall, if we were to bring them to a sudden stop…"
"We'll get to watch every millisecond of their spine slowly turning to crumbles, and the subsequent, decidedly final agony, stretched to minutes." 
"Eww…"
We still have some time before they hit the ground. We have to find something to break their fall…

choices.label: Fine something to break their fall.
choices.desc: Run a Lust & Sloth Advantage check to gain a Tremor E.G.O Gift.

check.prompt: Who will look for a cushion?

pass.text:
[Sinner] returned, carrying something in their hands.
It's a plush cusion.
"Let's try to make sure that the person falls on top of this thing, instead of trying to catch them ourselves…"
The other Sinners moved quickly, removing any dangerous objects from the area.
Finally, [Sinner] moved the cushion to just the right spot to break the civilian's fall.
… Eventually, the falling civilian gently hit the cushion. It sounded rather comfy.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Interlinked Time obtained!

fail.text:
[Sinner] returned, carrying something in their hand.
It's a plush cushion.
But…
"Oi, what's wrong with you? This thing's way too small!"
It's barely large enough to cover someone's torso.
"W-well, 'tis better than having naught to break their fall!"
Either way, there wasn't enough time for us to go out and look for an alternative. The Sinners decided to stand around in a circle to use their bodies to break their fall.
… Who, eventually, did.
The shock absorption was distributed amongst several bodies, and the tiny cushion at least managed to protect the person's back, but…
… once it was over, most of the Sinners were stumbling around with either broken arms or cracked spines.
fail.result_text:
E.G.O Gift Interlinked Time obtained! 
 All Allies took 20 damage.

"No need to go that far. Come on, fellas. Let me show you how it's done."
The Sinners made a small circle under the falling person, and successfully broke their fall.
"T-thank you so much…"
They thanked us, and handed us a small portion of what they were carrying.
… Very slowly. But the Sinners had grown used to it at this point, so we all waited patiently before seeing them off.

events.name: T Corp. Collector
events.story:
"Halt! This area is off-limits to outsiders!"
A man wearing a tall top hat, presumably an employee of T Corp., stops us.
"Only those contracted by T Corp., or those with special authorization slips, may pass through here."
Realizing that we were just standing there dumbfounded and unsure as to what we must do, he points to the side and continues.
"Hmm, looks like you do have the right to pass through here. Perhaps you've misplaced your pass."
"You can request for a reissuance there, off to the side. Go try your luck there."

choices.label: Receive a pass.
choices.desc: Lust & Sloth Advantage check. Pass to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift.

check.prompt: Who will go receive a pass?

pass.text:
"You can receive the pass permit here."
As instructed by the receptionist, [Sinner] filled out the pass issuance form without question.
"Please fill in the blanks here, and here as well."
[Sinner] carried out the task valiantly.
"And for your specific visitation purposes, the pass fee is listed right here."
"Uhh…"
[Sinner] look at us with consternation.
"Buuut, the Time Lottery winner this time around donated their winnings to pay for civilians' pass permits. What a generous soul, that one."
"Now, please wear this badge. Don't forget to return it once your task here is done."
We were able to obtain ourselves a pass without paying a single Ahn.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Emergency Investigator Badge obtained!

fail.text:
We decided to grab a pass, but the door was already shut.
"Time is more precious than Ahn. Do arrive earlier than our closing hours next time."
Only the haphazardly scribbled and tacked on sign greeted us at the receptionist's desk.

choices.label: Take a contract.
choices.desc: Begin a combat encounter. Win to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift.
choices.story:
"Well, we've had some trouble 'round these parts at T Corp. We'll welcome outside help if we can get it."
"One of them being the Yurodiviye—they've put out a manifesto or what have you, that they're thinking of stirring trouble here. Take them out, and we can hand you a badge without having to go through the process of getting a separate pass permit." As if on cue, we found ourselves surrounded by a group of people in striking scarves.
choices.result_text: Win the battle to gain E.G.O Gift Emergency Investigator Badge!

Present the Warning Notice.
Choice unlocked with the 'Warning Notice'

"… Alright? But… why?"
"What benefit could you possibly have to gain from presenting that warning slip?"
"I mean, I was going to search your names in the system, which would have shown that you've all been warned; meaning, it was only a matter of time before I—hang on, were you all trying to save my time?"
"Well, I do appreciate the gesture, chaps. Let's not waste any more time and wrap this up."
Then, as if on cue, a shudder drops in front of the reception desk, and a siren begins to blare.
… It wasn't long before we were surrounded by T Corp. employees.

events.name: Yurodiviye
events.story:
We turn into a corner and come across a rather crudely drawn poster.
Written on the poster is a brief introduction next to a small note with directions.
'Running low on time, but burning full of frustration? Then come join the Yurodiviye.
Are you content with letting the inequity walk all over you?
Or would you rather live for its destruction?
Desire it, desire it hard!
Take this poster, let it be your train ticket.
At the ■■■ alley, face the ■■ road and walk at a speed of 120km per day. Alone.'

choices.label: Take the poster, and follow the directions on the note.
choices.desc: Run a Lust, Sloth, and Gluttony Advantage check to gain a Tremor E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
We remained in hiding while [Sinner] sorted out the directions on the poster and made it to the meeting spot.
Sometime later, [Sinner] conversed briefly with a stranger before returning to us with what appears to be a mechanical gear of sorts.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Entanglement Override Sequencer obtained!
