We remained in hiding while [Sinner] sorted out the directions on the poster and made it to the meeting spot.
But…
… no one came to meet [Sinner].
That's when we sensed a group of scarved people approaching from behind us.
"I'm quite certain we asked any hopefuls to come alone… what are you lot, hounds of T Corp.?"
… Looks like a fight is inevitable.
fail.result_text: Win the battle to gain E.G.O Gift Entanglement Override Sequencer!

It does make one wonder: what could the Yurodiviye be recruiting for? But it seems to be a waste of time to follow this lead.
I look away from the poster and hurry myself alongside the Sinners.

"Wait, that chalice…"
"Of course, I've heard the tales. Someone working hard for the redistribution of wealth, despite not wearing our color…"
"Keep up the good work, comrade… this machine'll come in handy, take it."
Clearly, he must've been mistaken. He patted my shoulder lightly before leaving something in my hands.
choices.result_text: E.G.O Gift Entanglement Override Sequencer obtained!

events.name: The Time Ripper
events.story:
A desperate voice echoes from afar.
"Join us. Let's tear down the inequities, together."
Another voice speaks.
"We're saving time from their poor, miserable deaths. This is a holy deed."
Another voice speaks excitedly.
"Join us, mate. Become one of the phantom thieves. Know them blokes, right? The gentleman thieves, the thieves who serve justice… Hm, or are we more like muggers of justice?"
… Maybe we can use this as an opportunity to trick them.

choices.label: Pretend to join them.
choices.desc: Run a Lust & Sloth Advantage check. Pass to gain Cost.

check.prompt: Who will pretend to join them?

pass.text:
[Sinner] signals me with a nod before walking forward.
"A very wise decision! Let us remove your brain and bring you into our fold."
"Now, while we do not have the luxury of time, take this, and—"
[Sinner] snatches the thing in their hands and begins striding back toward the rest of us.
"… Huh?"
"Y-you must let us finish! You're…"
"What are you all, daft?! We've been tricked!"
We forged onward, ignoring the sounds coming from behind us.
pass.result_text: Cost 240 gained

fail.text:
[Sinner] signals me with a nod before walking forward.
A different set of voices began to echo.
"Hold on, how do we trust them?"
"Let's just move on! We're not just letting any sod join us willy-nilly…"
"I'm sorry; forget we ever had this conversation. It seems that our offer was made in haste, without a proper agreement made even amongst us."
[Sinner] continues to argue their case, but…
"If you won't forget us… we may have to take your time."
They seem quite determined to leave us; they walk past us without hesitation.

choices.label: Refuse.
choices.story:
"You refuse…? You refused us…?"
"No, this is better. It is not yet the time for the secrecy of our existence to be revealed."
"I never had any faith in them to begin with!"
"Couldn't you have been a tad more careful? They already heard everything! About our purpose!"
The voices seem to argue amongst one another for a moment before the figure finally approaches us.
"Forget we ever had this conversation. It seems that our offer was made in haste, without a proper agreement made even amongst us."

events.name: Economy Class Discount Voucher Event
events.story:
A ticket booth inside a WARP train platform.
In front of it is a long line of people trying to get their tickets.
As we were waiting in line, a passenger approached us. They're dressed like an employee of a Wing…
"'Scuse me, can I ask you folks something?"
"Verily! Ask away!"
"If it's gonna take just ten seconds to get there anyway… what's the real difference between first class and economy class seats?"
"I did make bank from this work trip, but… first class ticket's probably a waste of money, right?"
The Sinners all turn to look at me as the passenger waits for our reply.

choices.label: You should buy a first class ticket.
choices.desc: Gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift depending on the result of the following choice
choices.story:
Well, now that we've talked to one another… I suppose a little tip couldn't hurt.
While we couldn't explain the details, we recommended that, as long as they could afford it, they should buy a first class ticket.
"Wha? A first class ticket?"
The passenger's eyes open wide, surprised.
A first class ticket…? That's like… my two months' salary. Are you sure it's worth that much money?

choices.label: You SHOULD buy a first class ticket.
choices.desc: Envy & Sloth Advantage check. Pass to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
"Mm, fine. I did hear some pretty bad stuff about the first class seats, but… you're pretty convincing."
"Screw it, I made a ton of cash from this trip anyway. I'll splurge on a first class ticket."
The passenger appears convinced to purchase a first class ticket by [Sinner]'s passionate recommendation.
"Thank you for your advice, stranger."
The passenger produces a paper voucher from their pocket and hands it over to [Sinner].
"I got this from one of the magazines I'm subscribed to. It's for you."
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Economy Class Discount Voucher obtained!

"You're not a W Corp. employee, are you…?"
"I dunno, it sounds like you're trying too hard to sell me on this idea."
"I'll think about it."
Despite what they said, it's easy to tell that the passenger's convinced to go with an economy ticket.

We ended the conversation with a polite goodbye.
A subtle look of guilt appears on the Sinners' faces.

events.name: Canned Ice Cream Event
events.story:
As we were waiting around on the platform, we happened across a Fixer equipped with various prosthetic parts.
A cool costume and four mechanical arms.
That was more than enough to draw the interest of a few Sinners. They all look at them intently.
Maybe the Fixer felt their gaze.
They turn around and look back in our direction.
"I noticed that you've been watching me for a while. What's up?"

choices.label: "Are you from up north?"
choices.desc: Gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift depending on the result of the following choice
choices.story:
"Yep, from up north. Was it the outfit? I guess northern outfits do stand out with how heavily we're dressed."
"Whew, I really enjoy the sights down south. I can actually take in the horizon, 'yknow? Up north, we've got so many damn tall buildings that we basically don't ever see a proper horizon. It's even worse in downtown areas. It's like I'm walking through a building jungle."
"Hm, your weapons are pretty simple, huh? Gotta color 'em, put some dangly bits on 'em, make 'em stand out, catch my drift? They'll look down on you if you can't immediately show how impressive you are."
"Oh, also, another thing. Lemme tell you folks about the tricolor canned ice cream they sell back in my hometown. Man, it's a real delicacy. If you ever—"
"……."
It's not like I've got ears myself, but I'm starting to understand what it means to "talk someone's ear off".
We learned a lot more than we wanted to about the northern regions.
I think we lost them somewhere around a harangue about various canned items of P Corp.
Should we ask some more questions?

choices.label: "What are the benefits of having four arms?"
choices.desc: Select to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
"First, it's sturdy. I commissioned it from one of the more expensive workshops, you know. Also, think about how often you hurt your arms and hands as you're doing Fixer work."
"I'm tellin' ya, prosthetic maintenance is way cheaper than getting your flesh regenerated."
"Oh, another thing. You don't have to hold your phone awkwardly with your cheek when you're typing and calling at the same time. You can open a can of ice cream with a pair of hands while the other goes over some documents…"
"Man, back when I was working in the western regions, I had so, so much work that I even thought about installing more sets of arms beyond these four!"
"……."
It's not like I've got ears myself, but I'm starting to understand what it means to "talk someone's ear off".

We'll have to walk to the center of the room where the worming, intertwined mass of flesh is.

There's something at [Sinner]'s feet.

events.name: Prosthetic Joint Servos & Crystallized Blood Event
events.story:
A prosthetic body blocks the passageway between two train cars.
We approach them carefully, just in case that it is a Bloodbag.
… It is a Bloodbag, just dormant and immobilized.
A closer inspection through the mechanical joints reveals that any flesh that was once there has been completely desiccated.
The swollen veins broke through the steel armor, turning into red crystal growths all over the prosthetic body.
Though their expression is unobservable, it isn't hard to imagine that palpable pain must have been involved in this process. The Fixer's last moments left them in a twisted form that couldn't have been born from anything else but unimaginable pain.

choices.label: See if anything can be done to help.
choices.desc: Pride & Envy & Gloom Advantage check. Pass to gain a Charge E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
There isn't much we can do to help.
[Sinner] points out a mechanical part as we were investigating the prosthetic body.
While its master can no longer move, the mechanical parts are still in operation.
For a moment, I wonder if they can revert a broken prosthetic as well once the train reaches its destination.
Considering that the passengers' clothes are reverted too, it's likely that the same will apply to prosthetics.
Then it's probably okay to borrow a part for a while, right?
I asked [Sinner] to dismantle the prosthetic.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Prosthetic Joint Servos obtained!

fail.text:

We can only hope that the reconstruction process goes smoothly once the train arrives.

The Sinners grow alarmed at the sight of desiccated viscera visible through the crystallized blood and the prosthetic husk.
After a brief discussion with the Sinners, I decided to take a sample of the crystallized blood.
It might come in useful.

"It has got to be a rather dangerous weapon."
"Verily, 'tis an item most puzzling!"
Clearly, the Sinners are having a hard time coming to a consensus.
... Looks like it's up to me to decide whether we're picking that thing up or not.

choices.label: Pick up the weapon.

"'Scuse me, can I ask you folks something?"
"Verily! Ask away!"
"If it's gonna take just ten seconds to get there anyway… what's the real difference between first class and economy class seats?"
"I did make bank from this work trip, but… first class ticket's probably a waste of money, right?"

A first class ticket…? That's like… my two months' salary. Are you sure it's worth that much money?

[Sinner] powers through the unpleasant, disgusting sensation and stands still through the whole ordeal.
A few minutes later, a voice tells us that biometric authentication is complete. The cable returns to its original spot.
There's something at [Sinner]'s feet.

The selected Sinner loses 10

Another thick cable reaches out toward [Sinner]…

events.name: Prosthetic Joint Servos & Crystallized Blood Event
events.story:
A prosthetic body blocks the passageway between two train cars.
We approach them carefully, just in case that it is a Bloodbag.
… It is a Bloodbag, just dormant and immobilized.
A closer inspection through the mechanical joints reveals that any flesh that was once there has been completely desiccated.
The swollen veins broke through the steel armor, turning into red crystal growths all over the prosthetic body.
Though their expression is unobservable, it isn't hard to imagine that palpable pain must have been involved in this process. The Fixer's last moments left them in a twisted form that couldn't have been born from anything else but unimaginable pain.

choices.label: See if anything can be done to help.
choices.desc: Pride & Envy & Gloom Advantage check. Pass to gain a Charge E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
There isn't much we can do to help.
[Sinner] points out a mechanical part as we were investigating the prosthetic body.
While its master can no longer move, the mechanical parts are still in operation.
For a moment, I wonder if they can revert a broken prosthetic as well once the train reaches its destination.
Considering that the passengers' clothes are reverted too, it's likely that the same will apply to prosthetics.
Then it's probably okay to borrow a part for a while, right?
I asked [Sinner] to dismantle the prosthetic.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Prosthetic Joint Servos obtained!

fail.text:
There isn't anything we can do to help.
We can only hope that the reconstruction process goes smoothly once the train arrives.
fail.result_text:
Nothing happened. 
 E.G.O Gift Crystallized Blood obtained!

choices.label: Investigate if this has anything to do with a Bloodfiend.
choices.desc: Select to gain a Bleed E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
There is no doubt that this Fixer was attacked by a Bloodfiend.
The Sinners grow alarmed at the sight of desiccated viscera visible through the crystallized blood and the prosthetic husk.
After a brief discussion with the Sinners, I decided to take a sample of the crystallized blood.
It might come in useful.

events.theme: Murder on the WARP Express BokGak

events.name: LCB Regular Check-up
events.story:
We're at the starting point of the Dungeon of the Fathoms.
We found ourselves in a room that appears to be a workshop of E.G.O gears.
'If you have scored below 100% synchronization rate in the aptitude test, take only a single E.G.O from here.'
An ominous warning sign greets us all, and the same words repeat ceaselessly from the speaker.
The Sinners all go to take a look, enticed by the sign telling us that we can pick up E.G.O gears here… but what we find there are E.G.O Gifts.
"Wha? These ain't E.G.O gears. These are… them gifts or something, right?"
"It appears that E.G.O are manifest here in the shape of E.G.O Gifts."
"Hm. Can't we just take them all?"
"This is a Dungeon of the Fathoms. As it differs from the usual Mirror Dungeons, it is highly advisable that its rules are followed."
What should we do?

choices.label: Take the flaming gauntlet.
choices.desc: Select to gain a Burn E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
This one seems best suited for the situation we're in.
We take the 'Combustion Gloves' E.G.O Gift.

choices.label: Take the combat boots with spiky bits on them.
choices.desc: Select to gain a Rupture E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
This one seems best suited for the situation we're in.
We take the 'Spiked Combat Boots' E.G.O Gift.
choices.result_text: E.G.O Gift Spiked Combat Boots obtained!

choices.label: Take the cleaning solution spray.
choices.desc: Select to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
This one seems best suited for the situation we're in.
We take the 'Illusory Hunt' E.G.O Gift.

events.name: LCB Regular Check-up
events.story:
We came across a group of researchers passionately poring over various documents.
They're having a debate about two subjects: emotions and flame.
"Regular flames don't seem to hurt the Abnormalities very much. So why does this work, I wonder…?"
"Perhaps a greater degree of wrathful emotions opens up the room for the fire's heat to touch Abnormalities and Distortions, both entities of the unknown."
They must've noticed us listening in to their conversation intently—one of them approaches us with a glint in their eyes.
"Are you the 'sample' who's agreed to this experiment?"
"If so, try this on."
In the researcher's hands was what looked like an ignition plug… or a testing machine of sorts.

choices.label: You have the wrong person.
choices.story:
"Wha? You're not the sample?"
"Then what the hell are you doing in here? Get out, now!"
We were kicked out.

choices.label: We're the 'samples'.
choices.desc: Run a Wrath & Lust Advantage check to gain a Burn E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
"Oho, what an interesting reaction. Decent synchronization rate as well."
Maybe the researcher liked what they saw?
After scribbling their observations into various papers, the researcher let [Sinner] go.
[Sinner] took off the gear and presented it before the researcher to return it, but they simply shook their head in response.
"The gear seems to fit you perfectly. Take it with you."
pass.result_text:
E.G.O Gift Re-ignition Plug obtained! 
 The Selected Identity healed for 30.

fail.text:
"Hm, too much stress for your body, is it? Perhaps this wasn't a good match for you, after all."
The researcher furrows their brow, clearly unhappy about the results.
[Sinner] also scowls—but mostly from pain.
"Well, perhaps it takes some time for you to acclimatize to it. Take it with you, and try to get used to it."
"Try it on a few times and bring it back to me if you find it completely unbearable."
fail.result_text:
E.G.O Gift Re-ignition Plug obtained! 
 The Selected Identity took 30 damage!

events.name: LCB Regular Check-up
events.story:
Several researchers are moving about busily in a hectic-looking laboratory.
Did something escape, or something?
As we stood there gawking at the mess, someone walked up to the Sinners.
"Get outta my way!"
"A-actually, you know what? Perfect timing."
"Eat this. C'mon, we don't have much time 'till the clinical trial report deadline!"

choices.label: Eat it.
choices.desc: Run a Gluttony & Gloom Advantage check to gain a Rupture E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
[Sinner]'s face lights up with surprise as soon as they take a swig of the researcher's potion.
The potion seems to have alleviated a great degree of stress from [Sinner]—their eyes were practically twinkling.
"This clinical trial was a success. Thanks for volunteering."
"Please, take this. It's one of our newest line of medicines."
pass.result_text:
E.G.O Gift Enhancer Mk.4 obtained! 
 The Selected Identity healed for 30.

fail.text:
[Sinner]'s face scrunches up into wrinkles with disgust as soon as they take a swig of the researcher's potion.
It doesn't look like [Sinner] is doing too good—even worse, they can't seem to stop retching at the flavor.
"This clinical trial was a failure, I guess... Sorry about that."
"Take this with you, at least. It's one of our newest line of medicines."
fail.result_text:
E.G.O Gift Enhancer Mk.4 obtained! 
 The Selected Identity took 30 damage!

choices.label: We're not eating that. We don't even know what that is.
choices.story:
"Well, then get the hell outta my way!"
The researcher pushed us aside.

events.name: LCB Regular Check-up
events.story:
We see the Ardor Blossom Moth within the containment unit.
Small, crimson particles of flame surround it like an aura.
The flaming wings die out one moment, only to roar vigorously in the next.
An incessant attempt to set fire to everything around it.
"What a beautiful specimen, this Ardor Blossom Moth. Have you finished your observations?"
"We've been learning a lot about the Abnormality recently."
"There's still a lot of unknowns, but still."
"Speaking of which, here's a pop quiz. What E.G.O Gift can you get from the Ardor Blossom Moth?"

choices.label: Subaquatic Blossom
choices.desc: Select the right answer to gain a Burn E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
"……."
"Pay more attention next time."
The researcher brushed past us.

choices.label: Hellterfly’s Dream
choices.desc: Select the right answer to gain a Burn E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
"Right on the money. You know your Ardor Blossom Moth."
"But that's not all. Recently, it's been giving out these things, too."
"Take this with you. I'm just glad to have run into a kindred soul."
You receive a burning, flickering flame. It seems to have come directly from the Ardor Blossom Moth itself.

events.name: LCB Regular Check-up
events.story:
We see the Faelantern within the containment unit.
A cyan-hued fairy flutters toward the wiry, ancient branches of the tree and softly lands on one of them.
The branch seating the fairy sways, as though to entice us to get closer to them...
Bright, countless yellow eyes glimmer from the shadows beneath its roots.
"What a beautiful specimen, this Faelantern. Have you finished your observations?"
"We've been learning a lot about the Abnormality recently."
"There's still a lot of unknowns, but still."
"Speaking of which, here's a pop quiz. What E.G.O Gift can you get from the Faelantern?"

choices.label: Midwinter Nightmare
choices.desc: Select the right answer to gain a Rupture E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
"Right on the money. You know your Faelantern."
"But that's not all. Recently, it's been giving out these things, too."
"Take this with you. I'm just glad to have run into a kindred soul."
You receive a bony twig. It seems to have come directly from the Faelantern itself.

choices.label: Concavity
choices.desc: Select the right answer to gain a Rupture E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
"……."
"Pay more attention next time."
The researcher brushed past us.

events.name: LCB Regular Check-up
events.story:
At the end of this hallway, a group of researchers is having a discussion in front of an unnaturally dark place.
Noticing our presence, their faces brighten up as they approach us.
"Please, will you investigate this area ahead for us?"
"We will help with the best of our abilities should you accept."

choices.label: Accept and investigate.
choices.desc:
Heal all allies
Run a Pride & Envy Advantage check to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
"I love to see some proper enthusiasm. Yes... I like your attitude. Take this with you."
"It'll help you in your investigations."
After handing us the gear, the researchers walked up to the Sinners and began examining them.
Once they were finished, the Sinners were all in tip-top shape again.
pass.result_text:
All Allies healed back to Full. 
 E.G.O Gift Regular Operational Gear obtained!

fail.text:
"At least try to feign some enthusiasm, why don't you?"
"Well, we'll at least make sure that you're fully recovered. Don't look so disgruntled about it."
The researchers walked up to the Sinners and began examining them.
Once they were finished, the Sinners were all in tip-top shape again.
fail.result_text: All Allies healed back to Full.

choices.label: Refuse.
choices.story:
"Fine, walk away."
"We're not the ones losing out on a good deal."
The researchers all turned around without a moment's hesitation.

events.name: LCB Regular Check-up
events.story:
Several messy, frantic letters are carved into the wall with knives.
I can practically feel the sheer horror and desperation of their writers from the wild letters.
Upon close inspection, the deep marks tell a tale written in terror.
'They're swarming us the monsters I hear them their breathing they're going to kill us all'
'Save me please someone anyone save me I dont want to die please'
'Fear is what drives men to madness. The monsters are near, I can feel the rumble of their feet. They are coming…'
There are unfinished sentences written on the wall.
Death has carved deep marks between them.

choices.label: Ignore them and move on.
choices.story:
Nothing good can possibly come out of poking around in here. This won't be good for the Sinners.
We decided to quickly walk away from that place.

choices.label: Look around some more.
choices.desc: Run a Wrath & Gloom Advantage check to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
Noticing something, [Sinner] points to an area on the wall.
There is a small crack between the countless scribbles of letters. I carefully reach my hand into the opening, and—
Aha, I can feel the tip of my fingers brushing against a card. Someone must've hidden it in there.
This might come in handy later.
pass.result_text:
All Allies healed back to Full. 
 E.G.O Gift Operation Authorization Card obtained!

fail.text:
Noticing something, [Sinner] points to an area on the wall.
There is a small crack between the countless scribbles of letters. I carefully reach my hand into the opening, and—
I feel the tip of my fingers brushing against a healing ampule, its surface sticky with blood.
Perhaps there was a fight over this ampule.
There are signs of lingering despair and death all around this place.
We used the ampule and moved on, but a grim look is plastered on everyone's face.
fail.result_text:
All Allies healed back to Full. 
 All Allies lost 5!

events.name: Ardor Blossom Moth Containment Breach
events.story:
Perhaps the containment unit's security management has grown lax. 
 The Ardor Blossom Moth drifts languidly along the corridor, trailing a cluster of bright-red embers and flames in its wake. 
 Before long, the facility's announcement system erupts with warnings of a containment breach. Researchers come rushing down the hallway, scrambling to respond. 
 Should we step in and help the researchers suppress the Abnormality, or leave it to them and be on our way?

choices.label: Step in and help with the suppression.
choices.desc: Wrath Advantage check. Pass to gain a Burn E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
[Sinner] joined the researchers and swiftly helped suppress the Ardor Blossom Moth. 
 "Thank you. The truth is, this E.G.O gear is still undergoing calibration. It's still a bit tricky to use for Suppression..." 
 "A lot of us would've ended up seriously hurt had you not stepped in. We're grateful for your help, really." 
 The researchers passed us the E.G.O gear that was still being tested, calling it a "small token of appreciation." 
 "Trust me, it'll come in handy. Oh, and we'd appreciate it if you could try the gear out and let us know how well it performs out there."
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Trial Extraction : A.B.S obtained!

fail.text:
In the blink of an eye, the Ardor Blossom Moth's beating wings engulfed the researchers before [Sinner] could even react. 
 ... Then, slowly, the Abnormality turned to face us.
fail.result_text: Win the battle to gain E.G.O Gift Trial Extraction : A.B.S!

choices.label: Leave the suppression to the researchers.
choices.desc: No particular effect
choices.story:
They're armed to the teeth with E.G.O gears. Suppressing the Abnormality shouldn't pose much of a threat to them. 
 Let's pick up the pace and be on our way.

events.name: Faelantern Containment Breach
events.story:
A fluorescent, glowing hue of teal is dancing and rippling somewhere down the hallway. 
 An inexplicable impulse to walk toward the light takes hold of us. 
 Yet, seeing the researchers rush toward it as though drawn by an irresistible lure, it becomes clear that this is the doing of an Abnormality. 
 Should we force the researchers back and help suppress the Abnormality, or should we steer clear of whatever trap may lie ahead and move on?

choices.label: Step in and help with the suppression.
choices.desc: Gluttony Advantage check. Pass to gain a Rupture E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
[Sinner] should be more than capable of bringing the charmed people back to their senses and safely tracking down the escaped Abnormality to suppress it. 
 "*sigh* This isn't even the first time this particular entity's breached containment—we have all the relevant data, and yet, here we are." 
 "A lot of us would've ended up seriously hurt had you not stepped in. We're grateful for your help, really." 
 The researchers passed us the E.G.O gear that was still being tested, calling it a "small token of appreciation." 
 "Trust me, it'll come in handy. Oh, and we'd appreciate it if you could try the gear out and let us know how well it performs out there."
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Trial Extraction : Lantern obtained!

fail.text:
[Sinner] tried to snap the researchers out of it, but the charm was too strong—they wouldn't come around. 
 Perhaps wandering the hallways without equipping proper E.G.O gear had led them to this unfortunate outcome... 
 In the end, all we could do was watch as the Faelantern slaughtered the researchers, who were too entranced to even think of getting away. 
 ... At least we managed to corner the Abnormality. Suppressing it would be the least we can do in their memory.
fail.result_text: Win the battle to gain E.G.O Gift Trial Extraction : Lantern!

choices.label: Avoid the trap.
choices.desc: No particular effect
choices.story:
An Abnormality that lures its prey in with light... that can only mean the Faelantern. 
 We'd be taking a dangerous gamble ourselves if we attempted to confront it without a clear sense of where it's lurking. 
 Best pass this place by and keep our fighting strength intact. 
 ... Let's hurry along and keep moving.

events.name: Shock Centipede
events.story:
We can see the Shock Centipede beyond the glass of the containment unit. 
 "Ah, we're in the middle of studying how the Shock Centipede becomes effectively 'immortal' for a short while right before suppression." 
 "You see, our team's research paper focuses on discovering potential energy sources that allow for highly efficient charging gears." 
 "I trust you're all aware of the name of the E.G.O Gift extracted from this Abnormality?" 
 ... What was it again?

choices.label: Uncapped Defibrilator
choices.desc: Select the right answer to gain a Charge E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
"Correct! On top of safely containing temporary overcharges, there's barely any loss in the output as well! It is indeed a most remarkable phenomenon..." 
 The researcher chattered away happily before pulling something out from the cabinet behind. 
 "We recently implemented a new mechanism for calibrating Extractions—it produced quite an unusual form of E.G.O Gift." 
 "Maybe you'd be willing to try it out? Oh, we'd also appreciate any feedback on its performance..."
choices.result_text: E.G.O Gift Modified Extraction : AEDD obtained!

choices.label: Nonstandard-duty Battery
choices.desc: Select the right answer to gain a Charge E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
"......." 
 "Thought you'd remember it. I mean, you've been making use of it quite often..." 
 "You probably need more observation sessions." 
 With a drawn-out, disappointed sigh, the researcher walked away from us.

events.name: Post-choice Development
events.story:
"Let's see what it says... 'Entry Forbidden'...?" 
 We'd just passed the wall inscribed with messy, frantic letters when another door came into view. 
 The door was riddled with dents, as though something massive had repeatedly slammed into it with brutal force. 
 "At this point... think we could just force it open?" 
 "Nay, the current yet courses through it. It would be more prudent to open it by the rightful means and keep from inviting the consequences of crude handling." 
 A card reader panel is attached beside the battered door. 
 What should we do?

choices.label:
Open the door with the Operation Authorization Card. 
 Choice unlocked with the E.G.O Gift "Operation Authorization Card"
choices.desc: Select to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
The metallic screech of forcing the mangled door open grated on our ears, but eventually, the effort paid off. 
 What greeted us was the sight of a room caked in blood, littered with bits and traces of a desperate struggle. 
 "... This seems to be an employee ID card." 
 I took a closer look at the small plastic card the Sinner had picked up. 
 The blood had dried over the card in such thick layers that I couldn't make out the face and the name written on it. 
 ... Perhaps it'd be best to hold onto it for now.
choices.result_text: E.G.O Gift Someone's Dropped Employee Card obtained!

choices.label: Force the door open.
choices.desc: Wrath & Envy Advantage check. Pass to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
It was by no means an easy feat, but [Sinner] eventually managed to pry the door open. 
 What greeted us was the sight of a room caked in blood, littered with bits and traces of a desperate struggle. 
 "... This seems to be an employee ID card." 
 I took a closer look at the small plastic card the Sinner had picked up. 
 The blood had dried over the card in such thick layers that I couldn't make out the face and the name written on it. 
 ... Perhaps it'd be best to hold onto it for now.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Someone's Dropped Employee Card obtained!

fail.text:
"I thought it would open..." 
 [Sinner] kept at it for a good while, but the door simply refused to budge. 
 At some point, I realized we were wasting far too much time trying to force our way through the door without even knowing what might await us inside. 
 ... In the end, I gave [Sinner] a small pat on the back for trying and decided to move on.

choices.label: Walk away.
choices.desc: No particular effect
choices.story:
There are signs of someone—or something—forcing their way into the place that explicitly warned "Entry Forbidden." 
 The gap is far too small for a person to crawl through, but a small dog or a bird could have easily slipped in. 
 And if whatever went in through that gap is an Abnormality... 
 Then what awaits within is likely not a sight we'd wish to see or even picture in our minds. 
 Moving on should be the safest choice for now.

We see the Ardor Blossom Moth within the containment unit.
Small, crimson particles of flame surround it like an aura.
The flaming wings die out one moment, only to roar vigorously in the next.
An incessant attempt to set fire to everything around it.
"What a beautiful specimen, this Ardor Blossom Moth. Have you finished your observations?"
"We've been learning a lot about the Abnormality recently."
"There's still a lot of unknowns, but still."
"Speaking of which, here's a pop quiz. What E.G.O Gift can you get from the Ardor Blossom Moth?"

choices.label: Subaquatic Blossom
choices.desc: Select the right answer to gain a Burn E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
"……."
"Pay more attention next time."
The researcher brushed past us.

choices.label: Hellterfly’s Dream
choices.desc: Select the right answer to gain a Burn E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
"Right on the money. You know your Ardor Blossom Moth."
"But that's not all. Recently, it's been giving out these things, too."
"Take this with you. I'm just glad to have run into a kindred soul."
You receive a burning, flickering flame. It seems to have come directly from the Ardor Blossom Moth itself.

events.name: LCB Regular Check-up BokGak
events.story:
We see the Faelantern within the containment unit.
A cyan-hued fairy flutters toward the wiry, ancient branches of the tree and softly lands on one of them.
The branch seating the fairy sways, as though to entice us to get closer to them...
Bright, countless yellow eyes glimmer from the shadows beneath its roots.
"What a beautiful specimen, this Faelantern. Have you finished your observations?"
"We've been learning a lot about the Abnormality recently."
"There's still a lot of unknowns, but still."
"Speaking of which, here's a pop quiz. What E.G.O Gift can you get from the Faelantern?"

choices.label: Midwinter Nightmare
choices.desc: Select the right answer to gain a Rupture E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
"Right on the money. You know your Faelantern."
"But that's not all. Recently, it's been giving out these things, too."
"Take this with you. I'm just glad to have run into a kindred soul."
You receive a bony twig. It seems to have come directly from the Faelantern itself.

choices.label: Concavity
choices.desc: Select the right answer to gain a Rupture E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
"……."
"Pay more attention next time."
The researcher brushed past us.

events.name: LCB Regular Check-up BokGak
events.story:
At the end of this hallway, a group of researchers is having a discussion in front of an unnaturally dark place.
Noticing our presence, their faces brighten up as they approach us.
"Please, will you investigate this area ahead for us?"
"We will help with the best of our abilities should you accept."

choices.label: Accept and investigate.
choices.desc:
Heal all allies
Run a Pride & Envy Advantage check to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
"I love to see some proper enthusiasm. Yes... I like your attitude. Take this with you."
"It'll help you in your investigations."
After handing us the gear, the researchers walked up to the Sinners and began examining them.
Once they were finished, the Sinners were all in tip-top shape again.
pass.result_text:
All Allies healed back to Full. 
 E.G.O Gift Regular Operational Gear obtained!

fail.text:
"At least try to feign some enthusiasm, why don't you?"
"Well, we'll at least make sure that you're fully recovered. Don't look so disgruntled about it."
The researchers walked up to the Sinners and began examining them.
Once they were finished, the Sinners were all in tip-top shape again.
fail.result_text: All Allies healed back to Full.

choices.label: Refuse.
choices.story:
"Fine, walk away."
"We're not the ones losing out on a good deal."
The researchers all turned around without a moment's hesitation.

events.name: LCB Regular Check-up BokGak
events.story:
Several messy, frantic letters are carved into the wall with knives.
I can practically feel the sheer horror and desperation of their writers from the wild letters.
Upon close inspection, the deep marks tell a tale written in terror.
'They're swarming us the monsters I hear them their breathing they're going to kill us all'
'Save me please someone anyone save me I dont want to die please'
'Fear is what drives men to madness. The monsters are near, I can feel the rumble of their feet. They are coming…'
There are unfinished sentences written on the wall.
Death has carved deep marks between them.

choices.label: Ignore them and move on.
choices.story:
Nothing good can possibly come out of poking around in here. This won't be good for the Sinners.
We decided to quickly walk away from that place.

choices.label: Look around some more.
choices.desc: Run a Wrath & Gloom Advantage check to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
Noticing something, [Sinner] points to an area on the wall.
There is a small crack between the countless scribbles of letters. I carefully reach my hand into the opening, and—
Aha, I can feel the tip of my fingers brushing against a card. Someone must've hidden it in there.
This might come in handy later.
pass.result_text:
All Allies healed back to Full. 
 E.G.O Gift Operation Authorization Card obtained!

fail.text:
Noticing something, [Sinner] points to an area on the wall.
There is a small crack between the countless scribbles of letters. I carefully reach my hand into the opening, and—
I feel the tip of my fingers brushing against a healing ampule, its surface sticky with blood.
Perhaps there was a fight over this ampule.
There are signs of lingering despair and death all around this place.
We used the ampule and moved on, but a grim look is plastered on everyone's face.
fail.result_text:
All Allies healed back to Full. 
 All Allies lost 5!

events.name: Nocturnal Sweeping
events.story:
The night deepens.
Jade light shines through the window under the stifling moonless night sky.
As I conversed with the Sinner, something seemed to block out the light all of a sudden.
As we stood there, wary, someone ran into the room and swung a bladed instrument at us.
Thankfully, a Sinner unsheathed a weapon to block the intruder's attack.
They must've decided that the mission was a failure.
The opponent stared at us in silence for a moment before fleeing the scene.

choices.label: Pursue the fleeing intruder.
choices.desc: Run a Gluttony & Pride Advantage check to gain a Rupture E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
[Sinner] pursues the intruder with all the speed they can muster.
The intruder comes to a brief stop at a sharp turn—
[Sinner] does not miss that opportunity and swings their weapon at them, but they only succeed in cutting some fabric off their clothes.
Perhaps they dropped something in the process, however.
There was a yellow fabric on the ground.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Harestride obtained!

fail.text:
[Sinner] pursues the intruder with all the speed they can muster.
The intruder comes to a brief stop at a sharp turn—
[Sinner] does not miss that opportunity and swings their weapon at them, but they fail to even brush their clothes due to the intruder's absurd speed.
A resident of the building next to that scene walks out, sees the ground where the intruder stood on, and screams.
"What the hell? You messed up the road in front of my house!"
"I demand compensation! Or at least call an insurance Office to deal with this!"
We decided to stop pursuing them to clean up the floor before the resident made an even bigger fuss.

choices.label: Just watch the intruder run away.

events.name: Nocturnal Sweeping
events.story:
We notice henchmen of the Middle standing in the distance, discussing something.
It is likely that they are searching for a target who happened to get themselves written up in their Book of Vengeance.
Upon our approach, they stop us in our tracks and show us a picture.
"Seen a guy like this before?"

choices.label: Say "I think I've seen him before."
choices.desc: Run a Gluttony, Pride, & Envy Advantage check to gain a Blunt E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
[Sinner] doesn't seem to recognize the person in the picture at all.
However, with an impromptu story, [Sinner] managed to fool the henchmen of the Middle.
"I think that's gotta be the one, bro."
"That's it, we're heading east!"
"You've been very helpful. Here, take this."
"You're not our family, but these chains are proof that you helped the Middle out."
They handed us a bundle of heavy chains.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Chains of Loyalty obtained!

fail.text:
[Sinner] doesn't seem to recognize the person in the picture at all.
[Sinner] tries to come up with an impromptu story, but the henchmen of the Middle doesn't seem convinced.
"I don't think that's the guy, bro."
"Agreed, kid. Oh well. Move along, now."
"But before you go, take this."
[Sinner] received a temporary tattoo sticker.
It's not the real deal, but it looks pretty similar to the Middle's tattoos.
fail.result_text: E.G.O Gift Enh. Tattoos - The Middle obtained!

choices.label: Say "Nope, never seen him before."
choices.story: We stared back at them with blank, innocent eyes until they decided to let us go without trouble.

events.name: Nocturnal Sweeping
events.story:
We come across a dark interior.
People dressed in dark clothes are standing in a group. They are all wearing bamboo hats.
It seems that this group is expecting enemies; they are busily preparing for something.
"We have intercepted intelligence that someone will be going after our lord tonight."
"Backup team, stay here and wait for your next order."
"Operation team, head to the enemy infiltration points and prepare for their arrival."
"You all know your missions. Stick to them."

choices.label: Await orders.
choices.desc: Run a Gluttony & Pride Advantage check to gain a Rupture E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
Someone approaches as [Sinner] waits in standby.
"This is a talisman from Q Corp. Keep it safe, and use it against the enemies if they make it in this deep."
The talisman was engraved with various glyphs we couldn't understand.
It certainly carried some power, however—it'll come in handy.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Strange Glyph Inscriptions obtained!

fail.text:
Someone approaches as [Sinner] waits in standby.
"You're… I don't think you've been to anything today, hare."
"But if you're here anyway, clean up the room to see if there's anything that could get in our way."
We collected some broken shards and left the scene.
fail.result_text: E.G.O Gift Strange Glyph Talisman obtained!

choices.label: Follow the Operation team.
choices.desc: Run a Gluttony & Pride Advantage check to gain a Rupture E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
[Sinner] decided to follow the Operation team. Someone in a bamboo hat walks up to [Sinner] and delivers the mission.
"Place these talismans at their designated spots."
"Also, collect the scattered obstacles at a single place."
[Sinner] followed the mission, but was left with a few surplus talismans and shards.
"About those… keep them. Just in case."
We decided to take whatever was left.
pass.result_text:
E.G.O Gift Strange Glyph Talisman obtained! 
 E.G.O Gift Strange Glyph Inscriptions obtained!

fail.text:
"… Who are you? I haven't seen you around here before."
One of them looked at [Sinner] curiously.
"It seems that someone has infiltrated our ranks and disguised themselves as a hare."
"Intruders must be removed."
We are suddenly surrounded by a dark and yellow presence, suffocating us.
fail.result_text:
Reinforcements: 
 Win the battle to gain E.G.O Gift Strange Glyph Talisman!

events.name: Nocturnal Sweeping
events.story:
It is that hour of the night when it becomes impossible to guess the time.
We'd gotten off the bus for some reconnaissance when I sense a sudden, ominous tremor.
I turn to face the origin of the tremor, only to see a massive flood of Sweepers rushing toward us, blinking with their red lights.
They will sweep everything clean in their wake.
The longer we hesitate, the closer they're getting.

choices.label: Find a nearby shelter.
choices.desc: Run a Gluttony & Pride Advantage check to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift.

check.prompt: Who will lead us to a shelter?

pass.text:
[Sinner] identifies a prospective shelter and calls the other Sinners over.
We all ran into the shelter and shut the door behind us—but upon turning around, we realize that the place was already occupied. It did look big enough to hold us all, however.
It was an odd mishmash of a bar and a restaurant—slightly awkward to be called a bar, not robust enough to be called a restaurant. But people were enjoying their meals here anyway.
"I-I beg your forgiveness for our intrusion!"
One of the Sinners shout, and that seemed to have been acceptable enough for the guests. They soon get over their initial confusion and nod affirmatively.
We could hear something moving outside the door, but… at least this shelter seems safe.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Swishing Fuel Tank obtained!

fail.text:
[Sinner] identifies a prospective shelter and calls the other Sinners over.
Thunk, thunk.
The door budged, but something heavy and hard seemed to have stopped it from opening.
Whoever's in there probably locked the door as soon as the Night in the Backstreets began.
We turn around, but our exit's been blocked by the wave of Sweepers as well.
We have no choice but to fight them.
fail.result_text:
All allies take 20 damage! 
 Reinforcements: 
 Win the battle to gain E.G.O Gift Swishing Fuel Tank!

choices.label: Run for the bus.
choices.desc: 50% chance to begin a combat encounter. Win to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
Only by sprinting back to Mephistopheles do we make it all inside.
The relentless wave of Sweepers passes by moments after we close the door behind us.
pass.result_text: Nothing happened.

fail.text:
We sprint back to Mephistopheles, but it seems that we were a second too late.
We do not even have the time to turn around before the swarm overwhelmed us.
fail.result_text:
Reinforcements: 
 Win the battle to gain E.G.O Gift Swishing Fuel Tank!

events.name: Post-Heishou Choice Development
events.story:
Their duties completed, the Heishous are handing out the Mao Boluses they received from the Heishou-Xianren.
"And you, who are you? I haven't seen you around..."
"Perhaps they're the newly-initiated Hares?"
"... Identify yourselves."

choices.label:
Show them the Harestride and tell them you're new. 
 Choice unlocked with the E.G.O Gift "Harestride"
choices.desc: Select to gain a Rupture E.G.O Gift
choices.story: Once they've seen the Harestride, the Heishous moved on, leaving a Mao Bolus with the Sinner.
choices.result_text: E.G.O Gift Heishou Bolus - Mao obtained!

choices.label: Tell them you're a Hare returned from a duty elsewhere.
choices.desc: Run a Gluttony & Pride Advantage check to gain a Rupture E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
Relying on whatever they know about the Mao branch, [Sinner] tries to convince the Heishous.
To our relief, that seemed to have been enough to convince them—the Heishous left the scene after handing us a Mao Bolus.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Heishou Bolus - Mao obtained!

fail.text:
Relying on whatever they know about the Mao branch, [Sinner] tries to convince the Heishous.
But [Sinner] must've said something wrong or suspicious, because no sooner had they finished listening to [Sinner] than we were kicked out of there.

choices.label: Say that you're just passing by.
choices.desc: No particular effect
choices.story: We passed by the Heishous with nonchalance and left unscathed.

events.name: Oddly Familiar Boombox
events.story:
We see a group of the Middle's thugs blocking the path ahead, all donning the same attire as the ones we saw at the Great Lake.
Going right through them would risk a battle.
Looking around, we find a lone boombox some distance from them.
Is that the source of the raucous music that plays in the background whenever these thugs show up?
Perhaps moving it somewhere else would bait the thugs away from the road with its music.

choices.label: Take the Boombox.
choices.desc: Gluttony Advantage check. Pass to gain a Blunt E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
[Sinner] stealthily picked up the boombox.
We brought it to an adjacent street and hit the "play" button, blasting the alleyways with electronic dance music.
Nearby members of the Middle, alerted by the sudden burst of music, moved away from their stations toward that alley.
We shut off the music and snuck back to the original road, which was now open.
With the path ahead cleared, we were able to pass through without trouble.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Boombox of Dramatic Entrances obtained!

fail.text:
As soon as [Sinner] picked up the boombox, it began blasting electronic dance music loud enough to echo through the alleys.
Alerted by the sudden music, the Middle thugs immediately begin rushing at us.
fail.result_text:
Reinforcements:
Win the battle to gain E.G.O Gift Boombox of Dramatic Entrances!

choices.label: Take a different route.
choices.desc: No particular effect
choices.story:
There is no reason for us to risk a battle by taking this route.
We quietly turned our course and moved on via another path.

events.name: Punish the You branch Heishou.
events.story:
"Hey, you've come at just the right time. Listen, I need your advice."
We walked into a room with two Heishou glaring at each other, both of their buggy eyes bloodshot and clearly angry.
They explained to me that a Heishou of the You branch, in service of Xichun, happened to get into a kerfuffle with another Heishou.
"… And that's about the gist of it. Good thing they're both from my branches. A simple punishment wouldn't have been enough otherwise."
Like Xichun said, it seemed that they had decided to punish the Heishou of the You branch, who started the fight.
"How should I go about this?"

choices.label: Take the Heishou - You's talon—the Xueyan Blade.
choices.desc: Wrath & Gluttony Advantage check. Pass to gain a Burn E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
"So I should take the Heishou's talons because they couldn't be responsible with them, huh?"
As per [Sinner]'s advice, Xichun took the Heishou's dagger.
"Your will is my command, my lord…"
The Heishou of the You branch handed over the dagger, looking like they were giving up a very important part of themselves.
"I'll give 'em back to you after you think long and hard about what you've done wrong."
Xichun seems satisfied.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Bloodflame Sword obtained!

fail.text:
"… What? That's stupid."
Xichun, clearly dissatisfied with [Sinner]'s advice, commands the Heishou to… detention.
"Your will is my command. No same incident shall ever occur again, I promise."
The Heishou of the You branch gladly tied their own arms together.
… Xichun doesn't seem to find this resolution satisfying.

choices.label: Sentence the Heishou to a weeklong detention in binds.
choices.story:
"… Hm, yeah. That's what I was thinking of doing, too."
Xichun sentenced the Heishou to a detention.
"Your will is my command. No same incident shall ever occur again, I promise."
The Heishou of the You branch gladly tied their own arms together.
… Xichun doesn't seem to find this resolution satisfying.

events.name: Suspicious Red Cloth
events.story:
One after-school afternoon.
Xichun invited the Sinners to her office.
One of the Sinners notices a piece of red cloth on the ground, and inquires about it—but she only tilts her head curiously.
"That's not mine. That's… weird. I thought I cleared out all of the former Jia Mu's stuff…"
The red cloth was soaked in what appeared to be ominous, tarnished blood.

choices.label: Offer to take it with us if she has no need for it.
choices.desc: Pride & Gluttony Advantage check. Pass to gain a Slash E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
"Really…? That dirty thing…? Well, I mean, I'll give it to you if you want, but…"
Xichun gladly handed the piece of cloth over to [Sinner] upon their request.
"Well, if you need anything other than that creepy red cloth, don't hesitate."
… Some Sinners immediately perked up as though they were about to hound her with a list of demands, so I had put my foot down. … Which I barely managed.
The red cloth was already tied around [Sinner]'s wrist.

It's another day of classes for Jia Xichun, who's trying her best to prove her right to be the Family Hierarch.
After class…
… Jia Xichun came to visit the Sinners who taught today's classes.
"Guys, is it office hours? There were some things I didn't quite understand about today's class…"
The Sinners… or, rather, the teachers, turned to pay attention to Jia Xichun's questions.

"In order to understand the patterns and exceptions by which the mobile rooms operate on Restructuring Days…"
"By following the guidance of your heart instead of relying solely on sight…"
"And that is precisely why psychological shock is a much more superior method than physical pain…"
Some Sinners who specialized in "Zhi" step up to answer her questions.
After a few exchanges, Xichun gives us a confident nod.
"Thanks. I'll be back if there's anything else I didn't quite get."

"Right, lass! Remember, it's all in that glare…"
Some Sinners who specialized in "Yong" stepped up to answer her questions.

"So you've got to look through a K.L. to U.K."
"… So you've got to look through a kid's lens to understand kids, she says."
Some Sinners who specialized in "Ren" stepped up to answer her questions.

events.name: Someone fenced Heishou - Wu Branch gear
events.story:
The black market of District 8 Backstreets were full of interesting yet dangerous items.
Boluses that make you smarter at the cost of hair loss.
An Anamnaworm of someone who has tasted all kinds of wonderful cuisines.
But the one that stood out to us was…
"…? What's that doing there?"
"Dante, that thing's clearly been fenced. Maybe we can… "yoink" it, if ya know what I mean?"

"Oh, those are samples taken from the Corridor that looked like the Ring's gallery. We're done with the component analysis, so feel free to take them."
What should we do?

We explore the hall filled with endless stretches of display cases. The ceiling is so high that we can't even see where it ends.
At first, I tried counting how many toy boxes we'd walked past, but soon lost count…
"What's this?"
… and came upon an articulated hand model, standing proud in its lonesome glory.

Maybe we can put that to use if we can manage to pry it from the fist?

… Looks like the knuckle was rigged to bring down the shelves if the fingers are not uncurled in the right order.
The knuckle is now lost beneath the debris, buried too deep to retrieve.

events.name: Bamboo-hatted Kim's Past 1
events.story:
"Um, excuse me…"
As we were slowly looking around the streets of S Corp., a youth, after fidgeting and hesitating for a moment, walked up to us and asked for help.
The youth explained that, wishing to better his own status, he took the Royal Examination—akin to a public employment policy in S Corp.—and was able to attain a high grade for himself.
And that was where his problems began; as far as he knew, people who passed the exam with flying colors like himself had their travel expenses paid for the homeward trip and were to be granted a guide. But there must've been a misunderstanding or something, because when he left the exam grounds, no one was there to escort him.
Confused by the unexpected turn of events, he wandered away from the exam grounds in search of his escort, lost his bearings, and found himself in these alleys.
He's asking if we could help him with directions… What should we do?

choices.label: "Sorry, we've never been here before, either."
choices.desc: No particular effect
choices.story:
"Ah, you too are unfamiliar with these streets?"
The youth wandered off, clicking his tongue in disappointment.
"… Hmmh."
As soon as the youth disappeared from our sight, Bamboo-hatted Kim, who had slinked away to the back of the group, suddenly let out a deep sigh.
"Have you aught to say, Mentor?"
"Uh, that's… me. I am that youth."
… The sudden reveal threw the Sinners for a brief loop.
"Back then, I was a conceited fool who proudly smelled his own farts, not knowing how ridiculous he appeared."
"The exam was to compose an essay on a certain someone who has committed treason against S Corp. Full of foolish confidence as always, I wrote them a long paper humiliating the treasonous wretch so that no such embarrassment could ever stain our history again…"
"… and only upon arriving home did I realize who he was. Who would've known that the 'treasonous wretch' I had excoriated savagely in the exam was none other than my own ancestor?"
"T-then the reason you did not seek out a seat of an official, even after passing the test, was…"
"How could I dare, Aeng-du? Why do you think no escort volunteered to guide my foolish past self?"
"Because every soul in S Corp. but myself already knew what I had done, who I was—a bastard who betrayed his own ancestor's name to pass an exam."
Kim muttered placidly as though he was sharing a mildly funny joke, then walked ahead of us…
"But they needn't have shamed me into breaking my brush, for I had already done that myself."
… while quickly hiding his shaking hand beneath the other.

choices.label: "Let me ask my group if they can help."
choices.desc: Run a Gluttony & Pride Advantage check to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
[Sinner] opened their mouth to begin, stopped, then turned around to where Bamboo-hatted Kim and Aeng-du were.
"I… I am not so well-versed in the geography of this area. Perhaps Mentor would know better…?"
"… Come on."
Kim let out an audibly disconcerted sigh, then walked up to the youth to give him directions.
"… And take off that royal celebratory flower crown. You don't want people to know you've passed the exam."
"Hm? But why would…?"
"It's for a good reason. Just do as I say and you'll thank me one day."
The youth stared back at him in puzzlement, before seemingly deciding that giving proper gratitude for Kim's assistance took precedence. He handed us what appeared to be a small ceramicware vessel.
"Ah, might this be a water dropper for brush calligraphy?"
"Though you may have no practical need of this, for I see none of you are much acquainted with the art of grinding ink against inkstone, I impart this gift to you in hopes that this dropper may form a small flow in your rivers of life."
"… Ha!"
… Though it would have made for a rather moving moment had it not been for the exaggerated scoff Kim gave, the youth hurried on his path without minding the sudden discourtesy.
Aeng-du later asked Kim what had spurred his sudden outburst, but he did not give her a reply, instead choosing silence behind pursed lips.

events.name: Bamboo-hatted Kim's Past 2
events.story:
Navigating our way through the streets of S Corp., we come across a young man hugging a blade, his gaze wandering blankly toward the sky.
"… Ah."
He seemed to have caught us staring—he turned his head toward us, gave us a once-over, then slumped back where he sat.
"Pass on by, folks. I have no intent of bringing you harm."
His voice was familiar… but I couldn't quite place my finger on it.
"Search not for a revelation in the clouds drifting by, for they hold no answers."
Kim blurted out of the blue as we were about to walk past the sword-hugging man.
Oh, then that man must be…
"… Do you know me?"
"Must I know you to impart some unsolicited advice? A meddler in me simply cannot help himself when walking past a disadvantageous game of baduk."
The man widened his eyes in brief surprise, then began in a contemplative voice.
"You are a player of greater dan than I—that I can tell; so if you will, permit me to solicit some advice."
"Shamed I am of my past plays, for they were dishonorable and deserving of ridicule; thus I had begun to wonder if I would be of better use should I become a blade for hire…"
"Then, a man of incorruptible integrity, a just soul, sought me out and asked me that I serve as his blade. Yet, I worry that my filth may befoul his hands, too."
"What say you? Would you say that I take this opportunity and make this play? Or…"

choices.label: Let Bamboo-hatted Kim answer.
choices.desc: Select to gain a Slash E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
"Shamed you may be of your past plays, yet what of it?"
"What choice have you got but to continue placing the stones, when the game shall avail you no mercy of reverting a move?"
"What if continuing this play leads me to lose all of my territories?"
"Then resign the game."
"You've given it all to the end, and if it is indeed a bitter one, then what can you do? The least you can do is play it until the game is called."
"You're playing by following the flow anyhow, aren't you?"
"……."
"Though we have but just met, it seems as though your gaze penetrates deep into my bones, stranger."
"Take this as a token of my thanks for your 'meddling.'"
A lightbulb seemed to have gone off in his head; light flashed in the eyes of the man, or Bamboo-hatted Kim of the past, and he jumped to his feet and sped off, but not before handing us something.
"… Not that you'll be able to do anything to change the course of this losing game."
I think I heard Kim whisper.
choices.result_text: E.G.O Gift Flagroot Cane Sword obtained!

choices.label: Let a Sinner answer instead.
choices.desc: Run a Sloth & Pride Advantage check to heal the selected Identity.

pass.text:
[Sinner] told past Kim that, even if he weren't to take the chance now, an opportunity should present itself again.
"What about you, what do you believe I should do?"
"You were the one I wanted to hear from, after all."
But [Sinner]'s reply must not have been satisfying to the young man—that is, Kim of the past—because he again directed the question toward Kim of the present, who made no effort to hide his discomfort.
"So if I answer my own question from the past, does that count as my 'second opportunity'?"
"Hmph, that's more than I was afforded."
… Kim's replies were nothing but dry sarcasm.
But the young man gave a light chuckle as though he found that non-answer to be satisfactory, then slumped back to the ground. 
"Well, I did ask for your advice, but I suppose the choice ultimately comes down to me."
"Here, take this. I know to repay for people's time, answer or not."
He rummaged around for a bit in his pockets and handed us a rather sizeable tteok bundled in a giant leaf.
"It's a bundle of delicious tteok for your troubles. Take some for the road."

fail.text:
Just as [Sinner] began their answer…
"I don't remember asking you a single thing."
The young man's—Bamboo-hatted Kim of the past—voice now carried an icy edge, perhaps frustrated by Kim's silence.
"… Fine. If you would rather not say, then carry on."
The young man flicked his hand in a shooing motion, then slumped back to the ground. Seeing no reason to linger, we carried on without another word.

events.name: Bamboo-hatted Kim's Past 3
events.story:
I catch a glimpse of a figure, staring off into the darkness of the unlit prison.
"Hah…"
Bamboo-hatted Kim lets out a sigh, but before he even fully exhales…
"Who goes there?!"
A sharp cry cuts through the stagnant air. Someone here must've noticed us.
What should we do?

choices.label: Claim that we are the prison's guards, keeping our eyes on the prisoner.
choices.desc: No particular effect
choices.story:
"At least put a little effort into your lies, huh?!"
Clearly, pretending to be prison guards the way we are was a lie too easily disproven…
We took to our heels as the woman, red with anger, came after us with her sword unsheathed.

choices.label: Unsheathe our weapons and stand ready for battle.
choices.desc: Gain a Slash E.G.O Gift depending on the result of the following choice
choices.story:
"… You're not the prison guards."
The woman who called us stood there for a moment, nonchalantly trying to gauge us even as we stood with our weapons drawn. Then, she walked toward us in a gait that could not be called aggressive.
But instead of chatting with us, she called upon the figure sitting inside the prison.
"Would you care to explain? Who are they? And… what happened?"
The one-sided exchange continued for a while as she tried various lines of questioning to chat up the figure inside the cell, but it was to no avail.
"… Hah. Might as well be talking to a corpse long dead."
She let out an exasperated sigh before turning to us.
"Are you not here to visit him as well? Might you be those who share his purpose?"

choices.label: Say that you're not.
choices.desc: No particular effect
choices.story:
"… You're not?"
"Then might I… consider you naught but spies who have infiltrated the prison of the Royal Court?"
We took to our heels as the woman, without giving us even a second to explain ourselves, charged at us with her weapon drawn.

choices.label: Say that you are, and explain the situation.
choices.desc: Run a Lust & Pride Advantage check to gain a Slash E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
"… Visit that fool?"
Hearing that, [Sinner] and Kim stepped forth to explain what had led to the incident at the Right State Councilor's estate.
… With a… particularly critical edge coming on when describing Kim's own actions, that is.
"So that is what has transpired…?!"
"Uh— Uhm, hold on. How does that man know what happened—"
"There's no time for idle chatter. You must leave S Corp. right this instant, and…"
By the time Kim's story ended, the prisoner's curiosity finally bubbled over the limit and threatened to spill over as questions; however, the woman, who had just learned the truth of what had happened, refused to engage at all and focused entirely on removing the cangue clasped around the prisoner's throat.
"You cannot stay here; there is still much to be done."
"Ah, as for my fellow conspirators—perhaps it would be best that you make yourselves scarce as well, considering your precarious position in S Corp."
"The side entrance I used should still be open and unguarded. Leave, quickly!"
She continued to deftly work her hands to unclasp the cangue, even as she gave us directions so detailed and vivid that we could find our way out of the prison without a map.
"……."
Meanwhile, Bamboo-hatted Kim had wandered off to a corner of the room and picked up a broken piece of wood, pocketing it.

"…? I don't believe I recognize you. Who are you people, anyway?"
Before [Sinner] had the chance to get into the details of what happened, the prisoner suddenly spoke up.
As much as he might have wanted to remain silent, it seemed that the story only he should know coming out of strangers' mouths seemed to have stirred his lips awake.
"You don't know them?"
"Then might I… consider them naught but spies who have infiltrated the prison of the Royal Court?"
We took to our heels as the woman, without giving us even a second to explain ourselves, charged at us with her weapon drawn.

events.name: Education & Machine Console

We came across a containment unit as we were making our way across the hallway. Its door is letting off sparks of lightning.
Looks like the generator's shorted; the door refuses to close. But it doesn't seem like whatever Abnormality in there's escaped.
Try as we might to take a better look inside, the sheer darkness of the containment unit makes it hard to tell what's going on in there.
The webs haning from the ceiling and the suspiciously pitch-black floor were quite bizarre to behold, however.

choices.label: Stare at the webs.

Looking through the webs reveals… small spiders crawling within.
And that they were no mere spiderweb.
The darkness that devoured the floor lights up, red eyes glowing and teeming.
The little spiders notice the generator, and begin weaving their webs.
Some of them stick to the Sinners, slowly crawling up their bodies.

events.name: Safety Team
events.story:
Every corner of this room is filled with an emerald light.
Somebody spilled a bunch of Enkephalin on the table, enough to start slowly dripping to the floor.
'Executive Manager, we've found some Enkephalin here.'
'Mm. It will likely be helpful to our endeavors should we collect them'
'T.T.G.G.C.C?'
'"Take that glass gas canister, capiche?" … she says…'

choices.label: Scoop up some Enkephalin.
choices.desc: Select to gain a Sinking E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
'It is a terrible strategy to mess with gas you don't know the effects of! I say that we leave the gas and take only the Enkephalin.'
'Hmph, you don't know what you're blathering about.'
'Do you not see the twisted beauty emanating from the ominous gas container?'
'Nah, lass. I don't. It's just you.'
'So, um. Wouldn't that Enkephalin also be contaminated or something?'
'Enkephalin is not a material that is so easily tainted.'
The Sinners soon split into two parties and begin arguing with one another.
Few minutes later, we found ourselves quickly making our way through the hallway with a box of Enkephalin in our hands.

choices.desc: Select to gain a Sinking E.G.O Gift
choices.story:

'I am rather partial to the hazy levitation of the effluvium.'
'Ooho, forsooth! Yet… how shalt thou carry the intangible gas!?'
'Look, here's a button to extract the gas into a portable gas canister~'
The Sinners soon split into two parties and begin arguing with one another.

Beyond the glass is a bizarre skull…
A floating skull bound by thorns to a cross, surrounded by a circular light.
The empty eye sockets of the skull gaze straight into us.

events.name: Heal HP, SP, or gain Cost
events.story:
We look up to see white butterflies above us.
Though given wings, the butterflies wander the hallway, fluttering to nowhere.
We make our way to where it seems to rest a while, and we see a large coffin past the transparent glass window.
It was too grand for a one, yet too small for many.
'A lonesome coffin lies.'
'Eugh, a coffin…? I have a bad feeling about this. We probably shouldn't touch it, right?'
'That'd be the safer choice, yeah… but what if there's something in there that could help us?

choices.label: Let's not mess with the coffin and leave.
choices.story:
We solemnly paid our respects to the coffin past the door, then left.
Butterflies without a home dance, fluttering toward us on a shearing, cold wind.
Are they writhing out of sorrow, or are they wingbeats of lamentation? We cannot know.
A remembrance rises as I quietly observe the butterflies. That something has merely and fully returned to whence it came.

choices.label: Let's see what's inside the coffin.

choices.story:
A cold cadaver of a butterfly rests silently inside the coffin.
The white butterflies, who so desperately fluttered their tiny wings in the faith that there must be something there at the end, are no more; gone, unnoticed by all.
What lies past the periphery of death, one asks. Truth be told, there is nothing, nothing at all.

'This is a magic bullet that will never miss, no matter what.'
'But… it has one condition. The final bullet will always fly toward the one you love most.'
'If you are still willing to fire this bullet, or have someone you would like to shoot… I can grant you that.'

events.name: The Knight of Despair Containment Unit
events.story:
This is an Abnormality of despair that has gone through a repeated cycle of faith and betrayal, leaving only the emotion that is expressed through black tears.
The hero, once a self-proclaimed knight and a protector of justice, is nowhere to be seen.
So many things that were once thought to be immutable changed, and her once-steadfast pride lay weathered and eroded.
Her eye socket, the endless wellspring of tears, is now twisted black; only the dark, burnt teardrop remains beneath it.

choices.label: Change comes for everything, eventually.
choices.desc: Run a Gloom, Pride, & Envy Advantage check to gain a Sinking E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
Change is inevitable; it is simply a part of the natural flow.
So are those who are changed by truth.
One who sought to remain on the side of good, upon realizing that there was no evil left in the world, came to fill its absence herself.
And here is the one who despaired upon seeing all that she swore to protect turn to dust.
Change comes for everything, eventually.
To accept the changes, gather the falling tears and whet the sword keen, for the flow cannot be stemmed.

events.name: The Queen of Hatred Containment Unit
events.story:
The Containment Unit's door was open.
Inside the unit was a girl, whispering, muttering to herself while curled up on the ground in gloom.
"There's good, and there's evil in this world."
"Where there's light, there's darkness. It can't entirely be one way or the other."
"I'm good, so they're evil."
"I am a chosen one."
"Am I unnecessary?"
"I hate… peace…?"
Anxiety. Compulsion. Obsession. Exhaustion.
Dark energy radiates around her like a materialization of those very words.

choices.label: We don't live in a binary world defined only by good and evil.
choices.desc: Run a Wrath, Pride & Envy Advantage check to gain a Charge E.G.O Gift.

pass.text:
"Is that… true?"
While she didn't seem to fully agree to what [Sinner] said, it seems that it managed to alleviate some of her anxiety.
"Thanks. I must've been… thinking about it too negatively."
The girl smiles brightly as she hands something to [Sinner].
"This is a token of our friendship. Please take it!"
"And don't forget to call me when there's evil afoot, okay?"
… But I'm not sure how much longer this chipper attitude will last.

"That's how it's supposed to be… The good me can exist again, if I become evil."
She levitates slowly into the air, before azure spears appear from somewhere and skewer her.
An unsettling, serpentine creature manifests from within like it's breaking out of an egg before rapidly crawling out of the Containment Unit.

events.name: Lobotomy Corporation Central Command
events.story:
There's a report on a Central Command Team Clerk's desk.
The report was partially censored, but it seemed to be talking about a newly developed shield bullet of sorts.
'The Trauma Shield can protect its user from psychological damages from external sources for a ■■■■■■■ ■■■■ or ■■■■■■■■■.'
'If Shield bullet ■■■■■■ is needed, request the manager or a ■■■■■■■■ for assistance.'
Next to the heavily redacted report is a box labeled 'Trauma Shield sample & manual'.

choices.label: Take it.
choices.desc: Select to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
"Remember last time at the um… Training Team? This looks kind of similar to the ampule… that hit me back there."
"It seems not to share the name, however similar it may appear in its purpose to protect the target."
If it really has a positive effect on us, like the Sinners are saying, then it will definitely come in handy.
We took the sample.

choices.label: Leave it.
choices.story:
Let's not mess with something we don't quite understand. What if something unexpected happens?
We decided to leave it as-is.

events.name: Lobotomy Corporation Storage
events.story:
We're in a storage room at Lobotomy Corporation.
There's a broken machine—filled with what look like chunks of flesh.
"What… is that? Why's that just lying around in a storage room?"
"Faust explains that it is the remains of a previous iteration of a Sephirah, disposed upon replacement."
"… So it's a dead body?"
"Not exactly. Only its memories are reset; with replacement, the identical version of the Sephirah upon its initial production is reproduced."
"Almost a selfsame way in which we are rewound."
"Yeah, kinda like us, huh?"
Things got a bit awkward.
What can I, as the manager, say to lift the mood?

choices.label: I know we'll do fine. Like we always do.
choices.desc: Select to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift
choices.story:
"That's a very positive attitude~"
"Ooh~ Dante, is that confidence I sense?"
Despite my fears, that managed to lift the team's spirits in no time.

"You utter fool, can't you grasp that this is merely a demonstration of Executive Manager's high-brow sense of humor, a perfect remedy for this awkward silence?"
"What…?"
Despite my fears, that managed to lift the team's spirits in no time.

events.name: Punishing Bird
events.story:
The Qliphoth Overload siren blares loudly through the hallway. 
 We see a cute, small bird through the window of the overloaded containment unit. 
 There's a note taped to the wall next to this unit—"Insight Work is effective." 
 The Qliphoth Counter has already dropped to 10, but we don't see any Agents around. 
 "I think, uh, Miss Hod or someone warned us about something like that in one of our past visits…?" 
 "Mm. We were told that an increase in the Meltdown Gauge could trigger the arrival of Ordeals." 
 "Wha? Then we'd better get crackin'! Hurry inside, you lot!" 
 "Y-ya sure it's a good idea for us to go in there?" 
 Would it be okay if we just left this here and moved on?

 It was at that moment when a large flower bloomed by the monster's feet.

events.name: Singing Machine Gift Options
events.story:
There's someone crying inside the containment unit. 
 We peered inside to find a suspicious figure, wearing an outfit that stood out from those of the employees. 
 Noticing our presence, he suddenly approached us, beaming. 
 "I-I have to tune my instrument to perfect accuracy, but I don't have anyone to help me." 
 "Do you… like music? Help me, and I'll give you one of my instruments." 
 "H-how about it? Deal?"

choices.label: Agree to help, and ask for a guitar.
choices.desc: Wrath & Lust Advantage check. Pass to gain a Bleed E.G.O Gift.

check.prompt: Who will give it a try?

pass.text:
[Sinner] slipped a hand into the suspicious machine. 
 A flicker of pain crossed the Sinner's face, but after a moment, they gave a small gesture to show that it was bearable. 
 In response, the machine released a hauntingly beautiful melody. 
 "I… I need to finish the tuning… before I forget the melody." 
 The stranger who asked for help started tuning the instrument to match the pitch and tune of the machine. 
 [Sinner] pulled their hand out and took up the guitar resting nearby.
pass.result_text: E.G.O Gift Harmonics obtained!
